title: VerifAI: A Verifiable Open-Source Search Engine for Biomedical Question Answering
summary: We introduce VerifAI, an open-source expert system for biomedical question answering that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a novel post-hoc claim verification mechanism. Unlike standard RAG systems, VerifAI ensures factual consistency by decomposing generated answers into atomic claims and validating them against retrieved evidence using a fine-tuned natural language inference (NLI) engine. The system comprises three modular components: (1) a hybrid Information Retrieval (IR) module optimized for biomedical queries (MAP@10 of 42.7%), (2) a citation-aware Generative Component fine-tuned on a custom dataset to produce referenced answers, and (3) a Verification Component that detects hallucinations with state-of-the-art accuracy, outperforming GPT-4 on the HealthVer benchmark. Evaluations demonstrate that VerifAI significantly reduces hallucinated citations compared to zero-shot baselines and provides a transparent, verifiable lineage for every claim. The full pipeline, including code, models, and datasets, is open-sourced to facilitate reliable AI deployment in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: VerifAI是一个开源生物医学问答专家系统，通过检索增强生成结合后验声明验证机制，确保事实一致性并减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG系统在生物医学等高风险领域存在事实一致性问题，需要开发能够验证生成答案可靠性的系统。
AI.method: 系统包含三个模块：1)针对生物医学查询优化的混合信息检索模块；2)基于自定义数据集微调的引用感知生成组件；3)使用微调自然语言推理引擎验证原子声明的验证组件。
AI.result: 检索模块MAP@10达到42.7%，验证组件在HealthVer基准上超越GPT-4，显著减少幻觉引用，提供透明的声明溯源。
AI.conclusion: VerifAI通过模块化设计和后验验证机制，为高风险领域提供了可靠、可验证的AI解决方案，已开源促进可靠AI部署。

title: Unbiased Rectification for Sequential Recommender Systems Under Fake Orders
summary: Fake orders pose increasing threats to sequential recommender systems by misleading recommendation results through artificially manipulated interactions, including click farming, context-irrelevant substitutions, and sequential perturbations. Unlike injecting carefully designed fake users to influence recommendation performance, fake orders embedded within genuine user sequences aim to disrupt user preferences and mislead recommendation results, thereby manipulating exposure rates of specific items to gain competitive advantages. To protect users' authentic interest preferences and eliminate misleading information, this paper aims to perform precise and efficient rectification on compromised sequential recommender systems while avoiding the enormous computational and time costs of retraining existing models. Specifically, we identify that fake orders are not absolutely harmful - in certain cases, partial fake orders can even have a data augmentation effect. Based on this insight, we propose Dual-view Identification and Targeted Rectification (DITaR), which primarily identifies harmful samples to achieve unbiased rectification of the system. The core idea of this method is to obtain differentiated representations from collaborative and semantic views for precise detection, and then filters detected suspicious fake orders to select truly harmful ones for targeted rectification with gradient ascent. This ensures that useful information in fake orders is not removed while preventing bias residue. Moreover, it maintains the original data volume and sequence structure, thus protecting system performance and trustworthiness to achieve optimal unbiased rectification. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that DITaR achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in terms of recommendation quality, computational efficiency, and system robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出DITaR方法，通过双视角识别和针对性修正来对抗序列推荐系统中的虚假订单，在保持系统性能的同时实现无偏修正。
AI.motivation: 虚假订单通过人为操纵交互（如刷单、上下文无关替换、序列扰动）误导序列推荐系统，影响推荐结果并操纵特定商品的曝光率。传统方法需要重新训练模型，计算和时间成本高昂。研究发现虚假订单并非绝对有害，部分虚假订单甚至具有数据增强效果，因此需要精确识别有害样本进行针对性修正。
AI.method: 提出DITaR（双视角识别和针对性修正）方法：1）从协同过滤和语义两个视角获取差异化表示进行精确检测；2）过滤检测到的可疑虚假订单，选择真正有害的样本；3）使用梯度上升进行针对性修正。该方法保持原始数据量和序列结构，避免移除虚假订单中的有用信息，防止偏差残留。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验表明，DITaR在推荐质量、计算效率和系统鲁棒性方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DITaR能够有效识别和修正序列推荐系统中的有害虚假订单，在保护用户真实兴趣偏好的同时保持系统性能，实现最优的无偏修正。

title: Pretrain-then-Adapt: Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Text-based Person Search
summary: Text-based person search faces inherent limitations due to data scarcity, driven by stringent privacy constraints and the high cost of manual annotation. To mitigate this, existing methods usually rely on a Pretrain-then-Finetune paradigm, where models are first pretrained on synthetic person-caption data to establish cross-modal alignment, followed by fine-tuning on labeled real-world datasets. However, this paradigm lacks practicality in real-world deployment scenarios, where large-scale annotated target-domain data is typically inaccessible. In this work, we propose a new Pretrain-then-Adapt paradigm that eliminates reliance on extensive target-domain supervision through an offline test-time adaptation manner, enabling dynamic model adaptation using only unlabeled test data with minimal post-train time cost. To mitigate overconfidence with false positives of previous entropy-based test-time adaptation, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation (UATTA) framework, which introduces a bidirectional retrieval disagreement mechanism to estimate uncertainty, i.e., low uncertainty is assigned when an image-text pair ranks highly in both image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, indicating high alignment; otherwise, high uncertainty is detected. This indicator drives offline test-time model recalibration without labels, effectively mitigating domain shift. We validate UATTA on four benchmarks, i.e., CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, RSTPReid, and PAB, showing consistent improvements across both CLIP-based (one-stage) and XVLM-based (two-stage) frameworks. Ablation studies confirm that UATTA outperforms existing offline test-time adaptation strategies, establishing a new benchmark for label-efficient, deployable person search systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/nkuzjh/UATTA.

AI.tldr: 提出UATTA框架，通过无标签测试数据的离线测试时适应，解决文本行人搜索中数据稀缺和领域偏移问题
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练-微调范式的方法依赖大规模标注目标域数据，在实际部署中不实用。需要一种仅使用无标签测试数据就能动态适应模型的方法
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知测试时适应（UATTA）框架，引入双向检索不一致机制估计不确定性：当图像-文本对在图像到文本和文本到图像检索中均排名靠前时分配低不确定性，否则检测高不确定性。该指标驱动无标签的离线测试时模型重新校准
AI.result: 在CUHK-PEDES、ICFG-PEDES、RSTPReid和PAB四个基准测试上验证，在基于CLIP（单阶段）和XVLM（两阶段）框架上均显示一致改进。消融研究证实UATTA优于现有离线测试时适应策略
AI.conclusion: UATTA建立了标签高效、可部署行人搜索系统的新基准，通过无标签测试数据的离线适应有效缓解领域偏移

title: SkillForge: Forging Domain-Specific, Self-Evolving Agent Skills in Cloud Technical Support
comment: Accepted at ACM SIGIR 2026 Industry Track. 18 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Deploying LLM-powered agents in enterprise scenarios such as cloud technical support demands high-quality, domain-specific skills. However, existing skill creators lack domain grounding, producing skills poorly aligned with real-world task requirements. Moreover, once deployed, there is no systematic mechanism to trace execution failures back to skill deficiencies and drive targeted refinements, leaving skill quality stagnant despite accumulating operational evidence. We introduce SkillForge, a self-evolving framework that closes an end-to-end creation-evaluation-refinement loop. To produce well-aligned initial skills, a Domain-Contextualized Skill Creator grounds skill synthesis in knowledge bases and historical support tickets. To enable continuous self-optimization, a three-stage pipeline -- Failure Analyzer, Skill Diagnostician, and Skill Optimizer -- automatically diagnoses execution failures in batch, pinpoints the underlying skill deficiencies, and rewrites the skill to eliminate them. This cycle runs iteratively, allowing skills to self-improve with every round of deployment feedback. Evaluated on five real-world cloud support scenarios spanning 1,883 tickets and 3,737 tasks, experiments show that: (1) the Domain-Contextualized Skill Creator produces substantially better initial skills than the generic skill creator, as measured by consistency with expert-authored reference responses from historical tickets; and (2) the self-evolution loop progressively improves skill quality from diverse starting points (including expert-authored, domain-created, and generic skills) across successive rounds, demonstrating that automated evolution can surpass manually curated expert knowledge.

AI.tldr: SkillForge是一个自进化的LLM技能框架，通过创建-评估-精炼闭环解决企业场景中技能与领域需求不匹配的问题，实现技能质量的持续自我优化。
AI.motivation: 现有技能创建器缺乏领域基础，产生的技能与真实任务需求不匹配；部署后缺乏系统机制将执行失败追溯到技能缺陷并进行针对性改进，导致技能质量停滞不前。
AI.method: SkillForge包含两个核心组件：1) 领域情境化技能创建器，基于知识库和历史支持工单进行技能合成；2) 三阶段自优化管道（失败分析器、技能诊断器、技能优化器），自动诊断批量执行失败、定位底层技能缺陷并重写技能以消除问题。
AI.result: 在5个真实云支持场景（1,883个工单，3,737个任务）的评估显示：1) 领域情境化技能创建器比通用技能创建器产生显著更好的初始技能；2) 自进化循环能从不同起点（专家编写、领域创建、通用技能）逐步提升技能质量，自动进化能超越手动策划的专家知识。
AI.conclusion: SkillForge通过端到端的创建-评估-精炼闭环，实现了LLM技能在企业场景中的持续自我优化，解决了技能与领域需求不匹配以及部署后缺乏系统性改进机制的问题。

title: Drift and selection in LLM text ecosystems
summary: The public text record -- the material from which both people and AI systems now learn -- is increasingly shaped by its own outputs. Generated text enters the public record, later agents learn from it, and the cycle repeats. Here we develop an exactly solvable mathematical framework for this recursive process, based on variable-order $n$-gram agents, and separate two forces acting on the public corpus. The first is drift: unfiltered reuse progressively removes rare forms, and in the infinite-corpus limit we characterise the stable distributions exactly. The second is selection: publication, ranking and verification filter what enters the record, and the outcome depends on what is selected. When publication merely reflects the statistical status quo, the corpus converges to a shallow state in which further lookahead brings no benefit. When publication is normative -- rewarding quality, correctness or novelty -- deeper structure persists, and we establish an optimal upper bound on the resulting divergence from shallow equilibria. The framework therefore identifies when recursive publication compresses public text and when selective filtering sustains richer structure, with implications for the design of AI training corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可精确求解的数学框架，分析生成文本进入公共记录后被后续AI系统学习并再次生成的递归过程，识别漂移和选择两种力量对公共语料库的影响。
AI.motivation: 公共文本记录现在越来越多地由其自身输出塑造：生成的文本进入公共记录，后续智能体从中学习，循环往复。需要理解这种递归过程如何影响公共语料库的结构和质量。
AI.method: 基于变阶n-gram智能体开发可精确求解的数学框架，分离分析两种作用力：漂移（无过滤重用逐渐消除罕见形式）和选择（发布、排名和验证过滤进入记录的内容）。
AI.result: 在无限语料库极限下精确描述了稳定分布。当发布仅反映统计现状时，语料库收敛到浅层状态，进一步前瞻无益；当发布是规范性的（奖励质量、正确性或新颖性）时，深层结构得以保持，并建立了与浅层均衡偏离的最优上界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架识别了递归发布何时压缩公共文本，以及选择性过滤何时维持更丰富的结构，对AI训练语料库设计具有重要启示。

title: GNN-as-Judge: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Graph Learning with GNN Feedback
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) due to their superior semantic understanding ability on textual node features. However, their effectiveness as predictors in the low-resource setting, where labeled nodes are severely limited and scarce, remains constrained since fine-tuning LLMs usually requires sufficient labeled data, especially when the TAG shows complex structural patterns. In essence, this paper targets two key challenges: (i) the difficulty of generating and selecting reliable pseudo labels on TAGs for LLMs, and (ii) the need to mitigate potential label noise when fine-tuning LLMs with pseudo labels. To counter the challenges, we propose a new framework, GNN-as-Judge, which can unleash the power of LLMs for few-shot semi-supervised learning on TAGs by incorporating the structural inductive bias of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Specifically, GNN-as-Judge introduces a collaborative pseudo-labeling strategy that first identifies the most influenced unlabeled nodes from labeled nodes, then exploits both the agreement and disagreement patterns between LLMs and GNNs to generate reliable labels. Furthermore, we develop a weakly-supervised LLM fine-tuning algorithm that can distill the knowledge from informative pseudo labels while mitigating the potential label noise. Experiments on multiple TAG datasets demonstrate that GNN-as-Judge significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in low-resource regimes where labeled data are scarce.

AI.tldr: GNN-as-Judge框架通过结合GNN的结构归纳偏置，解决LLM在低资源文本属性图上的伪标签生成和噪声标签问题，显著提升少样本半监督学习性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在文本属性图上表现出色，但在低资源设置下（标记节点严重受限）效果受限，因为微调LLM通常需要足够的标记数据，特别是当TAG呈现复杂结构模式时。本文针对两个关键挑战：1）为LLM生成和选择可靠伪标签的困难；2）需要减轻使用伪标签微调LLM时的潜在标签噪声。
AI.method: 提出GNN-as-Judge框架，通过结合GNN的结构归纳偏置来释放LLM在TAG上少样本半监督学习的潜力。具体包括：1）协作伪标签策略，首先识别标记节点影响最大的未标记节点，然后利用LLM和GNN之间的一致性和分歧模式生成可靠标签；2）弱监督LLM微调算法，可以从信息丰富的伪标签中提取知识，同时减轻潜在的标签噪声。
AI.result: 在多个TAG数据集上的实验表明，GNN-as-Judge显著优于现有方法，特别是在标记数据稀缺的低资源情况下。
AI.conclusion: GNN-as-Judge通过有效结合LLM的语义理解能力和GNN的结构归纳偏置，成功解决了LLM在低资源文本属性图上的伪标签生成和噪声标签问题，为少样本半监督学习提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Detection of Hate and Threat in Digital Forensics: A Case-Driven Multimodal Approach
summary: Digital forensic investigations increasingly rely on heterogeneous evidence such as images, scanned documents, and contextual reports. These artifacts may contain explicit or implicit expressions of harm, hate, threat, violence, or intimidation, yet existing automated approaches often assume clean text input or apply vision models without forensic justification. This paper presents a case-driven multimodal approach for hate and threat detection in forensic analysis. The proposed framework explicitly determines the presence and source of textual evidence, distinguishing between embedded text, associated contextual text, and image-only evidence. Based on the identified evidence configuration, the framework selectively applies text analysis, multimodal fusion, or image-only semantic reasoning using vision language models with vision transformer backbones (ViT). By conditioning inference on evidence availability, the approach mirrors forensic decision-making, improves evidentiary traceability, and avoids unjustified modality assumptions. Experimental evaluation on forensic-style image evidence demonstrates consistent and interpretable behavior across heterogeneous evidence scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向数字取证的多模态仇恨与威胁检测框架，通过证据配置分析选择性应用文本分析、多模态融合或纯视觉推理，提升取证决策的可追溯性和解释性。
AI.motivation: 数字取证调查中常涉及图像、扫描文档等异构证据，这些证据可能包含仇恨、威胁等有害内容。现有自动化方法通常假设干净的文本输入或未经取证论证地应用视觉模型，无法有效处理取证场景中的证据异质性和来源多样性问题。
AI.method: 提出基于案例驱动的多模态框架：1）明确确定文本证据的存在和来源，区分嵌入式文本、关联上下文文本和纯图像证据；2）根据识别的证据配置，选择性应用文本分析、多模态融合或基于ViT骨干的视觉语言模型的纯图像语义推理；3）基于证据可用性进行条件推理，模拟取证决策过程。
AI.result: 在取证风格图像证据上的实验评估表明，该方法在异构证据场景下表现出一致且可解释的行为，提高了证据可追溯性，避免了不合理的模态假设。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过显式建模证据配置和条件推理，为数字取证中的仇恨与威胁检测提供了更符合实际调查需求的解决方案，增强了自动化分析的可信度和实用性。

title: BracketRank: Large Language Model Document Ranking via Reasoning-based Competitive Elimination
summary: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires deep semantic inference beyond surface-level keyword matching, posing a challenge for current LLM-based rerankers limited by context constraints and order sensitivity. We propose \textbf{\BracketRank}, a framework that treats document reranking as a reasoning-driven competitive tournament. Our approach introduces three key innovations: (1) adaptive grouping based on model context limits, (2) reasoning-enhanced prompts that mandate step-by-step relevance explanations, and (3) a bracket-style elimination structure with winner and loser tracks. This design ensures robust document advancement while enabling parallel processing across competition stages. Evaluation on the BRIGHT reasoning benchmark shows that \BracketRank achieves \textbf{26.56 nDCG@10}, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines including RankGPT-4 (17.0) and Rank-R1-14B (20.5). On TREC datasets, BracketRank achieves 77.90 nDCG@5 on DL 19 and 75.85 nDCG@5 on DL 20, exceeding all baselines, establishing that explicit reasoning within competitive elimination is a powerful paradigm for complex, multi-step retrieval tasks. https://github.com/DataScienceUIBK/BracketRank

AI.tldr: BracketRank是一个将文档重排序视为推理驱动竞赛的框架，通过自适应分组、推理增强提示和淘汰赛结构，在推理密集型检索任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的重排序器在处理推理密集型检索任务时面临上下文限制和顺序敏感性挑战，无法进行深层次语义推理，需要新的方法来解决这些限制。
AI.method: 提出BracketRank框架，包含三个关键创新：1) 基于模型上下文限制的自适应分组；2) 要求逐步相关性解释的推理增强提示；3) 包含胜者和败者赛道的淘汰赛结构，支持并行处理。
AI.result: 在BRIGHT推理基准测试中，BracketRank达到26.56 nDCG@10，显著优于RankGPT-4(17.0)和Rank-R1-14B(20.5)。在TREC数据集上，DL19达到77.90 nDCG@5，DL20达到75.85 nDCG@5，均超过所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 在竞争性淘汰结构中融入显式推理是处理复杂多步检索任务的有效范式，BracketRank通过推理驱动的竞赛框架显著提升了推理密集型检索的性能。

title: Memory-Guided Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization (MG-TuRBO) for High Dimensions
summary: Traffic simulation and digital-twin calibration is a challenging optimization problem with a limited simulation budget. Each trial requires an expensive simulation run, and the relationship between calibration inputs and model error is often nonconvex, and noisy. The problem becomes more difficult as the number of calibration parameters increases. We compare a commonly used automatic calibration method, a genetic algorithm (GA), with Bayesian optimization methods (BOMs): classical Bayesian optimization (BO), Trust-Region BO (TuRBO), Multi-TuRBO, and a proposed Memory-Guided TuRBO (MG-TuRBO) method. We compare performance on 2 real-world traffic simulation calibration problems with 14 and 84 decision variables, representing lower- and higher-dimensional (14D and 84D) settings. For BOMs, we study two acquisition strategies, Thompson sampling and a novel adaptive strategy. We evaluate performance using final calibration quality, convergence behavior, and consistency across runs. The results show that BOMs reach good calibration targets much faster than GA in the lower-D problem. MG-TuRBO performs comparably in our 14D setting, it demonstrates noticeable advantages in the 84D problem, particularly when paired with our adaptive strategy. Our results suggest that MG-TuRBO is especially useful for high-D traffic simulation calibration and potentially for high-D problems in general.

AI.tldr: 比较遗传算法与多种贝叶斯优化方法在交通仿真校准中的性能，提出记忆引导TuRBO方法在高维问题上表现优异
AI.motivation: 交通仿真和数字孪生校准是一个具有有限仿真预算的挑战性优化问题。每个试验都需要昂贵的仿真运行，校准输入与模型误差之间的关系通常是非凸且带有噪声的。随着校准参数数量的增加，问题变得更加困难。
AI.method: 比较遗传算法（GA）与多种贝叶斯优化方法：经典贝叶斯优化（BO）、Trust-Region BO（TuRBO）、Multi-TuRBO和提出的记忆引导TuRBO（MG-TuRBO）。在14维和84维两个真实世界交通仿真校准问题上评估性能，研究两种采集策略：Thompson采样和新的自适应策略。
AI.result: 贝叶斯优化方法在低维问题中比遗传算法更快达到良好校准目标。MG-TuRBO在14维设置中表现相当，在84维问题中显示出明显优势，特别是与自适应策略结合时。
AI.conclusion: MG-TuRBO对于高维交通仿真校准特别有用，可能对一般高维问题也有效。贝叶斯优化方法在有限仿真预算下比遗传算法更高效。

title: A Semi-Automated Framework for 3D Reconstruction of Medieval Manuscript Miniatures
summary: This paper presents a semi-automated framework for transforming two-dimensional miniatures from medieval manuscripts into three-dimensional digital models suitable for extended reality (XR), tactile 3D~printing, and web-based visualization. We evaluate seven image-to-3D methods (TripoSR, SF3D, SPAR3D, TRELLIS, Wonder3D, SAM~3D, Hi3DGen) on 69~manuscript figures from two collections using rendering-based metrics (Silhouette IoU, LPIPS, CLIP~Score) and volumetric measures (Depth Range Ratio, watertight percentage), revealing a trade-off between volumetric expansion and geometric fidelity. Hi3DGen balances topological quality with rich surface detail through its normal bridging approach, making it a good starting point for expert refinement. Our pipeline combines SAM segmentation, Hi3DGen mesh generation, expert refinement in ZBrush, and AI-assisted texturing. Two case studies on Gothic illuminations from the Decretum Gratiani (Vatican Library) and Renaissance miniatures by Giulio Clovio demonstrate applicability across artistic traditions. The resulting models can support WebXR visualization, AR overlay on physical manuscripts, and tactile 3D~prints for visually impaired users.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个半自动化框架，将中世纪手稿中的二维微型画转换为三维数字模型，适用于XR、3D打印和Web可视化，评估了7种图像转3D方法，发现Hi3DGen在拓扑质量和表面细节间取得平衡，并通过两个案例研究验证了框架的适用性。
AI.motivation: 中世纪手稿中的二维微型画具有重要的文化和历史价值，但传统展示方式限制了其可访问性和互动性。需要一种方法将这些二维艺术品转换为三维数字模型，以支持扩展现实(XR)应用、3D打印触觉体验和Web可视化，特别是为视障用户提供触觉访问途径。
AI.method: 1) 评估7种图像转3D方法(TripoSR, SF3D, SPAR3D, TRELLIS, Wonder3D, SAM~3D, Hi3DGen)在69个手稿图像上的表现；2) 使用基于渲染的指标(轮廓IoU, LPIPS, CLIP分数)和体积指标(深度范围比、水密百分比)进行评估；3) 开发包含SAM分割、Hi3DGen网格生成、ZBrush专家细化和AI辅助纹理的完整流程；4) 在两个案例研究(Decretum Gratiani和Giulio Clovio作品)中验证框架。
AI.result: 评估发现图像转3D方法在体积扩展和几何保真度之间存在权衡关系。Hi3DGen通过其法线桥接方法在拓扑质量和丰富表面细节之间取得平衡，是专家细化的良好起点。框架成功应用于哥特式和文艺复兴时期的不同艺术传统，生成的模型支持WebXR可视化、AR叠加和触觉3D打印。
AI.conclusion: 提出的半自动化框架能够有效地将中世纪手稿中的二维微型画转换为高质量的三维数字模型，为文化遗产的可视化、互动和可访问性提供了新的可能性，特别是通过触觉3D打印为视障用户创造了访问途径。Hi3DGen在现有方法中表现最佳，而专家细化环节确保了最终模型的准确性。

title: EMA Is Not All You Need: Mapping the Boundary Between Structure and Content in Recurrent Context
summary: What exactly do efficient sequence models gain over simple temporal averaging? We use exponential moving average (EMA) traces, the simplest recurrent context (no gating, no content-based retrieval), as a controlled probe to map the boundary between what fixed-coefficient accumulation can and cannot represent. EMA traces encode temporal structure: a Hebbian architecture with multi-timescale traces achieves 96% of a supervised BiGRU on grammatical role assignment with zero labels, surpassing the supervised model on structure-dependent roles. EMA traces destroy token identity: a 130M-parameter language model using only EMA context reaches C4 perplexity 260 (8x GPT-2), and a predictor ablation (replacing the linear predictor with full softmax attention) yields identical loss, localizing the entire gap to the traces. The traces apply lossy, data-independent compression; by the data processing inequality, no downstream predictor can recover the discarded information. Fixed-coefficient accumulation, whether across time or depth, suffers irreversible information dilution that only learned, input-dependent selection can resolve.

AI.tldr: EMA traces作为最简单的循环上下文，揭示了固定系数累积在表示能力上的边界：能编码时间结构但破坏token身份信息，存在不可逆的信息稀释问题
AI.motivation: 探究高效序列模型相比简单时间平均的优势，使用EMA迹作为受控探针来界定固定系数累积能表示和不能表示的内容边界
AI.method: 使用指数移动平均迹作为最简单的循环上下文（无门控、无基于内容的检索），构建多时间尺度EMA迹的Hebbian架构，并在语言建模任务中测试EMA-only上下文模型
AI.result: 多时间尺度EMA迹在语法角色分配任务中达到监督BiGRU的96%性能，在结构相关角色上甚至超越监督模型；130M参数EMA-only语言模型在C4数据集上的困惑度为260（GPT-2的8倍）；预测器消融实验显示损失完全由迹引起
AI.conclusion: 固定系数累积（无论是跨时间还是跨深度）存在不可逆的信息稀释问题，只有学习的、输入相关的选择机制才能解决这一问题

title: QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation
comment: 24 pages total, 25 figures, 5 tables, including supplementary material. Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on I Can't Believe It's Not Better
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet quantum code generation is still evaluated mostly within single frameworks, making it difficult to separate quantum reasoning from framework familiarity. We introduce QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, with 42 aligned tasks covering quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation.
  We evaluate models with executable functional tests, report Pass@1 and Pass@5, and use KL-divergence-based acceptance for probabilistic outputs. We additionally study Pass@1 after feedback-based repair, where a model may revise code after a runtime error or wrong answer. Across frameworks, the strongest one-shot scores reach 59.5% in Qiskit, 54.8% in Cirq, and 42.9% in PennyLane; with feedback-based repair, the best scores rise to 83.3%, 76.2%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results show clear progress, but also that reliable multi-framework quantum code generation remains unsolved and still depends strongly on framework-specific knowledge.

AI.tldr: QuanBench+是一个统一的量子代码生成基准测试，涵盖Qiskit、PennyLane和Cirq三个框架，包含42个对齐任务，用于评估大语言模型在量子算法、门分解和态制备方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前量子代码生成评估大多局限于单一框架，难以区分量子推理能力和框架熟悉度，需要统一的跨框架基准测试来准确评估大语言模型的量子代码生成能力。
AI.method: 创建QuanBench+基准测试，包含Qiskit、PennyLane和Cirq三个框架的42个对齐任务；使用可执行功能测试评估模型，报告Pass@1和Pass@5；采用基于KL散度的概率输出接受标准；研究基于反馈的修复后Pass@1，允许模型在运行时错误或错误答案后修订代码。
AI.result: 最强单次生成得分：Qiskit 59.5%、Cirq 54.8%、PennyLane 42.9%；基于反馈修复后最佳得分提升至：Qiskit 83.3%、Cirq 76.2%、PennyLane 66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 研究显示量子代码生成取得明显进展，但可靠的多框架量子代码生成仍未解决，仍然高度依赖框架特定的知识，需要进一步改进。

title: ViSAGE @ NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction
summary: In this report, we present our champion solution for the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction held in conjunction with CVPR 2026. To exploit complementary inductive biases for video saliency, we propose Video Saliency with Adaptive Gated Experts (ViSAGE), a multi-expert ensemble framework. Each specialized decoder performs adaptive gating and modulation to refine spatio-temporal features. The complementary predictions from different experts are then fused at inference. ViSAGE thereby aggregates diverse inductive biases to capture complex spatio-temporal saliency cues in videos. On the Private Test set, ViSAGE ranked first on two out of four evaluation metrics, and outperformed most competing solutions on the other two metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization ability. Our code has been released at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/CVPRW26-ViSAGE.

AI.tldr: ViSAGE在NTIRE 2026视频显著性预测挑战赛中夺冠，采用多专家集成框架，通过自适应门控和调制机制融合不同专家的互补归纳偏置，在测试集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 视频显著性预测需要捕捉复杂的时空线索，单一模型难以充分利用互补的归纳偏置，因此需要设计能够整合多种专家知识的框架来提升预测性能。
AI.method: 提出ViSAGE（Video Saliency with Adaptive Gated Experts）多专家集成框架，每个专家解码器执行自适应门控和调制来细化时空特征，在推理时融合不同专家的互补预测结果。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026挑战赛的Private Test集上，ViSAGE在四个评估指标中的两个排名第一，在其他两个指标上也优于大多数竞争方案，展示了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ViSAGE通过多专家集成框架成功聚合了多样化的归纳偏置，能够有效捕捉视频中复杂的时空显著性线索，在视频显著性预测任务中取得了优异性能。

title: IAT: Instance-As-Token Compression for Historical User Sequence Modeling in Industrial Recommender Systems
summary: Although sophisticated sequence modeling paradigms have achieved remarkable success in recommender systems, the information capacity of hand-crafted sequential features constrains the performance upper bound. To better enhance user experience by encoding historical interaction patterns, this paper presents a novel two-stage sequence modeling framework termed Instance-As-Token (IAT). The first stage of IAT compresses all features of each historical interaction instance into a unified instance embedding, which encodes the interaction characteristics in a compact yet informative token. Both temporal-order and user-order compression schemes are proposed, with the latter better aligning with the demands of downstream sequence modeling. The second stage involves the downstream task fetching fixed-length compressed instance tokens via timestamps and adopting standard sequence modeling approaches to learn long-range preferences patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IAT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits superior in-domain and cross-domain transferability. IAT has been successfully deployed in real-world industrial recommender systems, including e-commerce advertising, shopping mall marketing, and live-streaming e-commerce, delivering substantial improvements in key business metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出Instance-As-Token（IAT）两阶段序列建模框架，通过将历史交互实例压缩为统一实例嵌入，再采用标准序列建模学习长期偏好模式，显著提升推荐系统性能。
AI.motivation: 现有序列建模方法受限于手工设计的序列特征信息容量，限制了性能上限。为更好地编码历史交互模式以提升用户体验，需要更有效的序列表示方法。
AI.method: IAT采用两阶段框架：第一阶段将每个历史交互实例的所有特征压缩为统一的实例嵌入（实例作为令牌），提出时间顺序和用户顺序两种压缩方案；第二阶段通过时间戳获取固定长度的压缩实例令牌，采用标准序列建模方法学习长期偏好模式。
AI.result: IAT显著优于最先进方法，展现出优异的领域内和跨领域可迁移性。已在电商广告、商城营销、直播电商等实际工业推荐系统中成功部署，关键业务指标获得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: IAT框架通过将实例压缩为令牌，有效解决了序列特征信息容量限制问题，为推荐系统序列建模提供了更强大的表示能力，具有实际应用价值。

title: Re-Mask and Redirect: Exploiting Denoising Irreversibility in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences. We show that their safety alignment rests on a single fragile assumption: that the denoising schedule is monotonic and committed tokens are never re-evaluated. Safety-aligned dLLMs commit refusal tokens within the first 8-16 of 64 denoising steps, and the schedule treats these commitments as permanent. A trivial two-step intervention - re-masking these tokens and injecting a 12-token affirmative prefix - achieves 76.1% ASR on HarmBench (n=159, Lg=128) against LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 81.8% ASR (n=159) against Dream-7B-Instruct, without any gradient computation or adversarial search. The simplicity of this exploit is itself the central finding: augmenting with gradient-optimized perturbation via a differentiable Gumbel-softmax chain consistently degrades ASR (e.g., 41.5% vs. 76.1% at Lg=128), confirming that the vulnerability is structural rather than requiring sophisticated exploitation. These findings reveal that dLLM safety is not adversarially robust but architecturally shallow - it holds only because the denoising schedule is never violated. We discuss defenses including safety-aware unmasking schedules, step-conditional prefix detection, and post-commitment re-verification.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型的安全对齐依赖于单调去噪调度的脆弱假设，通过简单的重新掩码和肯定前缀注入即可实现高攻击成功率，无需梯度计算或对抗搜索。
AI.motivation: 研究扩散语言模型安全对齐的鲁棒性，揭示其依赖于单调去噪调度的脆弱假设，这种假设在现实攻击场景中可能被轻易绕过。
AI.method: 提出两步干预攻击：1) 重新掩码已承诺的拒绝令牌；2) 注入12个令牌的肯定前缀。在HarmBench上测试LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct，并与基于梯度的Gumbel-softmax链优化攻击进行对比。
AI.result: 简单攻击在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上达到76.1%攻击成功率（n=159, Lg=128），在Dream-7B-Instruct上达到81.8%。基于梯度的优化攻击反而降低成功率（41.5% vs 76.1%），证明漏洞是结构性的而非需要复杂利用。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型的安全对齐缺乏对抗鲁棒性，仅因去噪调度未被违反而表面有效。需要安全感知的去掩码调度、步骤条件前缀检测和承诺后重新验证等防御机制。

title: Robust Reasoning Benchmark
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high performance on standard mathematical benchmarks, their underlying reasoning processes remain highly overfit to standard textual formatting. We propose a perturbation pipeline consisting of 14 techniques to evaluate robustness of LLM reasoning. We apply this pipeline to AIME 2024 dataset and evalute 8 state-of-the-art models on the resulting benchmark. While frontier models exhibit resilience, open weights reasoning models suffer catastrophic collapses (up to 55% average accuracy drops across perturbations and up to 100% on some), exposing structural fragility. To further disentangle mechanical parsing failures from downstream reasoning failures, we strictly isolate the models' working memory capacity by forcing models to solve multiple unperturbed mathematical problems sequentially within a single context window. Our results indicate that open weight models ranging from 7B to 120B parameters and Claude Opus 4.6 exhibit accuracy decay on subsequent problems. This degradation demonstrates that intermediate reasoning steps permanently pollute standard dense attention mechanisms. We argue that to achieve reliable reasoning, future reasoning architectures must integrate explicit contextual resets within a model's own Chain-of-Thought, leading to fundamental open questions regarding the optimal granularity of atomic reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出14种扰动技术评估LLM数学推理鲁棒性，发现前沿模型较稳健但开源模型在扰动下性能严重下降，并揭示密集注意力机制中推理步骤会永久污染工作记忆
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在标准数学基准上表现优异，但其推理过程严重过拟合于标准文本格式，需要评估真实推理鲁棒性而非表面格式匹配
AI.method: 提出包含14种技术的扰动流水线评估LLM推理鲁棒性；使用AIME 2024数据集创建基准；通过强制模型在单一上下文窗口中顺序解决多个未扰动问题来隔离工作记忆容量
AI.result: 前沿模型展现韧性，但开源推理模型在扰动下遭受灾难性崩溃（平均准确率下降达55%，某些扰动下100%）；7B到120B参数的开源模型及Claude Opus 4.6在后续问题上显示准确率衰减，表明中间推理步骤永久污染标准密集注意力机制
AI.conclusion: 为实现可靠推理，未来推理架构必须在模型自身思维链中集成显式上下文重置，这引发了关于原子推理任务最优粒度的基础开放性问题

title: MARINER: A 3E-Driven Benchmark for Fine-Grained Perception and Complex Reasoning in Open-Water Environments
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding and high-level reasoning in real-world open-water environments remain under-explored due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks. We introduce MARINER, a comprehensive benchmark built under the novel Entity-Environment-Event (3E) paradigm. MARINER contains 16,629 multi-source maritime images with 63 fine-grained vessel categories, diverse adverse environments, and 5 typical dynamic maritime incidents, covering fine-grained classification, object detection, and visual question answering tasks. We conduct extensive evaluations on mainstream Multimodal Large language models (MLLMs) and establish baselines, revealing that even advanced models struggle with fine-grained discrimination and causal reasoning in complex marine scenes. As a dedicated maritime benchmark, MARINER fills the gap of realistic and cognitive-level evaluation for maritime multimodal understanding, and promotes future research on robust vision-language models for open-water applications. Appendix and supplementary materials are available at https://lxixim.github.io/MARINER.

AI.tldr: MARINER是一个基于实体-环境-事件（3E）范式的海事多模态基准，包含16,629张多源海事图像，涵盖63个细粒度船舶类别、多样化恶劣环境和5种典型动态海事事件，支持细粒度分类、目标检测和视觉问答任务。
AI.motivation: 现实世界开放水域环境中的细粒度视觉理解和高级推理研究不足，缺乏专门的基准测试。现有基准无法充分评估海事场景中的复杂认知能力。
AI.method: 提出实体-环境-事件（3E）范式构建MARINER基准，包含16,629张多源海事图像，涵盖63个细粒度船舶类别、多样化恶劣环境和5种典型动态海事事件。基准支持细粒度分类、目标检测和视觉问答任务。
AI.result: 对主流多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行广泛评估并建立基线，发现即使是先进模型在复杂海洋场景中的细粒度区分和因果推理方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: MARINER作为专门的海事基准，填补了海事多模态理解中现实性和认知级评估的空白，促进了开放水域应用中鲁棒视觉语言模型的未来研究。

title: Regime-Conditional Retrieval: Theory and a Transferable Router for Two-Hop QA
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Theory and empirical validation of regime-conditional multi-hop retrieval routing
summary: Two-hop QA retrieval splits queries into two regimes determined by whether the hop-2 entity is explicitly named in the question (Q-dominant) or only in the bridge passage (B-dominant). We formalize this split with three theorems: (T1) per-query AUC is a monotone function of the cosine separation margin, with R^2 >= 0.90 for six of eight type-encoder pairs; (T2) regime is characterized by two surface-text predicates, with P1 decisive for routing and P2 qualifying the B-dominant case, holding across three encoders and three datasets; and (T3) bridge advantage requires the relation-bearing sentence, not entity name alone, with removal causing an 8.6-14.1 pp performance drop (p < 0.001). Building on this theory, we propose RegimeRouter, a lightweight binary router that selects between question-only and question-plus-relation-sentence retrieval using five text features derived directly from the predicate definitions. Trained on 2WikiMultiHopQA (n = 881, 5-fold cross-fitted) and applied zero-shot to MuSiQue and HotpotQA, RegimeRouter achieves +5.6 pp (p < 0.001), +5.3 pp (p = 0.002), and +1.1 pp (non-significant, no-regret) R@5 improvement, respectively, with artifact-driven.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两跳QA检索的两种机制划分(Q-dominant和B-dominant)，通过三个定理形式化该划分，并基于此开发RegimeRouter轻量级路由器，在多个数据集上实现显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有两跳QA检索方法未区分查询中第二跳实体的显式命名情况，导致检索效率受限。需要形式化分析不同机制的特征，并设计能根据查询特性自适应选择检索策略的路由器。
AI.method: 1) 形式化分析：提出三个定理描述两跳检索机制；2) 路由器设计：基于表面文本谓词定义五个文本特征，构建RegimeRouter轻量级二进制路由器；3) 训练评估：在2WikiMultiHopQA上训练，零样本应用于MuSiQue和HotpotQA。
AI.result: 1) 定理验证：T1显示AUC与余弦分离边际单调相关(R²≥0.90)；T2显示机制特征跨编码器和数据集一致；T3显示桥接优势需要关系承载句而非实体名；2) RegimeRouter在三个数据集上分别实现+5.6pp、+5.3pp和+1.1pp的R@5提升，统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 两跳QA检索的机制划分具有理论基础，基于表面文本特征的轻量级路由器能有效选择检索策略，显著提升多跳QA性能，为复杂QA系统设计提供了理论指导和实用工具。

title: WAND: Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Autoregressive Text-to-Speech Models
summary: Recent decoder-only autoregressive text-to-speech (AR-TTS) models produce high-fidelity speech, but their memory and compute costs scale quadratically with sequence length due to full self-attention. In this paper, we propose WAND, Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation, a framework that adapts pretrained AR-TTS models to operate with constant computational and memory complexity. WAND separates the attention mechanism into two: persistent global attention over conditioning tokens and local sliding-window attention over generated tokens. To stabilize fine-tuning, we employ a curriculum learning strategy that progressively tightens the attention window. We further utilize knowledge distillation from a full-attention teacher to recover high-fidelity synthesis quality with high data efficiency. Evaluated on three modern AR-TTS models, WAND preserves the original quality while achieving up to 66.2% KV cache memory reduction and length-invariant, near-constant per-step latency.

AI.tldr: WAND框架通过窗口化注意力与知识蒸馏，将自回归TTS模型的计算和内存复杂度从二次降低到常数级，同时保持合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归TTS模型虽然能生成高质量语音，但其全自注意力机制导致计算和内存成本随序列长度呈二次方增长，限制了实际应用效率。
AI.method: 提出WAND框架：1) 将注意力机制分离为条件token的持久全局注意力和生成token的局部滑动窗口注意力；2) 采用课程学习策略逐步收紧注意力窗口以稳定微调；3) 利用全注意力教师模型进行知识蒸馏以高效恢复高质量合成。
AI.result: 在三个现代AR-TTS模型上评估，WAND保持了原始质量，同时实现了高达66.2%的KV缓存内存减少，以及长度不变、接近常数的每步延迟。
AI.conclusion: WAND框架成功将预训练AR-TTS模型的计算和内存复杂度降低到常数级，为高质量语音合成提供了更高效实用的解决方案。

title: Ranked Activation Shift for Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: State-of-the-art post-hoc out-of-distribution detection methods rely on intermediate layer activation editing. However, they exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets and models. We show that this instability is driven by differences in the activation distributions, and identify a failure mode of scaling-based methods that arises when penultimate layer activations are not rectified. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \ours, a hyperparameter-free post-hoc method that replaces sorted activation magnitudes with a fixed in-distribution reference profile. Our simple plug-and-play method shows strong and consistent performance across datasets and architectures without assumptions on the penultimate layer activation function, and without requiring any hyperparameter tuning, while preserving in-distribution classification accuracy by construction. We further analyze what drives the improvement, showing that both inhibiting and exciting activation shifts independently contribute to better out-of-distribution discrimination.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需超参数调整的后处理OOD检测方法，通过固定参考分布替换排序激活幅度，在多种数据集和架构上表现稳定
AI.motivation: 现有后处理OOD检测方法依赖中间层激活编辑，但在不同数据集和模型上表现不稳定。研究发现这种不稳定性源于激活分布的差异，并识别出基于缩放的方法在未修正的倒数第二层激活时出现的失效模式
AI.method: 提出一种超参数自由的后处理方法，用固定的分布内参考分布替换排序的激活幅度。这是一种即插即用的方法，无需对倒数第二层激活函数做假设，也不需要超参数调优，同时通过构造保持分布内分类精度
AI.result: 该方法在多种数据集和架构上表现出强大且一致的性能，无需超参数调优。分析表明，抑制和兴奋激活偏移都独立地有助于更好的OOD判别
AI.conclusion: 通过固定参考分布替换排序激活幅度的超参数自由方法，解决了现有OOD检测方法在不同数据集和模型上的不稳定性问题，同时保持分布内分类精度

title: WildDet3D: Scaling Promptable 3D Detection in the Wild
summary: Understanding objects in 3D from a single image is a cornerstone of spatial intelligence. A key step toward this goal is monocular 3D object detection--recovering the extent, location, and orientation of objects from an input RGB image. To be practical in the open world, such a detector must generalize beyond closed-set categories, support diverse prompt modalities, and leverage geometric cues when available. Progress is hampered by two bottlenecks: existing methods are designed for a single prompt type and lack a mechanism to incorporate additional geometric cues, and current 3D datasets cover only narrow categories in controlled environments, limiting open-world transfer. In this work we address both gaps. First, we introduce WildDet3D, a unified geometry-aware architecture that natively accepts text, point, and box prompts and can incorporate auxiliary depth signals at inference time. Second, we present WildDet3D-Data, the largest open 3D detection dataset to date, constructed by generating candidate 3D boxes from existing 2D annotations and retaining only human-verified ones, yielding over 1M images across 13.5K categories in diverse real-world scenes. WildDet3D establishes a new state-of-the-art across multiple benchmarks and settings. In the open-world setting, it achieves 22.6/24.8 AP3D on our newly introduced WildDet3D-Bench with text and box prompts. On Omni3D, it reaches 34.2/36.4 AP3D with text and box prompts, respectively. In zero-shot evaluation, it achieves 40.3/48.9 ODS on Argoverse 2 and ScanNet. Notably, incorporating depth cues at inference time yields substantial additional gains (+20.7 AP on average across settings).

AI.tldr: WildDet3D提出了一种统一的几何感知架构，支持文本、点和框提示，并能融合深度信号，同时构建了最大的开放3D检测数据集WildDet3D-Data，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 单目3D目标检测在开放世界应用中面临两个瓶颈：现有方法仅支持单一提示类型且缺乏融合几何线索的机制，以及当前3D数据集类别有限、环境受限，限制了开放世界泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出WildDet3D统一架构，原生支持文本、点和框三种提示模态，可在推理时融合辅助深度信号；同时构建WildDet3D-Data数据集，通过2D标注生成候选3D框并人工验证，包含130万图像和1.35万类别。
AI.result: 在开放世界设置下，WildDet3D-Bench基准上文本/框提示分别达到22.6/24.8 AP3D；Omni3D上达到34.2/36.4 AP3D；零样本评估在Argoverse 2和ScanNet上达到40.3/48.9 ODS；融合深度线索平均提升20.7 AP。
AI.conclusion: WildDet3D解决了单目3D检测在开放世界应用中的关键瓶颈，通过统一的多提示架构和大规模数据集实现了显著的性能提升，深度融合进一步增强了检测能力。

title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation
summary: General recommender systems deliver personalized services by learning user and item representations, with the central challenge being how to capture latent user preferences. However, representations derived from sparse interactions often fail to comprehensively characterize user behaviors, thereby limiting recommendation effectiveness. Recent studies attempt to enhance user representations through sophisticated modeling strategies ($e.g.,$ intent or language modeling). Nevertheless, most works primarily concentrate on model interpretability instead of representation optimization. This imbalance has led to limited progress, as representation optimization is crucial for recommendation quality by promoting the affinity between users and their interacted items in the feature space, yet remains largely overlooked. To overcome these limitations, we propose DIAURec, a novel representation learning framework that unifies intent and language modeling for recommendation. DIAURec reconstructs representations based on the prototype and distribution intent spaces formed by collaborative and language signals. Furthermore, we design a comprehensive representation optimization strategy. Specifically, we adopts alignment and uniformity as the primary optimization objectives, and incorporates both coarse- and fine-grained matching to achieve effective alignment across different spaces, thereby enhancing representational consistency. Additionally, we further introduce intra-space and interaction regularization to enhance model robustness and prevent representation collapse in reconstructed space representation. Experiments on three public datasets against fifteen baseline methods show that DIAURec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, fully validating its effectiveness and superiority.

AI.tldr: DIAURec是一个新颖的表示学习框架，通过统一意图建模和语言建模来优化用户表示，采用对齐和均匀性作为主要优化目标，结合粗粒度和细粒度匹配，在三个公开数据集上超越15个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统从稀疏交互中学习到的用户表示往往无法全面表征用户行为，限制了推荐效果。虽然近期研究尝试通过意图或语言建模增强用户表示，但大多关注模型可解释性而非表示优化，而表示优化对于提升用户与交互物品在特征空间中的亲和力至关重要，这一关键问题被长期忽视。
AI.method: 提出DIAURec框架，统一意图建模和语言建模进行推荐。基于协作信号和语言信号形成的原型和分布意图空间重建表示。设计全面的表示优化策略：采用对齐和均匀性作为主要优化目标，结合粗粒度和细粒度匹配实现不同空间的有效对齐；引入空间内正则化和交互正则化增强模型鲁棒性，防止重建空间表示崩溃。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上对15个基线方法的实验表明，DIAURec始终优于最先进的基线方法，充分验证了其有效性和优越性。
AI.conclusion: DIAURec通过统一意图和语言建模，结合全面的表示优化策略，成功解决了现有推荐系统中用户表示不全面的问题，显著提升了推荐质量，为表示优化在推荐系统中的重要性提供了有力证据。

title: Medical Reasoning with Large Language Models: A Survey and MR-Bench
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on medical exam-style tasks, motivating growing interest in their deployment in real-world clinical settings. However, clinical decision-making is inherently safety-critical, context-dependent, and conducted under evolving evidence. In such situations, reliable LLM performance depends not on factual recall alone, but on robust medical reasoning. In this work, we present a comprehensive review of medical reasoning with LLMs. Grounded in cognitive theories of clinical reasoning, we conceptualize medical reasoning as an iterative process of abduction, deduction, and induction, and organize existing methods into seven major technical routes spanning training-based and training-free approaches. We further conduct a unified cross-benchmark evaluation of representative medical reasoning models under a consistent experimental setting, enabling a more systematic and comparable assessment of the empirical impact of existing methods. To better assess clinically grounded reasoning, we introduce MR-Bench, a benchmark derived from real-world hospital data. Evaluations on MR-Bench expose a pronounced gap between exam-level performance and accuracy on authentic clinical decision tasks. Overall, this survey provides a unified view of existing medical reasoning methods, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and highlights key gaps between current model performance and the requirements of real-world clinical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文对大型语言模型在医学推理领域的研究进行了全面综述，提出了基于认知理论的医学推理框架，组织了七种技术路线，并引入真实医院数据构建的MR-Bench基准，揭示了考试表现与临床决策准确性之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医学考试任务上表现出色，但在真实临床环境中部署面临挑战。临床决策具有安全性关键、情境依赖和证据动态更新的特点，需要稳健的医学推理能力而非单纯的事实回忆。当前缺乏对医学推理方法的系统梳理和评估。
AI.method: 基于临床推理的认知理论，将医学推理概念化为溯因、演绎和归纳的迭代过程。将现有方法组织为七种主要技术路线，涵盖基于训练和无训练方法。在统一实验设置下对代表性模型进行跨基准评估，并引入基于真实医院数据的MR-Bench基准来评估临床推理能力。
AI.result: 系统评估揭示了现有医学推理方法的性能差异。MR-Bench上的评估显示，模型在考试任务上的表现与真实临床决策任务的准确性之间存在显著差距，表明当前模型性能尚未满足真实世界临床推理的要求。
AI.conclusion: 该综述提供了医学推理方法、基准和评估实践的统一视图，强调了当前模型性能与真实世界临床推理要求之间的关键差距，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: On Semiotic-Grounded Interpretive Evaluation of Generative Art
summary: Interpretation is essential to deciphering the language of art: audiences communicate with artists by recovering meaning from visual artifacts. However, current Generative Art (GenArt) evaluators remain fixated on surface-level image quality or literal prompt adherence, failing to assess the deeper symbolic or abstract meaning intended by the creator. We address this gap by formalizing a Peircean computational semiotic theory that models Human-GenArt Interaction (HGI) as cascaded semiosis. This framework reveals that artistic meaning is conveyed through three modes - iconic, symbolic, and indexical - yet existing evaluators operate heavily within the iconic mode, remaining structurally blind to the latter two. To overcome this structural blindness, we propose SemJudge. This evaluator explicitly assesses symbolic and indexical meaning in HGI via a Hierarchical Semiosis Graph (HSG) that reconstructs the meaning-making process from prompt to generated artifact. Extensive quantitative experiments show that SemJudge aligns more closely with human judgments than prior evaluators on an interpretation-intensive fine-art benchmark. User studies further demonstrate that SemJudge produces deeper, more insightful artistic interpretations, thereby paving the way for GenArt to move beyond the generation of "pretty" images toward a medium capable of expressing complex human experience. Project page: https://github.com/songrise/SemJudge.

AI.tldr: 提出SemJudge评估器，基于皮尔斯符号学理论评估生成艺术中的深层符号和索引意义，超越传统仅关注图像质量或提示符匹配的表面评估
AI.motivation: 当前生成艺术评估器只关注表面图像质量或字面提示符匹配，无法评估创作者意图的深层符号或抽象意义，需要新的评估框架来捕捉艺术表达的复杂性
AI.method: 形式化皮尔斯计算符号学理论，将人-生成艺术交互建模为级联符号过程，提出SemJudge评估器，使用分层符号图从提示到生成物重建意义创造过程
AI.result: 定量实验显示SemJudge在解释密集型艺术基准上比先前评估器更接近人类判断，用户研究表明SemJudge能产生更深层、更有洞察力的艺术解释
AI.conclusion: SemJudge通过评估符号和索引意义，使生成艺术从仅生成"漂亮"图像转向能够表达复杂人类经验的媒介，为生成艺术评估提供了新的理论框架

title: Hybrid Cold-Start Recommender System for Closure Model Selection in Multiphase Flow Simulations
summary: Selecting appropriate physical models is a critical yet difficult step in many areas of computational science and engineering. In multiphase Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), practitioners must choose among numerous closure model combinations whose performance varies strongly across flow conditions. Sub-optimal choices can lead to inaccurate predictions, simulation failures, and wasted computational resources, making model selection a prime candidate for data-driven decision support. This work formulates closure model selection as a cold-start recommender system problem in a high-cost scientific domain. We propose a hybrid recommendation framework that combines (i) metadata-driven case similarity and (ii) collaborative inference via matrix completion. The approach enables case-specific model recommendations for entirely new CFD cases using their descriptive features, while leveraging historical simulation results from similar cases. The methodology is evaluated on 13,600 simulations across 136 validation cases and 100 model combinations. A nested cross-validation protocol with experiment-level holdout is employed to rigorously assess generalisation to unseen flow scenarios under varying levels of data sparsity. Recommendation quality is measured using ranking-based metrics and a domain-specific regret measure capturing performance loss relative to the per-case optimum. Results show that the proposed hybrid recommender consistently outperforms popularity-based and expert-designed reference models and reduces regret across the investigated sparsities. These findings demonstrate that recommender system methodology can effectively support complex scientific decision-making tasks characterised by expensive evaluations, structured metadata, and limited prior observations.

AI.tldr: 该研究将多相CFD中的闭合模型选择问题构建为冷启动推荐系统，提出结合元数据相似性和矩阵补全的混合推荐框架，在13,600个模拟上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多相计算流体动力学中，闭合模型的选择对预测精度至关重要但非常困难。现有模型组合众多且性能随流动条件变化显著，不当选择会导致预测不准确、模拟失败和计算资源浪费，因此需要数据驱动的决策支持。
AI.method: 提出混合推荐框架：1) 基于元数据的案例相似性分析；2) 通过矩阵补全进行协同推断。该方法利用案例描述特征为新CFD案例提供特定推荐，同时利用历史相似案例的模拟结果。采用嵌套交叉验证协议和实验级保留来严格评估不同数据稀疏度下对新流动场景的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在136个验证案例和100个模型组合的13,600个模拟上评估。使用基于排名的指标和特定领域的遗憾度量（相对于每个案例最优模型的性能损失）来衡量推荐质量。结果表明，所提出的混合推荐器在研究的各种稀疏度下始终优于基于流行度和专家设计的参考模型，并减少了遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 推荐系统方法学可以有效支持具有昂贵评估、结构化元数据和有限先验观测特征的复杂科学决策任务。该工作为高成本科学领域中的模型选择问题提供了实用的数据驱动解决方案。

title: Uncertainty Estimation for the Open-Set Text Classification systems
summary:
Accurate uncertainty estimation is essential for building robust and trustworthy recognition systems. In this paper, we consider the open-set text classification (OSTC) task - and uncertainty estimation for it. For OSTC a text sample should be classified as one of the existing classes or rejected as unknown. To account for the different uncertainty types encountered in OSTC, we adapt the Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) method for the text domain. Our approach addresses two major causes of prediction errors in text recognition systems: text uncertainty that stems from ill formulated queries and gallery uncertainty that is related the ambiguity of data distribution.
  By capturing these sources, it becomes possible to predict when the system will make a recognition error. We propose a new OSTC benchmark and conduct extensive experiments on a wide range of data, utilizing the authorship attribution, intent and topic classification datasets. HolUE achieves 40-365% improvement in Prediction Rejection Ratio (PRR) over the quality-based SCF baseline across datasets: 365% on Yahoo Answers (0.79 vs 0.17 at FPIR 0.1), 347% on DBPedia (0.85 vs 0.19), 240% on PAN authorship attribution (0.51 vs 0.15 at FPIR 0.5), and 40% on CLINC150 intent classification (0.73 vs~0.52). We make public our code and protocols https://github.com/Leonid-Erlygin/text_uncertainty.git

AI.tldr: 将Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE)方法应用于文本领域，解决开放集文本分类中的不确定性估计问题，通过捕获文本不确定性和图库不确定性来预测识别错误，在多个数据集上显著提升预测拒绝率。
AI.motivation: 开放集文本分类需要准确的不确定性估计来构建鲁棒可信的识别系统。现有方法未能充分考虑文本识别系统中的两种主要错误来源：文本不确定性（查询表述不当）和图库不确定性（数据分布模糊性）。
AI.method: 将Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE)方法适配到文本领域，同时处理文本不确定性和图库不确定性。文本不确定性源于查询表述质量，图库不确定性源于数据分布的模糊性。通过捕获这两种不确定性来源来预测系统何时会出现识别错误。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上显著优于基于质量的SCF基线方法：Yahoo Answers数据集上PRR提升365%（0.79 vs 0.17 @ FPIR 0.1），DBPedia提升347%（0.85 vs 0.19），PAN作者归属提升240%（0.51 vs 0.15 @ FPIR 0.5），CLINC150意图分类提升40%（0.73 vs 0.52）。
AI.conclusion: HolUE方法能有效处理开放集文本分类中的不确定性估计问题，通过同时考虑文本不确定性和图库不确定性，显著提升了预测拒绝性能，为构建更鲁棒的文本识别系统提供了有效解决方案。

title: Distilling Genomic Models for Efficient mRNA Representation Learning via Embedding Matching
comment: Accepted at the Tiny Papers Track for the Machine Learning for Genomics Explorations Workshop at ICLR 2026 an the Gen2 Workshop at ICLR 2026
summary: Large Genomic Foundation Models have recently achieved remarkable results and in-vivo translation capabilities. However these models quickly grow to over a few Billion of parameters and are expensive to run when compute is limited. To overcome this challenge, we present a distillation framework for transferring mRNA representations from a state of the art genomic foundation model into a much smaller model specialized for mRNA sequences, reducing the size by 200-fold. Embedding-level distillation worked better than logit based methods, which we found unstable. Benchmarking on mRNA-bench demonstrates that the distilled model achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable size and competes with larger architectures for mRNA-related tasks. Our results highlight embedding-based distillation of mRNA sequences as an effective training strategy for biological foundation models. This enables similar efficient and scalable sequence modelling in genomics, particularly when large models are computationally challenging or infeasible.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于mRNA序列的蒸馏框架，将大型基因组基础模型的知识转移到小200倍的专用模型中，在计算受限时实现高效序列建模
AI.motivation: 大型基因组基础模型虽然性能优异但参数量巨大（数十亿），在计算资源有限时运行成本高昂，需要开发更高效的模型
AI.method: 采用嵌入级蒸馏框架，将最先进基因组基础模型的mRNA表示转移到专门针对mRNA序列的小型模型中，发现嵌入级蒸馏比基于logit的方法更稳定有效
AI.result: 在mRNA-bench基准测试中，蒸馏模型在同等规模模型中达到最先进性能，并能与更大架构竞争mRNA相关任务，模型大小减少200倍
AI.conclusion: 基于嵌入的mRNA序列蒸馏是生物基础模型的有效训练策略，为计算受限场景下的基因组高效可扩展序列建模提供了解决方案

title: 3D-VCD: Hallucination Mitigation in 3D-LLM Embodied Agents through Visual Contrastive Decoding
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Large multimodal models are increasingly used as the reasoning core of embodied agents operating in 3D environments, yet they remain prone to hallucinations that can produce unsafe and ungrounded decisions. Existing inference-time hallucination mitigation methods largely target 2D vision-language settings and do not transfer to embodied 3D reasoning, where failures arise from object presence, spatial layout, and geometric grounding rather than pixel-level inconsistencies. We introduce 3D-VCD, the first inference-time visual contrastive decoding framework for hallucination mitigation in 3D embodied agents. 3D-VCD constructs a distorted 3D scene graph by applying semantic and geometric perturbations to object-centric representations, such as category substitutions and coordinate or extent corruption. By contrasting predictions under the original and distorted 3D contexts, our method suppresses tokens that are insensitive to grounded scene evidence and are therefore likely driven by language priors. We evaluate 3D-VCD on the 3D-POPE and HEAL benchmarks and show that it consistently improves grounded reasoning without any retraining, establishing inference-time contrastive decoding over structured 3D representations as an effective and practical route to more reliable embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 3D-VCD：首个用于3D具身智能体幻觉缓解的推理时视觉对比解码框架，通过对比原始和扭曲3D场景图的预测来抑制基于语言先验的不可靠决策。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型作为3D环境中具身智能体的推理核心时，容易产生幻觉导致不安全和不接地的决策。现有推理时幻觉缓解方法主要针对2D视觉语言设置，无法迁移到具身3D推理，因为失败源于物体存在性、空间布局和几何接地问题而非像素级不一致。
AI.method: 提出3D-VCD框架，通过对以物体为中心的表示（如类别替换、坐标或范围破坏）应用语义和几何扰动来构建扭曲的3D场景图。通过对比原始和扭曲3D上下文下的预测，抑制对场景证据不敏感、可能由语言先验驱动的token。
AI.result: 在3D-POPE和HEAL基准测试中，3D-VCD无需重新训练即可持续改进接地推理，证明基于结构化3D表示的推理时对比解码是提高具身智能可靠性的有效实用途径。
AI.conclusion: 3D-VCD建立了在结构化3D表示上进行推理时对比解码作为实现更可靠具身智能的有效方法，能够缓解3D具身智能体中的幻觉问题。

title: On the Representational Limits of Quantum-Inspired 1024-D Document Embeddings: An Experimental Evaluation Framework
summary:
Text embeddings are central to modern information retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). While dense models derived from Large Language Models (LLMs) dominate current practice, recent work has explored quantum-inspired alternatives motivated by the geometric properties of Hilbert-like spaces and their potential to encode richer semantic structure.
  This paper presents an experimental framework for constructing quantum-inspired 1024-dimensional document embeddings based on overlapping windows and multi-scale aggregation. The pipeline combines semantic projections (e.g., EigAngle), circuit-inspired feature mappings, and optional teacher-student distillation, together with a fingerprinting mechanism for reproducibility and controlled evaluation.
  We introduce a set of diagnostic tools for hybrid retrieval, including static and dynamic interpolation between BM25 and embedding-based scores, candidate union strategies, and a conceptual alpha-oracle that provides an upper bound for score-level fusion.
  Experiments on controlled corpora of Italian and English documents across technical, narrative, and legal domains, using synthetic queries, show that BM25 remains a strong baseline, teacher embeddings provide stable semantic structure, and standalone quantum-inspired embeddings exhibit weak and unstable ranking signals. Distillation yields mixed effects, improving alignment in some cases but not consistently enhancing retrieval performance, while hybrid retrieval can recover competitive results when lexical and embedding-based signals are combined.
  Overall, the results highlight structural limitations in the geometry of quantum-inspired embeddings, including distance compression and ranking instability, and clarify their role as auxiliary components rather than standalone retrieval representations.

AI.tldr: 量子启发式1024维文档嵌入在检索任务中表现不佳，BM25仍是强基线，量子嵌入仅适合作为辅助组件而非独立检索表示
AI.motivation: 探索量子启发的嵌入方法，利用希尔伯特空间的几何特性编码更丰富的语义结构，作为传统密集嵌入模型的替代方案
AI.method: 构建量子启发的1024维文档嵌入框架，基于重叠窗口和多尺度聚合，结合语义投影、电路启发特征映射、师生蒸馏，以及用于可重复性的指纹机制
AI.result: BM25保持强基线性能，量子启发嵌入表现出弱且不稳定的排序信号，蒸馏效果混合，混合检索结合词法和嵌入信号可获得竞争性结果
AI.conclusion: 量子启发嵌入存在几何结构限制（距离压缩和排序不稳定性），更适合作为辅助组件而非独立检索表示

title: A Representation-Level Assessment of Bias Mitigation in Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2025 (5th Workshop on Bias and Fairness in AI)
summary: We investigate how successful bias mitigation reshapes the embedding space of encoder-only and decoder-only foundation models, offering an internal audit of model behaviour through representational analysis. Using BERT and Llama2 as representative architectures, we assess the shifts in associations between gender and occupation terms by comparing baseline and bias-mitigated variants of the models. Our findings show that bias mitigation reduces gender-occupation disparities in the embedding space, leading to more neutral and balanced internal representations. These representational shifts are consistent across both model types, suggesting that fairness improvements can manifest as interpretable and geometric transformations. These results position embedding analysis as a valuable tool for understanding and validating the effectiveness of debiasing methods in foundation models. To further promote the assessment of decoder-only models, we introduce WinoDec, a dataset consisting of 4,000 sequences with gender and occupation terms, and release it to the general public. (https://github.com/winodec/wino-dec)

AI.tldr: 该研究通过表征分析探讨了偏见缓解如何重塑编码器-解码器基础模型的嵌入空间，使用BERT和Llama2评估性别-职业关联变化，发现偏见缓解能减少嵌入空间中的性别-职业差异，并引入WinoDec数据集促进解码器模型评估。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过表征分析理解偏见缓解如何改变基础模型的内部表示，为模型行为提供内部审计，并验证去偏见方法的有效性。
AI.method: 使用BERT（编码器）和Llama2（解码器）作为代表性架构，比较基线模型和偏见缓解变体在性别-职业术语关联上的变化，通过嵌入空间分析评估表征偏移。
AI.result: 偏见缓解显著减少了嵌入空间中性别-职业的差异，产生了更中立、平衡的内部表示；这种表征偏移在两种模型类型中表现一致，表明公平性改进可表现为可解释的几何变换。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入分析是理解和验证基础模型去偏见方法有效性的重要工具；研究引入的WinoDec数据集（4000个包含性别和职业术语的序列）将促进解码器模型的评估。

title: MolPaQ: Modular Quantum-Classical Patch Learning for Interpretable Molecular Generation
summary: Molecular generative models must jointly ensure validity, diversity, and property control, yet existing approaches typically trade off among these objectives. We present MOLPAQ, a modular quantum-classical generator that assembles molecules from quantum-generated latent patches. A \b{eta}-VAE pretrained on QM9 learns a chemically aligned latent manifold; a reduced conditioner maps molecular descriptors into this space; and a parameter-efficient quantum patch generator produces entangled node embeddings that a valence-aware aggregator reconstructs into valid molecular graphs. Adversarial fine-tuning with a latent critic and chemistry-shaped reward yields 100\% RDKit validity, 99.75\% novelty, and 0.905 diversity. Beyond aggregate metrics, the pretrained quantum generator, steered by the conditioner, improves mean QED by approx. 2.3\% and increases aromatic motif incidence by approx. 10-12\% relative to a parameter-matched classical generator, highlighting its role as a compact topology-shaping operator.

AI.tldr: MOLPAQ是一种模块化量子-经典分子生成器，通过量子生成的潜在片段组装分子，实现100%有效性、99.75%新颖性和0.905多样性，量子生成器在性质控制方面优于参数匹配的经典生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有分子生成模型通常在有效性、多样性和性质控制之间存在权衡，无法同时满足这些目标。需要开发能够同时确保这三个关键指标的分子生成方法。
AI.method: MOLPAQ采用模块化架构：1) β-VAE在QM9数据集上预训练学习化学对齐的潜在流形；2) 降维条件器将分子描述符映射到该空间；3) 参数高效的量子片段生成器产生纠缠节点嵌入；4) 价态感知聚合器重建为有效分子图；5) 使用潜在判别器和化学形状奖励进行对抗性微调。
AI.result: 实现100% RDKit有效性、99.75%新颖性和0.905多样性。量子生成器相比参数匹配的经典生成器，平均QED提高约2.3%，芳香基团出现率增加约10-12%，作为紧凑的拓扑塑造算子发挥作用。
AI.conclusion: MOLPAQ通过量子-经典混合架构成功解决了分子生成中有效性、多样性和性质控制的权衡问题，量子组件在性质优化方面展现出优势，为分子设计提供了新范式。

title: InsEdit: Towards Instruction-based Visual Editing via Data-Efficient Video Diffusion Models Adaptation
summary: Instruction-based video editing is a natural way to control video content with text, but adapting a video generation model into an editor usually appears data-hungry. At the same time, high-quality video editing data remains scarce. In this paper, we show that a video generation backbone can become a strong video editor without large scale video editing data. We present InsEdit, an instruction-based editing model built on HunyuanVideo-1.5. InsEdit combines a visual editing architecture with a video data pipeline based on Mutual Context Attention (MCA), which creates aligned video pairs where edits can begin in the middle of a clip rather than only from the first frame. With only O(100)K video editing data, InsEdit achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source methods on our video instruction editing benchmarks. In addition, because our training recipe also includes image editing data, the final model supports image editing without any modification.

AI.tldr: InsEdit是一个基于指令的视频编辑模型，通过视觉编辑架构和互相关注机制，仅需少量视频编辑数据就能实现高质量视频编辑，同时支持图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的视频编辑虽然直观，但通常需要大量视频编辑数据，而高质量视频编辑数据稀缺。本文旨在探索如何让视频生成模型在少量数据下成为强大的视频编辑器。
AI.method: 基于HunyuanVideo-1.5构建InsEdit模型，结合视觉编辑架构和基于互相关注机制的视频数据流水线，创建对齐的视频对，允许编辑从视频中间帧开始而非仅从第一帧开始。
AI.result: 仅使用约10万视频编辑数据，InsEdit在视频指令编辑基准测试中达到开源方法的最先进水平。由于训练配方包含图像编辑数据，最终模型无需修改即可支持图像编辑。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成主干模型可以在少量视频编辑数据下成为强大的视频编辑器，InsEdit通过创新的架构和数据流水线实现了这一目标，同时具备图像编辑能力。

title: TME-PSR: Time-aware, Multi-interest, and Explanation Personalization for Sequential Recommendation
summary: In this paper, we propose a sequential recommendation model that integrates Time-aware personalization, Multi-interest personalization, and Explanation personalization for Personalized Sequential Recommendation (TME-PSR). That is, we consider the differences across different users in temporal rhythm preference, multiple fine-grained latent interests, and the personalized semantic alignment between recommendations and explanations. Specifically, the proposed TME-PSR model employs a dual-view gated time encoder to capture personalized temporal rhythms, a lightweight multihead Linear Recurrent Unit architecture that enables fine-grained sub-interest modeling with improved efficiency, and a dynamic dual-branch mutual information weighting mechanism to achieve personalized alignment between recommendations and explanations. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method consistently improves recommendation accuracy and explanation quality, at a lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出TME-PSR模型，整合时间感知、多兴趣和解释个性化，通过双门控时间编码器、轻量多头线性循环单元和动态双分支互信息加权机制提升推荐准确性和解释质量
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐模型在个性化方面存在不足：1) 忽略用户间时间节奏偏好的差异；2) 缺乏对用户细粒度多兴趣的建模；3) 推荐与解释之间的语义对齐未考虑个性化因素。需要同时解决这三个问题来提升推荐系统的准确性和可解释性
AI.method: 提出TME-PSR模型：1) 双视图门控时间编码器捕获个性化时间节奏；2) 轻量多头线性循环单元架构实现细粒度子兴趣建模并提升效率；3) 动态双分支互信息加权机制实现推荐与解释的个性化对齐
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在较低计算成本下，持续提升了推荐准确性和解释质量
AI.conclusion: TME-PSR模型通过整合时间感知、多兴趣和解释个性化，为个性化序列推荐提供了有效的解决方案，在准确性和可解释性方面均有显著提升

title: EfficientSign: An Attention-Enhanced Lightweight Architecture for Indian Sign Language Recognition
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Human-Machine Systems
summary: How do you build a sign language recognizer that works on a phone? That question drove this work. We built EfficientSign, a lightweight model which takes EfficientNet-B0 and focuses on two attention modules (Squeeze-and-Excitation for channel focus, and a spatial attention layer that focuses on the hand gestures). We tested it against five other approaches on 12,637 images of Indian Sign Language alphabets, all 26 classes, using 5-fold cross-validation. EfficientSign achieves the accuracy of 99.94% (+/-0.05%), which matches the performance of ResNet18's 99.97% accuracy, but with 62% fewer parameters (4.2M vs 11.2M). We also experimented with feeding deep features (1,280-dimensional vectors pulled from EfficientNet-B0's pooling layer) into classical classifiers. SVM achieved the accuracy of 99.63%, Logistic Regression achieved the accuracy of 99.03% and KNN achieved accuracy of 96.33%. All of these blow past the 92% that SURF-based methods managed on a similar dataset back in 2015. Our results show that attention-enhanced learning model provides an efficient and deployable solution for ISL recognition without requiring a massive model or hand-tuned feature pipelines anymore.

AI.tldr: EfficientSign：一个轻量级手语识别模型，在印度手语字母数据集上达到99.94%准确率，参数量比ResNet18少62%，适合手机部署
AI.motivation: 开发能够在手机上运行的轻量级手语识别系统，解决传统方法需要大量参数或手动特征工程的问题
AI.method: 基于EfficientNet-B0构建轻量模型，集成两个注意力模块（通道注意力Squeeze-and-Excitation和空间注意力层），并在12,637张印度手语字母图像上使用5折交叉验证进行测试
AI.result: EfficientSign达到99.94%准确率（±0.05%），与ResNet18的99.97%相当但参数量减少62%（4.2M vs 11.2M）；使用EfficientNet-B0深度特征的SVM、逻辑回归、KNN分别达到99.63%、99.03%、96.33%，远超2015年SURF方法的92%
AI.conclusion: 注意力增强的轻量学习模型为印度手语识别提供了高效可部署的解决方案，无需大规模模型或手动调优的特征管道

title: Dynamic Ranked List Truncation for Reranking Pipelines via LLM-generated Reference-Documents
summary: Large Language Models (LLM) have been widely used in reranking. Computational overhead and large context lengths remain a challenging issue for LLM rerankers. Efficient reranking usually involves selecting a subset of the ranked list from the first stage, known as ranked list truncation (RLT). The truncated list is processed further by a reranker. For LLM rerankers, the ranked list is often partitioned and processed sequentially in batches to reduce the context length. Both these steps involve hyperparameters and topic-agnostic heuristics. Recently, LLMs have been shown to be effective for relevance judgment. Equivalently, we propose that LLMs can be used to generate reference documents that can act as a pivot between relevant and non-relevant documents in a ranked list. We propose methods to use these generated reference documents for RLT as well as for efficient listwise reranking. While reranking, we process the ranked list in either parallel batches of non-overlapping windows or overlapping windows with adaptive strides, improving the existing fixed stride setup. The generated reference documents are also shown to improve existing efficient listwise reranking frameworks. Experiments on TREC Deep Learning benchmarks show that our approach outperforms existing RLT-based approaches. In-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods accelerate LLM-based listwise reranking by up to 66\% compared to existing approaches. This work not only establishes a practical paradigm for efficient LLM-based reranking but also provides insight into the capability of LLMs to generate semantically controlled documents using relevance signals.

AI.tldr: 提出使用LLM生成参考文档作为相关与非相关文档之间的枢纽，用于排名列表截断和高效列表重排序，在TREC基准测试中优于现有方法，加速达66%
AI.motivation: LLM重排序面临计算开销大和上下文长度限制的挑战。现有方法依赖超参数和主题无关的启发式策略，需要更智能的排名列表截断和高效重排序方法
AI.method: 1) 使用LLM生成参考文档作为相关与非相关文档的枢纽；2) 基于参考文档进行排名列表截断；3) 采用并行批处理非重叠窗口或自适应步长的重叠窗口进行列表重排序；4) 将生成参考文档集成到现有高效列表重排序框架中
AI.result: 在TREC深度学习基准测试中优于现有RLT方法。域内和域外基准测试显示，相比现有方法，LLM列表重排序加速达66%。生成参考文档能提升现有高效列表重排序框架性能
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个实用的高效LLM重排序范式，同时揭示了LLM利用相关性信号生成语义可控文档的能力。提出的方法能有效解决计算开销和上下文长度限制问题

title: Temperature-Dependent Performance of Prompting Strategies in Extended Reasoning Large Language Models
summary: Extended reasoning models represent a transformative shift in Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities by enabling explicit test-time computation for complex problem solving. However, the optimal configuration of sampling temperature and prompting strategy for these systems remains largely underexplored. We systematically evaluate chain-of-thought and zero-shot prompting across four temperature settings (0.0, 0.4, 0.7, and 1.0) using Grok-4.1 with extended reasoning on 39 mathematical problems from AMO-Bench, a challenging International Mathematical Olympiad-level benchmark. We find that zero-shot prompting achieves peak performance at moderate temperatures, reaching 59% accuracy at T=0.4 and T=0.7, while chain-of-thought prompting performs best at the temperature extremes. Most notably, the benefit of extended reasoning increases from 6x at T=0.0 to 14.3x at T=1.0. These results suggest that temperature should be optimized jointly with prompting strategy, challenging the common practice of using T=0 for reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 系统评估了扩展推理模型中温度设置和提示策略对数学问题求解性能的影响，发现零样本提示在中等温度表现最佳，而思维链提示在温度极端值表现更好，扩展推理的收益随温度升高而增加。
AI.motivation: 扩展推理模型代表了LLM能力的变革性转变，但针对这些系统的最优温度配置和提示策略仍缺乏系统研究。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索温度设置与提示策略的联合优化。
AI.method: 使用Grok-4.1扩展推理模型，在39个来自AMO-Bench（国际数学奥林匹克级别）的数学问题上，系统评估了思维链和零样本两种提示策略在四种温度设置（0.0、0.4、0.7、1.0）下的性能表现。
AI.result: 零样本提示在中等温度（T=0.4和T=0.7）达到峰值性能，准确率为59%；思维链提示在温度极端值表现最佳。扩展推理的收益从T=0.0时的6倍增加到T=1.0时的14.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 温度应与提示策略联合优化，挑战了在推理任务中普遍使用T=0的常见做法。扩展推理的收益随温度升高而显著增加，表明高温设置下模型能更好地利用扩展计算能力。

title: Structured Exploration and Exploitation of Label Functions for Automated Data Annotation
summary: High-quality labeled data is critical for training reliable machine learning and deep learning models, yet manual annotation remains costly and error-prone. Programmatic labeling addresses this challenge by using label functions (LFs), i.e., heuristic rules that automatically generate weak labels for training datasets. However, existing automated LF generation methods either rely on large language models (LLMs) to synthesize surface-level heuristics or employ model-based synthesis over hand-crafted primitives. These approaches often result in limited coverage and unreliable label quality. In this paper, we introduce EXPONA, an automated framework for programmatic labeling that formulates LF generation as a principled process balancing diversity and reliability. EXPONA systematically explores multi-level LFs, spanning surface, structural, and semantic perspectives. EXPONA further applies reliability-aware mechanisms to suppress noisy or redundant heuristics while preserving complementary signals. To evaluate EXPONA, we conducted extensive experiments on eleven classification datasets across diverse domains. Experimental results show that EXPONA consistently outperformed state-of-the-art automated LF generation methods. Specifically, EXPONA achieved nearly complete label coverage (up to 98.9%), improved weak label quality by up to 87%, and yielded downstream performance gains of up to 46% in weighted F1. These results indicate that EXPONA's combination of multi-level LF exploration and reliability-aware filtering enabled more consistent label quality and downstream performance across diverse tasks by balancing coverage and precision in the generated LF set.

AI.tldr: EXPONA：一种通过多层次探索和可靠性感知过滤自动生成标签函数的程序化标注框架，在覆盖率和精度之间取得平衡，显著提升弱标签质量和下游性能
AI.motivation: 高质量标注数据对训练可靠的机器学习模型至关重要，但手动标注成本高且易出错。现有的自动标签函数生成方法要么依赖大语言模型合成表面级启发式规则，要么基于手工构建的基元进行模型合成，导致覆盖范围有限且标签质量不可靠。
AI.method: EXPONA将标签函数生成构建为一个平衡多样性和可靠性的原则性过程。系统探索多层次标签函数，涵盖表面、结构和语义视角。应用可靠性感知机制抑制噪声或冗余启发式规则，同时保留互补信号。
AI.result: 在11个不同领域的分类数据集上进行的实验表明，EXPONA始终优于最先进的自动标签函数生成方法。实现了接近完全的标签覆盖率（高达98.9%），弱标签质量提升高达87%，下游加权F1性能增益高达46%。
AI.conclusion: EXPONA通过多层次标签函数探索和可靠性感知过滤的组合，在生成的标签函数集中平衡覆盖率和精度，实现了更一致的标签质量和下游性能，能够有效处理多样化的任务。

title: Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference
summary: We introduce Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a multimodal inference task spanning text, audio, and video, where models must produce calibrated probability estimates of hypotheses conditioned on a premise in any modality or combination. While uncertain inference has been explored in text, extension to other modalities has been limited to single-modality binary entailment judgments, leaving no framework for fine-grained probabilistic reasoning in or across other modalities. To address this, we curate a human-annotated evaluation set with scalar probability judgments across audio, visual, and audiovisual settings, and additionally evaluate on existing text and audio benchmarks. We introduce CLUE (Calibrated Latent Uncertainty Estimation), which combines self-consistent teacher calibration and distribution-based confidence probing to produce calibrated predictions. We demonstrate that our 3B-parameter model achieves equivalent or stronger performance than baselines up to 32B parameters across all modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出UMUI任务和CLUE方法，用于跨文本、音频、视频的多模态不确定性推理，通过3B参数模型在多个模态上达到或超越32B参数基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性推理研究主要局限于文本模态，其他模态仅支持单模态二元蕴含判断，缺乏跨模态细粒度概率推理框架。
AI.method: 提出CLUE方法，结合自洽教师校准和基于分布的置信度探测来产生校准预测；构建人工标注的多模态概率判断评估集。
AI.result: 3B参数模型在音频、视觉、视听及现有文本和音频基准测试中，达到或优于最高32B参数的基线模型性能。
AI.conclusion: UMUI任务和CLUE方法有效解决了多模态不确定性推理问题，小模型通过校准技术实现了与大模型相当或更好的性能。

title: PRAGMA: Revolut Foundation Model
summary: Modern financial systems generate vast quantities of transactional and event-level data that encode rich economic signals. This paper presents PRAGMA, a family of foundation models for multi-source banking event sequences. Our approach pre-trains a Transformer-based architecture with masked modelling on a large-scale, heterogeneous banking event corpus using a self-supervised objective tailored to the discrete, variable-length nature of financial records. The resulting model supports a wide range of downstream tasks such as credit scoring, fraud detection, and lifetime value prediction: strong performance can be achieved by training a simple linear model on top of the extracted embeddings and can be further improved with lightweight fine-tuning. Through extensive evaluation on downstream tasks, we demonstrate that PRAGMA achieves superior performance across multiple domains directly from raw event sequences, providing a general-purpose representation layer for financial applications.

AI.tldr: PRAGMA是一个基于Transformer的金融事件序列基础模型，通过掩码建模预训练处理多源银行事件数据，支持信用评分、欺诈检测等下游任务，仅需线性分类器即可实现优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现代金融系统产生大量交易和事件级数据，这些数据编码了丰富的经济信号，但传统方法难以有效处理这种离散、变长的金融记录序列，需要一种通用的表示学习方法。
AI.method: 采用Transformer架构，在大规模异构银行事件语料库上进行掩码建模预训练，使用专门针对离散、变长金融记录设计的自监督目标。模型支持通过提取的嵌入训练简单线性模型，或通过轻量级微调进一步改进性能。
AI.result: PRAGMA在多个下游任务（信用评分、欺诈检测、生命周期价值预测）上表现出优越性能，能够直接从原始事件序列中获得良好效果，为金融应用提供了通用表示层。
AI.conclusion: PRAGMA作为金融事件序列的基础模型，通过自监督预训练学习通用表示，显著简化了下游任务的处理流程，为金融领域的机器学习应用提供了强大且通用的解决方案。

title: Attention-Based Sampler for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Auto-regressive models (ARMs) have established a dominant paradigm in language modeling. However, their strictly sequential decoding paradigm imposes fundamental constraints on both inference efficiency and modeling flexibility. To address these limitations, diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have been proposed, offering the potential for parallel decoding and flexible language modeling. Despite these advantages, current dLLMs decoding strategies rely primarily on token level information, which fails to account for global sequence structure and often yields suboptimal results. In this paper, we study the decoding order selection problem from the perspective of log-likelihood maximization. We theoretically demonstrate that optimal sequence likelihood can be approximately achieved by decoding tokens in descending order of their attention matrix column sums. This finding provides a principled justification for attention-guided decoding and offers a theoretically grounded alternative to greedy search. We instantiate this theoretical insight in a new training-free decoding algorithm, termed Attn-Sampler, and further propose a block attention approximation and dynamic attention thresholding for practical acceleration. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed method, demonstrating that it achieves superior generation quality while enhancing the decoding parallelism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于注意力矩阵列和排序的解码顺序选择方法，从似然最大化角度理论证明了按注意力权重降序解码的合理性，并实现了无需训练的Attn-Sampler解码算法。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型（ARMs）的顺序解码范式限制了推理效率和建模灵活性，而现有的扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）解码策略主要依赖token级信息，忽略了全局序列结构，导致次优结果。需要从理论角度研究解码顺序选择问题。
AI.method: 从对数似然最大化角度理论分析，证明最优序列似然可通过按注意力矩阵列和降序解码近似实现。基于此理论洞察，提出了无需训练的Attn-Sampler解码算法，包含块注意力近似和动态注意力阈值技术以加速实践应用。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验验证了所提方法的有效性，表明该方法在提升解码并行性的同时实现了更优的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析建立了注意力引导解码的数学基础，提出的Attn-Sampler算法为扩散大语言模型提供了理论支撑的解码策略，在保持高质量生成的同时提高了并行解码能力。

title: On the Spectral Geometry of Cross-Modal Representations: A Functional Map Diagnostic for Multimodal Alignment
comment: Under review at ACMMM Brave New Ideas Track
summary: We study cross-modal alignment between independently pretrained vision (DINOv2) and language (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) encoders using the functional map framework from computational geometry, which represents correspondence between representation manifolds as a compact linear operator between graph Laplacian eigenbases. While the framework underperforms Procrustes alignment and relative representations for cross-modal retrieval across all supervision budgets, it reveals a structural property of multimodal representations. We find that the Laplacian eigenvalue spectra of the two encoders are quantitatively similar (normalized spectral distance 0.043), indicating that independently trained models develop manifolds of comparable intrinsic complexity. However, the functional map exhibits near-zero diagonal dominance (mean below 0.05) and large orthogonality error (70.15), showing that the eigenvector bases are effectively unaligned. We term this decoupling the spectral complexity--orientation gap: models converge in how much structure they capture but not in how they organize it. This gap defines a boundary condition for spectral alignment methods and motivates three diagnostic quantities : diagonal dominance, orthogonality deviation, and Laplacian commutativity error for characterizing cross-modal representation compatibility.

AI.tldr: 使用计算几何中的函数映射框架研究独立预训练的视觉和语言编码器之间的跨模态对齐，发现模型在捕获的结构量上收敛，但在组织方式上未对齐，提出了"谱复杂度-方向性差距"概念。
AI.motivation: 研究独立预训练的视觉（DINOv2）和语言（all-MiniLM-L6-v2）编码器之间的跨模态对齐，探索表示流形之间的对应关系，特别是使用计算几何中的函数映射框架来分析表示的结构特性。
AI.method: 使用函数映射框架（functional map framework）将表示流形之间的对应关系表示为图拉普拉斯特征基之间的紧凑线性算子。该方法将跨模态对齐问题转化为谱域中的线性映射问题，通过分析拉普拉斯特征谱和特征向量基的对齐情况来研究表示兼容性。
AI.result: 函数映射框架在跨模态检索任务中表现不如Procrustes对齐和相对表示方法。但分析发现两个编码器的拉普拉斯特征谱定量相似（归一化谱距离0.043），表明独立训练的模型发展出具有可比内在复杂度的流形。然而函数映射显示接近零的对角优势（均值低于0.05）和大的正交性误差（70.15），表明特征向量基实际上未对齐。这被称为"谱复杂度-方向性差距"。
AI.conclusion: 独立预训练的视觉和语言模型在捕获的结构量（谱复杂度）上收敛，但在组织方式（方向性）上未对齐。这一差距为谱对齐方法定义了边界条件，并提出了三个诊断量：对角优势、正交性偏差和拉普拉斯可交换性误差，用于表征跨模态表示兼容性。

title: RS-OVC: Open-Vocabulary Counting for Remote-Sensing Data
summary: Object-Counting for remote-sensing (RS) imagery is attracting increasing research interest due to its crucial role in a wide and diverse set of applications. While several promising methods for RS object-counting have been proposed, existing methods focus on a closed, pre-defined set of object classes. This limitation necessitates costly re-annotation and model re-training to adapt current approaches for counting of novel objects that have not been seen during training, and severely inhibits their application in dynamic, real-world monitoring scenarios. To address this gap, in this work we propose RS-OVC - the first Open Vocabulary Counting (OVC) model for Remote-Sensing and aerial imagery. We show that our model is capable of accurate counting of novel object classes, that were unseen during training, based solely on textual and/or visual conditioning.
