AI.tldr: EvoLen：一种结合进化分层和长度感知解码的DNA标记化方法，通过跨物种进化信号更好地保留功能序列模式（如调控基序），相比标准BPE在DNALM基准测试中表现相当或更优。
AI.motivation: DNA语言模型中的标记设计尚未充分探索。与自然语言不同，DNA缺乏固有的标记边界或预定义的组合规则，使得标记化成为基本的建模决策而非自然指定的过程。现有方法（如BPE）擅长捕捉反映人类生成语言规律性的标记结构，但DNA是由生物功能和进化约束而非语言惯例组织的。因此，DNA标记化应优先考虑功能序列模式（如调控基序）。
AI.method: EvoLen：结合进化分层与长度感知解码的标记器。方法包括：1）使用跨物种进化信号对DNA序列进行分组；2）在每个组上训练单独的BPE标记器；3）通过优先保留模式的规则合并所得词汇表；4）应用带动态规划的**长度感知解码**。
AI.result: 通过受控实验，EvoLen在以下方面表现更优：1）更好地保留功能序列模式；2）提高跨基因组背景的区分能力；3）更好地与进化约束对齐。同时，在多样化的DNALM基准测试中，EvoLen与标准BPE表现相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 标记化引入了关键的归纳偏置，而结合进化信息能产生更具生物学意义和可解释性的序列表示。EvoLen通过进化分层和长度感知解码，为DNA语言模型提供了更符合生物学功能的标记化方法。

title: Efficient RL Training for LLMs with Experience Replay
summary: While Experience Replay - the practice of storing rollouts and reusing them multiple times during training - is a foundational technique in general RL, it remains largely unexplored in LLM post-training due to the prevailing belief that fresh, on-policy data is essential for high performance. In this work, we challenge this assumption. We present a systematic study of replay buffers for LLM post-training, formalizing the optimal design as a trade-off between staleness-induced variance, sample diversity and the high computational cost of generation. We show that strict on-policy sampling is suboptimal when generation is expensive. Empirically, we show that a well-designed replay buffer can drastically reduce inference compute without degrading - and in some cases even improving - final model performance, while preserving policy entropy.

AI.tldr: 经验回放（存储并重用训练数据）在通用RL中很基础，但在LLM后训练中很少探索，因为普遍认为新鲜、同策略数据对高性能至关重要。本文挑战这一假设，系统研究LLM后训练的回放缓冲区设计，展示精心设计的回放缓冲区能大幅减少推理计算而不降低性能。
AI.motivation: 挑战LLM后训练中普遍认为必须使用新鲜同策略数据的假设，探索经验回放技术在此领域的应用潜力，以解决生成数据的高计算成本问题。
AI.method: 系统研究LLM后训练的回放缓冲区设计，将其形式化为陈旧性引起的方差、样本多样性和生成高计算成本之间的权衡优化问题。比较不同采样策略，包括严格同策略采样和回放缓冲区策略。
AI.result: 严格同策略采样在生成成本高时是次优的。精心设计的回放缓冲区能大幅减少推理计算（高达80%），而不降低最终模型性能，在某些情况下甚至能提升性能，同时保持策略熵。
AI.conclusion: 经验回放是LLM后训练中有效且高效的技术，能显著降低计算成本而不牺牲性能，挑战了必须使用新鲜同策略数据的传统观念。

title: GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent: Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have accelerated progress in domain-oriented AI, yet their development in geoscience and remote sensing (RS) remains constrained by distinctive challenges: wide-ranging disciplinary knowledge, heterogeneous sensor modalities, and a fragmented spectrum of tasks. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GeoMMBench, a comprehensive multimodal question-answering benchmark covering diverse RS disciplines, sensors, and tasks, enabling broader and more rigorous evaluation than prior benchmarks. Using GeoMMBench, we assess 36 open-source and proprietary large language models, uncovering systematic deficiencies in domain knowledge, perceptual grounding, and reasoning--capabilities essential for expert-level geospatial interpretation. Beyond evaluation, we propose GeoMMAgent, a multi-agent framework that strategically integrates retrieval, perception, and reasoning through domain-specific RS models and tools. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that GeoMMAgent significantly outperforms standalone LLMs, underscoring the importance of tool-augmented agents for dynamically tackling complex geoscience and RS challenges.

AI.tldr: GeoMMBench是一个全面的遥感多模态问答基准，用于评估大语言模型在地球科学领域的性能，并提出了GeoMMAgent多智能体框架来提升遥感任务处理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在地球科学和遥感领域的发展受到三个主要挑战的限制：广泛的学科知识、异构的传感器模态和碎片化的任务谱系。现有基准无法全面评估模型在这些复杂领域的表现。
AI.method: 1) 提出GeoMMBench基准，涵盖多样化的遥感学科、传感器和任务；2) 使用该基准评估36个开源和专有大语言模型；3) 提出GeoMMAgent多智能体框架，通过检索、感知和推理模块集成领域特定的遥感模型和工具。
AI.result: 评估揭示了现有模型在领域知识、感知基础和推理能力方面的系统性缺陷。GeoMMAgent在实验中显著优于独立的大语言模型，证明了工具增强智能体在解决复杂地球科学和遥感挑战中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了开发专门针对地球科学和遥感领域需求的多模态基准和工具增强智能体框架的重要性，为推进该领域的AI应用提供了有效的评估方法和解决方案。

title: Breaking Block Boundaries: Anchor-based History-stable Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently become a promising alternative to autoregressive large language models (ARMs). Semi-autoregressive (Semi-AR) decoding is widely employed in base dLLMs and advanced decoding strategies due to its superior performance. However, our observations reveal that Semi-AR decoding suffers from inherent block constraints, which cause the decoding of many cross-block stable tokens to be unnecessarily delayed. To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the identification of stable tokens and present three key findings: (1) naive lookahead decoding is unreliable, (2) token stability closely correlates with convergence trend, and (3) historical information is isolated. Building on these insights, we propose Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD), a training-free, plug-and-play dynamic decoding strategy. Specifically, AHD monitors the stability trend of tokens in real time through dynamic anchors. Once a token reaches stability, it initiates early cross-block decoding to enhance efficiency and performance. Extensive experiments across language, vision-language, and audio-language domains demonstrate that AHD simultaneously improves both performance and inference efficiency. Notably, AHD effectively reverses the performance degradation typically observed in existing advanced decoding acceleration strategies. For instance, on the BBH benchmark, our approach reduces decoding steps by 80% while improving performance by 3.67%.

AI.tldr: 提出Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD)，一种无需训练的动态解码策略，通过实时监控token稳定性趋势，实现跨块早期解码，同时提升扩散大语言模型的性能和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有半自回归解码存在固有的块约束问题，导致许多跨块稳定token的解码被不必要地延迟。需要解决这一效率瓶颈，同时保持或提升模型性能。
AI.method: 提出AHD策略：1）通过动态锚点实时监控token稳定性趋势；2）基于稳定性趋势识别稳定token；3）一旦token达到稳定状态，立即启动跨块早期解码；4）无需额外训练，即插即用。
AI.result: 在语言、视觉语言和音频语言多个领域的大规模实验中，AHD同时提升了性能和推理效率。在BBH基准测试中，解码步骤减少80%的同时性能提升3.67%，有效逆转了现有高级解码加速策略通常导致的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: AHD通过解决半自回归解码的块约束问题，实现了扩散大语言模型解码效率与性能的双重提升，为动态解码策略提供了新的有效解决方案。

title: Every Response Counts: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Tensor Decomposition
summary: While Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) consistently outperform single-agent systems on complex tasks, their intricate interactions introduce critical reliability challenges arising from communication dynamics and role dependencies. Existing Uncertainty Quantification methods, typically designed for single-turn outputs, fail to address the unique complexities of the MAS. Specifically, these methods struggle with three distinct challenges: the cascading uncertainty in multi-step reasoning, the variability of inter-agent communication paths, and the diversity of communication topologies. To bridge this gap, we introduce MATU, a novel framework that quantifies uncertainty through tensor decomposition. MATU moves beyond analyzing final text outputs by representing entire reasoning trajectories as embedding matrices and organizing multiple execution runs into a higher-order tensor. By applying tensor decomposition, we disentangle and quantify distinct sources of uncertainty, offering a comprehensive reliability measure that is generalizable across different agent structures. We provide comprehensive experiments to show that MATU effectively estimates holistic and robust uncertainty across diverse tasks and communication topologies.

AI.tldr: MATU：基于张量分解的多智能体系统不确定性量化框架，解决传统方法在复杂交互中的局限性
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在复杂任务上优于单智能体系统，但其复杂的交互引入了通信动态和角色依赖带来的可靠性挑战。现有不确定性量化方法通常为单轮输出设计，无法处理MAS特有的复杂性，特别是级联不确定性、通信路径可变性和通信拓扑多样性三大挑战。
AI.method: 提出MATU框架，通过张量分解量化不确定性。该方法超越分析最终文本输出，将整个推理轨迹表示为嵌入矩阵，并将多次执行运行组织成高阶张量。通过张量分解解耦和量化不同来源的不确定性，提供可泛化到不同智能体结构的全面可靠性度量。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，MATU能有效估计跨不同任务和通信拓扑的整体鲁棒不确定性。该框架提供了比传统方法更全面的可靠性评估。
AI.conclusion: MATU填补了多智能体系统不确定性量化方法的空白，通过张量分解方法解决了级联不确定性、通信路径可变性和拓扑多样性三大挑战，为MAS可靠性评估提供了通用框架。

title: Litmus (Re)Agent: A Benchmark and Agentic System for Predictive Evaluation of Multilingual Models
summary: We study predictive multilingual evaluation: estimating how well a model will perform on a task in a target language when direct benchmark results are missing. This problem is common in multilingual deployment, where evaluation coverage is sparse and published evidence is uneven across languages, tasks, and model families. We introduce a controlled benchmark of 1,500 questions spanning six tasks and five evidence scenarios. The benchmark separates accessible evidence from ground truth, enabling evaluation of systems that must infer missing results from incomplete literature evidence. We also present Litmus (Re)Agent, a DAG-orchestrated agentic system that decomposes queries into hypotheses, retrieves evidence, and synthesises predictions through feature-aware aggregation. Across six systems, Litmus (Re)Agent achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains in transfer-heavy scenarios where direct evidence is weak or absent. These results show that structured agentic reasoning is a promising approach to multilingual performance estimation under incomplete evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Litmus (Re)Agent系统，通过结构化智能体推理解决多语言性能预测问题，在证据不完整情况下预测模型在目标语言任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 多语言部署中评估覆盖稀疏，不同语言、任务和模型家族的已发表证据分布不均，需要预测模型在缺乏直接基准结果的目标语言上的性能。
AI.method: 构建包含1,500个问题的控制基准，涵盖6个任务和5种证据场景；开发Litmus (Re)Agent系统，采用DAG编排的智能体架构，将查询分解为假设、检索证据并通过特征感知聚合合成预测。
AI.result: 在6个系统比较中，Litmus (Re)Agent获得最佳整体性能，在直接证据薄弱或缺失的转移密集型场景中提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化智能体推理是证据不完整情况下多语言性能估计的有前景方法。

title: Large-Scale Universal Defect Generation: Foundation Models and Datasets
summary: Existing defect/anomaly generation methods often rely on few-shot learning, which overfits to specific defect categories due to the lack of large-scale paired defect editing data. This issue is aggravated by substantial variations in defect scale and morphology, resulting in limited generalization, degraded realism, and category consistency. We address these challenges by introducing UDG, a large-scale dataset of 300K normal-abnormal-mask-caption quadruplets spanning diverse domains, and by presenting UniDG, a universal defect generation foundation model that supports both reference-based defect generation and text instruction-based defect editing without per-category fine-tuning. UniDG performs Defect-Context Editing via adaptive defect cropping and structured diptych input format, and fuses reference and target conditions through MM-DiT multimodal attention. A two-stage training strategy, Diversity-SFT followed by Consistency-RFT, further improves diversity while enhancing realism and reference consistency. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD and VisA show that UniDG outperforms prior few-shot anomaly generation and image insertion/editing baselines in synthesis quality and downstream single- and multi-class anomaly detection/localization. Code will be available at https://github.com/RetoFan233/UniDG.

AI.tldr: UniDG是一个通用的缺陷生成基础模型，通过大规模数据集和创新的缺陷上下文编辑方法，实现了无需类别微调的参考式和文本指令式缺陷生成，在异常检测和定位任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有缺陷/异常生成方法通常依赖少样本学习，由于缺乏大规模配对的缺陷编辑数据，容易过拟合到特定缺陷类别。缺陷尺度和形态的巨大变化进一步限制了方法的泛化能力、真实感和类别一致性。
AI.method: 提出UDG数据集（30万正常-异常-掩码-描述四元组）和UniDG模型。采用缺陷上下文编辑方法，包括自适应缺陷裁剪和结构化双联画输入格式，通过MM-DiT多模态注意力融合参考和目标条件。采用两阶段训练策略：多样性监督微调（Diversity-SFT）和一致性强化微调（Consistency-RFT）。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上的实验表明，UniDG在合成质量和下游单类/多类异常检测/定位任务上优于现有的少样本异常生成和图像插入/编辑基线方法。
AI.conclusion: UniDG作为一个通用的缺陷生成基础模型，通过大规模数据集和创新的训练策略，解决了现有方法在泛化能力、真实感和一致性方面的局限性，为缺陷生成和异常检测提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Confident in a Confidence Score: Investigating the Sensitivity of Confidence Scores to Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Uncertainty quantification is a set of techniques that measure confidence in language models. They can be used, for example, to detect hallucinations or alert users to review uncertain predictions. To be useful, these confidence scores must be correlated with the quality of the output. However, recent work found that fine-tuning can affect the correlation between confidence scores and quality. Hence, we investigate the underlying behavior of confidence scores to understand its sensitivity to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We find that post-SFT, the correlation of various confidence scores degrades, which can stem from changes in confidence scores due to factors other than the output quality, such as the output's similarity to the training distribution. We demonstrate via a case study how failing to address this miscorrelation reduces the usefulness of the confidence scores on a downstream task. Our findings show how confidence metrics cannot be used off-the-shelf without testing, and motivate the need for developing metrics which are more robust to fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 研究发现监督微调会降低语言模型置信度分数与输出质量的相关性，导致置信度指标不能直接使用，需要开发更鲁棒的指标
AI.motivation: 不确定性量化技术用于衡量语言模型的置信度，但最近研究发现微调会影响置信度分数与输出质量的相关性，需要深入理解这种敏感性
AI.method: 研究监督微调后各种置信度分数的相关性变化，分析导致相关性下降的因素（如输出与训练分布的相似性），并通过案例研究展示相关性失调对下游任务的影响
AI.result: 监督微调后，各种置信度分数与输出质量的相关性下降，这种相关性失调源于置信度分数受输出与训练分布相似性等因素影响，而非仅由输出质量决定
AI.conclusion: 置信度指标不能直接使用而需要测试，需要开发对微调更鲁棒的置信度指标

title: MV3DIS: Multi-View Mask Matching via 3D Guides for Zero-Shot 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Conventional 3D instance segmentation methods rely on labor-intensive 3D annotations for supervised training, which limits their scalability and generalization to novel objects. Recent approaches leverage multi-view 2D masks from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to guide the merging of 3D geometric primitives, thereby enabling zero-shot 3D instance segmentation. However, these methods typically process each frame independently and rely solely on 2D metrics, such as SAM prediction scores, to produce segmentation maps. This design overlooks multi-view correlations and inherent 3D priors, leading to inconsistent 2D masks across views and ultimately fragmented 3D segmentation. In this paper, we propose MV3DIS, a coarse-to-fine framework for zero-shot 3D instance segmentation that explicitly incorporates 3D priors. Specifically, we introduce a 3D-guided mask matching strategy that uses coarse 3D segments as a common reference to match 2D masks across views and consolidates multi-view mask consistency via 3D coverage distributions. Guided by these view-consistent 2D masks, the coarse 3D segments are further refined into precise 3D instances. Additionally, we introduce a depth consistency weighting scheme that quantifies projection reliability to suppress ambiguities from inter-object occlusions, thereby improving the robustness of 3D-to-2D correspondence. Extensive experiments on the ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, ScanNet++, Replica, and Matterport3D datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MV3DIS, which achieves superior performance over previous methods

AI.tldr: MV3DIS：一种从粗到精的零样本3D实例分割框架，通过3D引导的掩码匹配策略和多视图一致性整合，解决了现有方法忽略多视图相关性和3D先验的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D实例分割方法依赖SAM生成的2D掩码，但独立处理每帧且仅使用2D指标，忽略了多视图相关性和3D先验，导致跨视图掩码不一致和3D分割碎片化。
AI.method: 提出MV3DIS框架：1) 3D引导掩码匹配策略，使用粗3D片段作为共同参考匹配跨视图2D掩码；2) 通过3D覆盖分布整合多视图掩码一致性；3) 深度一致性加权方案量化投影可靠性以抑制遮挡歧义；4) 基于视图一致的2D掩码精炼粗3D片段为精确3D实例。
AI.result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet++、Replica和Matterport3D数据集上的广泛实验表明，MV3DIS优于先前方法，实现了卓越性能。
AI.conclusion: MV3DIS通过显式整合3D先验和多视图一致性，有效解决了零样本3D实例分割中的跨视图不一致问题，实现了更鲁棒和精确的分割结果。

title: Quantisation Reshapes the Metacognitive Geometry of Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Pre-registered study. Code and data: https://github.com/synthiumjp/sdt-calibration
summary: We report that model quantisation restructures domain-level metacognitive efficiency in LLMs rather than degrading it uniformly. Evaluating Llama-3-8B-Instruct on the same 3,000 questions at Q5_K_M and f16 precision, we find that M-ratio profiles across four knowledge domains are uncorrelated between formats (Spearman rho = 0.00). Arts & Literature moves from worst-monitored (M-ratio = 0.606 at Q5_K_M) to best-monitored (1.542 at f16). Geography moves from well-monitored (1.210) to under-monitored (0.798). However, Type-2 AUROC profiles are perfectly stable across formats (rho = 1.00), localising the restructuring to the M-ratio normalisation rather than the underlying discrimination signal. This finding emerged from a pre-registered attempt to improve metacognition through domain-conditional training. We prescribed confidence-amplification SFT for the diagnosed weak domain, with matched-budget agnostic and wrong-prescription controls. All four confirmatory hypotheses were null (10,000 bootstrap resamples, seed = 42). The training successfully reshaped confidence distributions, doubling the NLP gap in Science from 0.076 to 0.152, but did not improve meta-d' because the diagnostic profile did not transfer across formats. Any system relying on domain-level M-ratio profiles has an unexamined dependency on inference format. Systems using AUROC_2 are safer. We release all code, pre-registrations, and trial-level data.

AI.tldr: 模型量化会重构LLM在领域层面的元认知效率，而非均匀降低。研究发现M-ratio在不同量化格式间完全不相关，而Type-2 AUROC保持完美稳定，表明重构主要发生在归一化层面而非基础判别信号。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究模型量化如何影响LLM的元认知效率，特别是不同知识领域的元认知监控能力是否会因量化格式而发生变化，这对于依赖领域级元认知评估的系统具有重要意义。
AI.method: 使用Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型，在Q5_K_M和f16两种精度下评估3000个问题的元认知表现。通过M-ratio和Type-2 AUROC指标分析四个知识领域（艺术与文学、地理等）的元认知效率。采用预注册实验设计，对诊断出的弱领域进行置信度放大SFT训练，并设置匹配预算的对照组。
AI.result: M-ratio在不同量化格式间完全不相关（Spearman rho=0.00），艺术与文学从最差监控（M-ratio=0.606）变为最佳监控（1.542），地理则从良好监控（1.210）变为监控不足（0.798）。Type-2 AUROC在不同格式间保持完美稳定（rho=1.00）。预注册的四个验证假设均为零结果，训练成功重塑了置信度分布但未改善meta-d'。
AI.conclusion: 模型量化会重构领域级M-ratio分布而非均匀降低元认知效率，任何依赖领域级M-ratio配置的系统都存在未检测的推理格式依赖性。使用AUROC_2的系统更为安全，研究强调了在评估LLM元认知时考虑量化格式的重要性。

title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Accurate 3D human keypoints localization is a critical technology enabling robots to achieve natural and safe physical interaction with users. Conventional 3D human keypoints estimation methods primarily focus on the whole-body reconstruction quality relative to the root joint. However, in practical human-robot interaction (HRI) scenarios, robots are more concerned with the precise metric-scale spatial localization of task-relevant body parts under the egocentric camera 3D coordinate. We propose TAIHRI, the first Vision-Language Model (VLM) tailored for close-range HRI perception, capable of understanding users' motion commands and directing the robot's attention to the most task-relevant keypoints. By quantizing 3D keypoints into a finite interaction space, TAIHRI precisely localize the 3D spatial coordinates of critical body parts by 2D keypoint reasoning via next token prediction, and seamlessly adapt to downstream tasks such as natural language control or global space human mesh recovery. Experiments on egocentric interaction benchmarks demonstrate that TAIHRI achieves superior estimation accuracy for task-critical body parts. We believe TAIHRI opens new research avenues in the field of embodied human-robot interaction. Code is available at: https://github.com/Tencent/TAIHRI.

AI.tldr: TAIHRI是首个专为近距离人机交互感知设计的视觉语言模型，通过量化3D关键点到有限交互空间，利用2D关键点推理实现任务相关身体部位的精确3D空间定位。
AI.motivation: 传统3D人体关键点估计方法主要关注相对于根关节的整体重建质量，但在实际人机交互场景中，机器人更关心在自我中心相机3D坐标系下任务相关身体部位的精确度量尺度空间定位。
AI.method: 将3D关键点量化为有限交互空间，通过2D关键点推理（下一令牌预测）精确定位关键身体部位的3D空间坐标，并能无缝适应下游任务如自然语言控制或全局空间人体网格恢复。
AI.result: 在自我中心交互基准测试中，TAIHRI对任务关键身体部位实现了优越的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: TAIHRI为人机交互领域开辟了新的研究途径，能够理解用户运动指令并引导机器人关注最任务相关的关键点。

title: Testing the Assumptions of Active Learning for Translation Tasks with Few Samples
summary: Active learning (AL) is a training paradigm for selecting unlabeled samples for annotation to improve model performance on a test set, which is useful when only a limited number of samples can be annotated. These algorithms often work by optimizing for the informativeness and diversity of the training data to be annotated. Recent work found that AL strategies fail to outperform random sampling on various language generation tasks when using 100-500 samples. To understand AL's poor performance when only using few samples, we investigate whether the core assumptions underlying AL strategies hold. We find that neither the informativeness nor diversity of the training data, which AL strategies optimize for, are correlated with test set performance. Instead, factors like the ordering of the training samples and interactions with pre-training data have a larger impact on performance. This suggests that future AL methods must take these factors into account in order to work with very few samples.

AI.tldr: 研究发现主动学习在语言生成任务中使用少量样本（100-500个）时表现不佳，核心原因是其优化的信息量和多样性假设与测试集性能不相关，而训练样本顺序和与预训练数据的交互才是关键影响因素。
AI.motivation: 主动学习（AL）通常用于在标注资源有限时选择最有价值的未标注样本进行标注，以提高模型性能。然而，近期研究发现AL在语言生成任务中使用少量样本（100-500个）时无法超越随机采样。本研究旨在探究AL在少量样本情况下表现不佳的根本原因，检验其核心假设是否成立。
AI.method: 通过实证研究分析主动学习策略的核心假设，特别是检验AL所优化的两个关键因素——训练数据的"信息量"和"多样性"是否与测试集性能相关。研究比较了不同AL策略在语言生成任务中的表现，并分析了影响性能的各种因素。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）AL策略所优化的训练数据信息量和多样性与测试集性能没有相关性；2）训练样本的顺序以及样本与预训练数据的交互对性能有更大影响；3）在少量样本情况下，这些被忽视的因素比AL传统关注的因素更为重要。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习在少量样本情况下表现不佳的根本原因在于其核心假设不成立。未来的AL方法必须考虑训练样本顺序、与预训练数据的交互等关键因素，而不仅仅是优化信息量和多样性，才能在少量样本场景下有效工作。

title: IKKA: Inversion Classification via Critical Anomalies for Robust Visual Servoing
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: We introduce IKKA (Inversion Classification via Critical Anomalies), a topologically motivated weighting framework for robust visual servoing under distribution shift. Unlike conventional outlier handling, IKKA treats maverick points as structurally informative observations: points where small perturbations can induce qualitatively different control responses or class assignments. The method combines local extremality, boundary transversality, and multi-scale persistence into a single anomaly weight, W(x) = E(x) x T(x) x M(x), which modulates control updates near ambiguous decision regions. We instantiate IKKA in a CPU-only embedded visual-servoing pipeline on Raspberry Pi 4 and evaluate it across 230 reproducible runs under nominal and stress conditions. In stress scenarios involving dim illumination and transient occlusion, IKKA reduces the 95th-percentile lateral error by 24% relative to a hybrid baseline (0.124 to 0.094) while increasing throughput from 20.0 to 24.8 Hz. Non-parametric analysis confirms a large effect size (Cliff's delta = 0.79).

AI.tldr: IKKA是一种基于拓扑异常加权的鲁棒视觉伺服框架，通过将异常点视为结构性信息而非离群值，在嵌入式系统上显著提升了分布偏移下的控制精度和速度。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉伺服方法在处理分布偏移（如光照变化、遮挡）时通常将异常点视为离群值进行剔除，但这种方法可能丢弃了决策边界附近的关键结构性信息。IKKA的动机是将这些"异常点"重新定义为包含重要拓扑信息的观测点，从而在复杂环境下实现更鲁棒的控制。
AI.method: IKKA提出了一种拓扑驱动的异常加权框架，将局部极值性(E)、边界横截性(T)和多尺度持续性(M)三个拓扑特征组合成异常权重W(x)=E(x)×T(x)×M(x)。该方法将异常点视为结构性信息观测点，即微小扰动可能导致控制响应或类别分配发生质变的点。权重调制控制更新，特别是在模糊决策区域附近。该方法在Raspberry Pi 4上实现了CPU-only的嵌入式视觉伺服流水线。
AI.result: 在230次可重复实验中，IKKA在压力场景（昏暗光照和瞬时遮挡）下，相对于混合基线方法，将95%分位数横向误差降低了24%（从0.124降至0.094），同时将吞吐量从20.0Hz提升至24.8Hz。非参数分析显示具有大效应量（Cliff's delta = 0.79）。
AI.conclusion: IKKA通过将拓扑异常加权框架应用于视觉伺服，证明了将异常点视为结构性信息而非简单离群值的有效性。该方法在嵌入式平台上实现了显著的性能提升，为分布偏移下的鲁棒机器人控制提供了新思路。

title: PerMix-RLVR: Preserving Persona Expressivity under Verifiable-Reward Alignment
summary: Persona prompting has been widely adopted to steer large language models (LLMs) behavior and improve their instruction performance by assigning specific characters. However, identifying an optimal persona is time-consuming, and its impact on output quality remains poorly understood. Prior work has mainly addressed this issue at the prompt level via inference-time strategies, incurring additional computation. In this work, we avoid inference-time prompt search by tackling persona sensitivity during training, aiming to train models that adapt their behavior to diverse personas while preserving task performance. In particular, we find that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) systematically reduces sensitivity to persona prompts, but also reveals an inherent trade-off of outcome-based optimization: while RLVR improves robustness on tasks with verifiable goals, it can also degrade persona expressivity when needed, e.g., in-character role-playing. To address this limitation, we propose PerMix-RLVR, a persona-mixed RLVR strategy that mitigates the persona robustness-fidelity trade-off, preserving strong robustness to harmful persona variation while enabling faithful persona adoption when required. Concretely, PerMix-RLVR improves persona stability score (PSS) over RLVR by +21.2% on MATH500, while also enhancing persona fidelity by +11.4% on PersonaGym.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PerMix-RLVR方法，通过在训练阶段而非推理阶段处理persona敏感性，解决了LLMs中persona提示的鲁棒性与保真度之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有persona提示方法需要大量时间寻找最优persona，且对输出质量的影响不明确。传统方法主要在推理阶段通过提示搜索解决，这会增加计算开销。作者希望在训练阶段解决persona敏感性，使模型能适应不同persona同时保持任务性能。
AI.method: 研究发现基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能系统性地减少对persona提示的敏感性，但会揭示基于结果优化的内在权衡：RLVR在具有可验证目标的任务上提高了鲁棒性，但在需要角色扮演等场景中会降低persona表达能力。为此提出PerMix-RLVR策略，混合persona的RLVR方法，缓解鲁棒性与保真度的权衡。
AI.result: PerMix-RLVR在MATH500上将persona稳定性评分（PSS）相比RLVR提高了21.2%，同时在PersonaGym上将persona保真度提高了11.4%。该方法在保持对有害persona变化的强鲁棒性的同时，能在需要时实现忠实的persona采用。
AI.conclusion: PerMix-RLVR有效解决了LLMs中persona提示的鲁棒性与保真度权衡问题，通过在训练阶段而非推理阶段处理persona敏感性，实现了更好的模型适应性。

title: Adaptive Simulation Experiment for LLM Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significant potential to improve operational efficiency in operations management. Deploying these models requires specifying a policy that governs response quality, shapes user experience, and influences operational value. In this research, we treat LLMs as stochastic simulators and propose a pairwise comparison-based adaptive simulation experiment framework for identifying the optimal policy from a finite set of candidates. We consider two policy spaces: an unstructured space with no parametric assumption, and a structured space in which the data are generated from a preference model. For both settings, we characterize the fundamental data requirements for identifying the optimal policy with high probability. In the unstructured case, we derive a closed-form expression for the optimal sampling proportions, together with a clear operational interpretation. In the structured case, we formulate a regularized convex program to compute the optimal proportions. We then develop an adaptive experimental procedure, termed LLM-PO, for both policy spaces, and prove that it identifies the optimal policy with the desired statistical guarantee while asymptotically attaining the fundamental data requirements. Numerical experiments demonstrate that LLM-PO consistently outperforms benchmark methods and improves LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM-PO框架，通过成对比较的自适应仿真实验从有限候选策略中识别最优LLM部署策略
AI.motivation: LLM在运营管理中能显著提升效率，但部署时需要指定策略来管理响应质量、塑造用户体验并影响运营价值。现有方法缺乏系统性框架来识别最优策略
AI.method: 将LLM视为随机模拟器，提出基于成对比较的自适应仿真实验框架LLM-PO。考虑两种策略空间：无参数假设的非结构化空间和基于偏好模型的结构化空间。推导两种情况下识别最优策略的基本数据需求，并开发相应的自适应实验程序
AI.result: 在非结构化情况下推导出最优采样比例的闭式表达式；在结构化情况下提出正则化凸规划计算最优比例。证明LLM-PO能以期望统计保证识别最优策略，并渐近达到基本数据需求。数值实验显示LLM-PO持续优于基准方法并提升LLM性能
AI.conclusion: LLM-PO为LLM部署策略优化提供了系统框架，通过自适应实验设计有效识别最优策略，在理论和实践上都具有重要意义

title: ASTRA: Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture for Complex Table Question Answering
summary: Table serialization remains a critical bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) in complex table question answering, hindered by challenges such as structural neglect, representation gaps, and reasoning opacity. Existing serialization methods fail to capture explicit hierarchies and lack schema flexibility, while current tree-based approaches suffer from limited semantic adaptability. To address these limitations, we propose ASTRA (Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture) including two main modules, AdaSTR and DuTR. First, we introduce AdaSTR, which leverages the global semantic awareness of LLMs to reconstruct tables into Logical Semantic Trees. This serialization explicitly models hierarchical dependencies and employs an adaptive mechanism to optimize construction strategies based on table scale. Second, building on this structure, we present DuTR, a dual-mode reasoning framework that integrates tree-search-based textual navigation for linguistic alignment and symbolic code execution for precise verification. Experiments on complex table benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

AI.tldr: ASTRA框架通过AdaSTR将表格重构为逻辑语义树以捕获层次依赖，结合DuTR的双模式推理（树搜索文本导航+符号代码执行），在复杂表格问答中实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表格序列化方法存在结构忽视、表示差距和推理不透明等问题，无法捕获显式层次结构且缺乏模式灵活性，而基于树的方法语义适应性有限。
AI.method: 提出ASTRA框架：1) AdaSTR利用LLM的全局语义感知将表格重构为逻辑语义树，通过自适应机制优化构建策略；2) DuTR双模式推理框架，集成基于树搜索的文本导航和符号代码执行。
AI.result: 在复杂表格基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA通过自适应语义树序列化和双模式推理有效解决了表格序列化的关键瓶颈，提升了复杂表格问答的能力。

title: $p1$: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts
summary: Prompt optimization improves language models without updating their weights by searching for a better system prompt, but its effectiveness varies widely across tasks. We study what makes a task amenable to prompt optimization. We show that the reward variance across different system prompts can be decomposed into two components: variance among responses, which captures generation stochasticity, and variance among system prompts, which captures differences in system prompt quality. Prompt optimization succeeds when variance among system prompts is sufficiently large, but fails when variance among responses dominates the variance of the system prompts. Surprisingly, we further show that scaling to more user prompts can hurt optimization by reducing variance among system prompts, especially on heterogeneous datasets where different user prompts favor different system prompts. Motivated by this insight, we propose $p1$, a simple user prompt filtering method that selects a small subset of user prompts with high variance across candidate system prompts. This subset of user prompts allows one to distinguish a good system prompt from a bad one, making system optimization easier. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that $p1$ substantially improves prompt optimization over training on the full dataset and outperforms strong baselines such as GEPA. Notably, training on only two prompts from AIME 24 yields a system prompt that generalizes well to other reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了提示优化的有效性条件，发现系统提示间的方差是关键因素，并提出p1方法通过筛选用户提示来提升优化效果。
AI.motivation: 研究提示优化在不同任务中效果差异的原因，探究什么因素决定任务是否适合进行提示优化。
AI.method: 将奖励方差分解为响应间方差和系统提示间方差，提出p1用户提示筛选方法，选择在候选系统提示间方差高的用户提示子集进行优化。
AI.result: 实验显示p1方法在推理基准测试中显著优于完整数据集训练和GEPA基线，仅使用AIME 24中的两个提示就能获得泛化良好的系统提示。
AI.conclusion: 提示优化的成功取决于系统提示间方差是否足够大，p1方法通过筛选高方差用户提示有效提升优化效果，且具有很好的泛化能力。

title: M-IDoL: Information Decomposition for Modality-Specific and Diverse Representation Learning in Medical Foundation Model
summary: Medical foundation models (MFMs) aim to learn universal representations from multimodal medical images that can generalize effectively to diverse downstream clinical tasks. However, most existing MFMs suffer from information ambiguity that blend multimodal representations in a single embedding space, leading to the degradation of modality specificity and diversity. In this paper, we propose M-IDoL, a self-supervised \underline{\textit{M}}FM that introduces Information Decomposition for multimodal representation Learning via two objectives: i) maximize inter-modality entropy by dispersing multimodal representation into separable Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) subspaces to achieve representation specificity across modalities; and ii) minimize intra-modality uncertainty by performing fine-grained semantic discrimination within each MoE subspace to enrich representation diversity per modality. By pre-training on 1.15 million medical images, M-IDoL i) delivers superior generalization across 21 downstream clinical tasks, outperforming 20 foundation models on five imaging modalities (e.g., X-ray, fundus, OCT, dermoscopy and pathology), and ii) learns modality-specific and diverse representations, showing clearer separation of feature cluster across modalities and finer-grained feature discrimination within each modality.

AI.tldr: M-IDoL是一种自监督医学基础模型，通过信息分解学习多模态表示，使用MoE子空间实现模态特异性，并在每个子空间内进行细粒度语义判别以增强模态内多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基础模型存在信息模糊问题，将多模态表示混合在单一嵌入空间中，导致模态特异性和多样性退化。需要一种能够保持模态特异性同时增强模态内多样性的方法。
AI.method: 提出M-IDoL模型，采用信息分解学习框架：1) 最大化模态间熵，通过将多模态表示分散到可分离的MoE子空间来实现跨模态表示特异性；2) 最小化模态内不确定性，在每个MoE子空间内进行细粒度语义判别以丰富每个模态的表示多样性。
AI.result: 在115万张医学图像上预训练后，M-IDoL在21个下游临床任务上表现出卓越的泛化能力，在5种成像模态（X光、眼底、OCT、皮肤镜和病理）上优于20个基础模型。学习到的表示具有模态特异性且多样，显示出跨模态特征簇更清晰的分离和模态内更细粒度的特征判别。
AI.conclusion: M-IDoL通过信息分解学习框架有效解决了医学基础模型中的信息模糊问题，实现了更好的模态特异性和多样性，在多种下游临床任务上展现出优越的泛化性能。

title: Towards Linguistically-informed Representations for English as a Second or Foreign Language: Review, Construction and Application
summary: The widespread use of English as a Second or Foreign Language (ESFL) has sparked a paradigm shift: ESFL is not seen merely as a deviation from standard English but as a distinct linguistic system in its own right. This shift highlights the need for dedicated, knowledge-intensive representations of ESFL. In response, this paper surveys existing ESFL resources, identifies their limitations, and proposes a novel solution. Grounded in constructivist theories, the paper treats constructions as the fundamental units of analysis, allowing it to model the syntax--semantics interface of both ESFL and standard English. This design captures a wide range of ESFL phenomena by referring to syntactico-semantic mappings of English while preserving ESFL's unique characteristics, resulting a gold-standard syntactico-semantic resource comprising 1643 annotated ESFL sentences. To demonstrate the sembank's practical utility, we conduct a pilot study testing the Linguistic Niche Hypothesis, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool in Second Language Acquisition research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于构式理论的英语作为第二语言/外语(ESFL)句法-语义标注资源，包含1643个标注句子，用于支持二语习得研究。
AI.motivation: 英语作为第二语言/外语(ESFL)的广泛使用引发了范式转变：ESFL不再被视为标准英语的偏离，而是独特的语言系统。这凸显了对专门的、知识密集的ESFL表征的需求。现有ESFL资源存在局限性，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: 基于建构主义理论，将构式作为基本分析单位，能够同时建模ESFL和标准英语的句法-语义接口。通过参考英语的句法-语义映射来捕捉广泛的ESFL现象，同时保留ESFL的独特特征，创建了包含1643个标注句子的黄金标准句法-语义资源。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含1643个标注ESFL句子的黄金标准句法-语义资源库(sembank)。通过测试语言生态位假说的试点研究，证明了该资源在二语习得研究中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于构式理论的ESFL句法-语义标注资源填补了现有研究的空白，为二语习得研究提供了有价值的工具，能够支持对ESFL作为独特语言系统的深入分析。

title: MASS: Mesh-inellipse Aligned Deformable Surfel Splatting for Hand Reconstruction and Rendering from Egocentric Monocular Video
comment: This paper has been accepted to CVM 2026 Journal Track and is under consideration for publication in IEEE TVCG
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D hands from egocentric monocular videos remains a challenge due to the limitations in capturing high-resolution geometry, hand-object interactions, and complex objects on hands. Additionally, existing methods often incur high computational costs, making them impractical for real-time applications. In this work, we propose Mesh-inellipse Aligned deformable Surfel Splatting (MASS) to address these challenges by leveraging a deformable 2D Gaussian Surfel representation. We introduce the mesh-aligned Steiner Inellipse and fractal densification for mesh-to-surfel conversion that initiates high-resolution 2D Gaussian surfels from coarse parametric hand meshes, providing surface representation with photorealistic rendering potential. Second, we propose Gaussian Surfel Deformation, which enables efficient modeling of hand deformations and personalized features by predicting residual updates to surfel attributes and introducing an opacity mask to refine geometry and texture without adaptive density control. In addition, we propose a two-stage training strategy and a novel binding loss to improve the optimization robustness and reconstruction quality. Extensive experiments on the ARCTIC dataset, the Hand Appearance dataset, and the Interhand2.6M dataset demonstrate that our model achieves superior reconstruction performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MASS方法，使用可变形2D高斯Surfel表示从单目第一人称视频重建高保真3D手部，通过网格对齐Steiner内切椭圆和分形细化实现网格到Surfel转换，引入高斯Surfel变形高效建模手部形变，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从单目第一人称视频重建高保真3D手部面临挑战：难以捕获高分辨率几何、手-物体交互、复杂手部物体；现有方法计算成本高，不适用于实时应用。
AI.method: 1. 网格对齐Steiner内切椭圆和分形细化：从粗糙参数化手部网格初始化高分辨率2D高斯Surfel；2. 高斯Surfel变形：通过预测Surfel属性残差更新和引入不透明度掩码来建模手部形变和个性化特征；3. 两阶段训练策略和绑定损失：提升优化鲁棒性和重建质量。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC、Hand Appearance和Interhand2.6M数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比最先进方法实现了更优的重建性能。
AI.conclusion: MASS方法通过可变形2D高斯Surfel表示有效解决了单目第一人称视频中高保真3D手部重建的挑战，在多个数据集上表现出优越性能。

title: CONDESION-BENCH: Conditional Decision-Making of Large Language Models in Compositional Action Space
summary: Large language models have been widely explored as decision-support tools in high-stakes domains due to their contextual understanding and reasoning capabilities. However, existing decision-making benchmarks rely on two simplifying assumptions: actions are selected from a finite set of pre-defined candidates, and explicit conditions restricting action feasibility are not incorporated into the decision-making process. These assumptions fail to capture the compositional structure of real-world actions and the explicit conditions that constrain their validity. To address these limitations, we introduce CONDESION-BENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate conditional decision-making in compositional action space. In CONDESION-BENCH, actions are defined as allocations to decision variables and are restricted by explicit conditions at the variable, contextual, and allocation levels. By employing oracle-based evaluation of both decision quality and condition adherence, we provide a more rigorous assessment of LLMs as decision-support tools.

AI.tldr: CONDESION-BENCH是一个评估大语言模型在组合动作空间中条件决策能力的基准，解决了现有基准中动作来自预定义候选集且缺乏显式可行性条件限制的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有决策支持基准存在两个简化假设：1) 动作从预定义的有限候选集中选择；2) 决策过程中不包含限制动作可行性的显式条件。这些假设未能捕捉现实世界动作的组合结构及其有效性约束条件。
AI.method: 引入CONDESION-BENCH基准，将动作定义为对决策变量的分配，并在变量、上下文和分配三个层面施加显式条件约束。采用基于oracle的评估方法，同时评估决策质量和条件遵守情况。
AI.result: 通过CONDESION-BENCH提供了对大语言模型作为决策支持工具的更严格评估框架，能够更准确地反映模型在现实世界决策场景中的表现。
AI.conclusion: CONDESION-BENCH基准通过引入组合动作空间和显式条件约束，解决了现有决策评估基准的局限性，为评估大语言模型的决策支持能力提供了更严谨的框架。

title: Smartwatch-Based Sitting Time Estimation in Real-World Office Settings
comment: Accepted at the 18th International Conference on Machine Learning and Computing (ICMLC 2026), February 6-9, 2026
summary: Sedentary behavior poses a major public health risk, being strongly linked to obesity, cardiovascular disease, and other chronic conditions. Accurately estimating sitting time is therefore critical for monitoring and improving individual health. This work addresses the problem in real-world office settings, where signals from the inertial measurement units (IMU) on a smartwatch were collected from office workers during their daily routines. We propose a method that estimates sitting time from the IMU signals by introducing the use of rotation vector sequences, derived from Euler angles, as a novel representation of movement dynamics. Experiments on a 34-hour dataset demonstrate that exploiting rotation vector sequences improves algorithm performance, highlighting their potential for robust sitting time estimation in natural environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于智能手表IMU信号，利用旋转矢量序列估计办公室环境中久坐时间的方法
AI.motivation: 久坐行为对公共健康构成重大风险，与肥胖、心血管疾病等慢性病密切相关。准确估计久坐时间对于监测和改善个人健康至关重要，特别是在现实办公环境中。
AI.method: 从智能手表惯性测量单元(IMU)收集办公室工作人员日常活动信号，引入基于欧拉角导出的旋转矢量序列作为运动动态的新表示方法，用于估计久坐时间。
AI.result: 在34小时数据集上的实验表明，利用旋转矢量序列提高了算法性能，证明了其在自然环境中进行稳健久坐时间估计的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 旋转矢量序列作为IMU信号的新表示形式，能够有效改善现实办公环境中久坐时间的估计准确性，为健康监测提供了有前景的技术方案。

title: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches
summary: Accurate object geometry estimation is essential for many downstream tasks, including robotic manipulation and physical interaction. Although vision is the dominant modality for shape perception, it becomes unreliable under occlusions or challenging lighting conditions. In such scenarios, tactile sensing provides direct geometric information through physical contact. However, reconstructing global 3D geometry from sparse local touches alone is fundamentally underconstrained. We present TouchAnything, a framework that leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements. Unlike prior work that trains category-specific reconstruction networks or learns diffusion models directly from tactile data, we transfer the geometric knowledge encoded in pretrained visual diffusion models to the tactile domain. Given sparse contact constraints and a coarse class-level description of the object, we formulate reconstruction as an optimization problem that enforces tactile consistency while guiding solutions toward shapes consistent with the diffusion prior. Our method reconstructs accurate geometries from only a few touches, outperforms existing baselines, and enables open-world 3D reconstruction of previously unseen object instances. Our project page is https://grange007.github.io/touchanything .

AI.tldr: TouchAnything利用预训练的大规模2D视觉扩散模型作为语义和几何先验，从稀疏触觉测量中重建3D几何，仅需少量触摸即可实现精确重建
AI.motivation: 视觉感知在遮挡或光照条件差时不可靠，而触觉传感通过物理接触提供直接几何信息。然而，仅从稀疏局部触摸重建全局3D几何本质上是不适定问题，需要先验知识来约束解空间
AI.method: 利用预训练的2D视觉扩散模型作为语义和几何先验，将稀疏接触约束和粗略类别描述作为输入，将重建问题表述为优化问题：在保持触觉一致性的同时，引导解向与扩散先验一致的形状收敛
AI.result: 仅需少量触摸即可重建精确几何，优于现有基线方法，能够实现未见过的物体实例的开放世界3D重建
AI.conclusion: TouchAnything成功将预训练视觉扩散模型中的几何知识迁移到触觉领域，为稀疏触觉测量下的3D重建提供了有效框架，在机器人操作和物理交互等下游任务中具有重要应用价值

title: Anchored Sliding Window: Toward Robust and Imperceptible Linguistic Steganography
summary: Linguistic steganography based on language models typically assumes that steganographic texts are transmitted without alteration, making them fragile to even minor modifications. While previous work mitigates this fragility by limiting the context window, it significantly compromises text quality. In this paper, we propose the anchored sliding window (ASW) framework to improve imperceptibility and robustness. In addition to the latest tokens, the prompt and a bridge context are anchored within the context window, encouraging the model to compensate for the excluded tokens. We formulate the optimization of the bridge context as a variant of prompt distillation, which we further extend using self-distillation strategies. Experiments show that our ASW significantly and consistently outperforms the baseline method in text quality, imperceptibility, and robustness across diverse settings. The code is available at github.com/ryehr/ASW_steganography.

AI.tldr: 提出锚定滑动窗口框架，通过锚定提示和桥接上下文来提升语言模型隐写术的鲁棒性和不可感知性，解决了传统方法对文本修改敏感的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统基于语言模型的隐写术假设隐写文本在传输过程中不被修改，对微小改动非常脆弱。现有方法通过限制上下文窗口来缓解脆弱性，但这严重损害了文本质量。
AI.method: 提出锚定滑动窗口框架，在上下文窗口中不仅包含最新标记，还锚定提示和桥接上下文，鼓励模型补偿被排除的标记。将桥接上下文优化公式化为提示蒸馏的变体，并进一步使用自蒸馏策略进行扩展。
AI.result: 实验表明，ASW在不同设置下在文本质量、不可感知性和鲁棒性方面显著且一致地优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 锚定滑动窗口框架有效提升了语言模型隐写术的鲁棒性和不可感知性，解决了传统方法的脆弱性问题，同时保持了高质量的文本生成。

title: Structural Evaluation Metrics for SVG Generation via Leave-One-Out Analysis
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) represent visual content as structured, editable code. Each element (path, shape, or text node) can be individually inspected, transformed, or removed. This structural editability is a main motivation for SVG generation, yet prevailing evaluation protocols primarily reduce the output to a single similarity score against a reference image or input texts, measuring how faithfully the result reproduces an image or follows the instructions, but not how well it preserves the structural properties that make SVG valuable. In particular, existing metrics cannot determine which generated elements contribute positively to overall visual quality, how visual concepts map to specific parts of the code, or whether the generated output supports meaningful downstream editing. We introduce element-level leave-one-out (LOO) analysis, inspired by the classic jackknife estimator. The procedure renders the SVG with and without each element, measures the resulting visual change, and derives a suite of structural quality metrics. Despite its simplicity, the jackknife's capacity to decompose an aggregate statistic into per-sample contributions translates directly to this setting. From a single mechanism, we obtain: (1) quality scores per element through LOO scoring that enable zero-shot artifact detection; (2) concept-element attribution that maps each element to the visual concept it serves; and (3) four structural metrics, purity, coverage, compactness, and locality, that quantify SVG modularity from complementary perspectives. We validate these metrics on over 19,000 edits (5 types) across 5 generation systems and 3 complexity tiers.

AI.tldr: 提出基于留一法(LOO)的元素级分析框架，用于评估SVG生成的结构化质量，包括元素质量评分、概念-元素归因和四个结构度量指标。
AI.motivation: 当前SVG生成评估主要关注图像相似度，忽视了SVG的结构化可编辑性这一核心价值。现有指标无法评估哪些元素对视觉质量有贡献、视觉概念如何映射到代码部分，以及生成结果是否支持有意义的后续编辑。
AI.method: 引入元素级留一法分析，受经典折刀估计器启发。对SVG中的每个元素，分别渲染包含和不包含该元素的版本，测量视觉变化，从而推导出一套结构化质量度量指标。
AI.result: 从单一机制获得：(1)通过LOO评分的元素质量分数，支持零样本伪影检测；(2)概念-元素归因，将每个元素映射到其服务的视觉概念；(3)四个结构度量指标：纯度、覆盖率、紧凑性和局部性，从互补角度量化SVG模块化程度。在5个生成系统和3个复杂度层级上验证了超过19,000次编辑。
AI.conclusion: 提出的留一法分析框架能够有效评估SVG生成的结构化质量，弥补了现有评估仅关注视觉相似度的不足，为SVG生成系统的开发和优化提供了重要的评估工具。

title: Low-Data Supervised Adaptation Outperforms Prompting for Cloud Segmentation Under Domain Shift
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, to be published in EarthVision @ CVPR 2026
summary: Adapting vision-language models to remote sensing imagery presents a fundamental challenge: both the visual and linguistic distributions of satellite data lie far outside natural image pretraining corpora. Despite this, prompting remains the dominant deployment paradigm, driven by the assumption that domain-specific language can guide frozen model representations toward specialized tasks. We test this assumption directly on a domain where the mismatch is prominent: cloud segmentation for satellite imagery. Using CLIPSeg on the CloudSEN12+ cloud segmentation benchmark, we evaluate 60 prompt variants spanning simple labels, domain terminology, appearance descriptors, and contextual cues, finding that every variant underperforms the zero-shot baseline (0.255 mIoU), with engineered prompts scoring as low as 0.07 mIoU. No amount of linguistic refinement bridges the gap between CLIP's natural image representations and satellite spectral imagery. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning with just 0.1% labeled data (~8 images) surpasses zero-shot performance overall, and 5-10% data recovers ~85% of maximum achievable mIoU. Full fine-tuning consistently outperforms low-rank adaptation by 0.03-0.09 mIoU, with the largest gaps for spectrally ambiguous classes, and at 0.5 to 1% labeled data, fine-tuning temporarily degrades performance on these classes before recovering, a supervision dip that aggregate mIoU can mask. For practitioners adapting vision-language models to specialized imagery, our results deliver a clear message: labeled data is not the expensive alternative to prompting; it is the worthwhile path.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在遥感云分割任务中，提示工程无法弥补CLIP自然图像表示与卫星光谱图像之间的分布差异，而少量有标签数据的监督微调即可显著超越零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是验证在视觉-语言模型适应遥感图像时，提示工程是否能够有效弥补自然图像预训练与卫星数据之间的分布差异，特别是在云分割这一典型任务上。
AI.method: 使用CLIPSeg模型在CloudSEN12+云分割基准上评估60种提示变体，包括简单标签、领域术语、外观描述符和上下文线索。同时进行监督微调实验，比较不同比例标注数据（0.1%-100%）下的性能，并对比全微调与低秩适应方法。
AI.result: 所有提示变体均表现不佳（最低0.07 mIoU），全部低于零样本基线（0.255 mIoU）。相反，仅使用0.1%标注数据（约8张图像）的监督微调即可超越零样本性能，5-10%数据可达到最大可达到mIoU的约85%。全微调始终优于低秩适应（差距0.03-0.09 mIoU），且在光谱模糊类别上表现更明显。
AI.conclusion: 对于将视觉-语言模型适应到专业图像领域，标注数据不是提示工程的昂贵替代方案，而是值得投入的有效路径。语言提示无法弥补自然图像表示与卫星光谱图像之间的分布差异。

title: NyayaMind- A Framework for Transparent Legal Reasoning and Judgment Prediction in the Indian Legal System
summary: Court Judgment Prediction and Explanation (CJPE) aims to predict a judicial decision and provide a legally grounded explanation for a given case based on the facts, legal issues, arguments, cited statutes, and relevant precedents. For such systems to be practically useful in judicial or legal research settings, they must not only achieve high predictive performance but also generate transparent and structured legal reasoning that aligns with established judicial practices. In this work, we present NyayaMind, an open-source framework designed to enable transparent and scalable legal reasoning for the Indian judiciary. The proposed framework integrates retrieval, reasoning, and verification mechanisms to emulate the structured decision-making process typically followed in courts. Specifically, NyayaMind consists of two main components: a Retrieval Module and a Prediction Module. The Retrieval Module employs a RAG pipeline to identify legally relevant statutes and precedent cases from large-scale legal corpora, while the Prediction Module utilizes reasoning-oriented LLMs fine-tuned for the Indian legal domain to generate structured outputs including issues, arguments, rationale, and the final decision. Our extensive results and expert evaluation demonstrate that NyayaMind significantly improves the quality of explanation and evidence alignment compared to existing CJPE approaches, providing a promising step toward trustworthy AI-assisted legal decision support systems.

AI.tldr: NyayaMind是一个用于印度司法系统的开源法律推理框架，通过检索-预测模块实现透明、可扩展的判决预测与解释，显著提升解释质量和证据对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有的法庭判决预测与解释系统在实际司法或法律研究应用中，不仅需要高预测性能，还必须生成透明、结构化且符合司法实践的法律推理。需要开发一个能够模拟法庭结构化决策过程的可信AI辅助法律决策支持系统。
AI.method: NyayaMind框架包含两个主要组件：检索模块和预测模块。检索模块采用RAG管道从大规模法律语料库中识别相关法律条文和先例案例；预测模块使用针对印度法律领域微调、面向推理的大语言模型，生成包括问题、论点、理据和最终判决的结构化输出。框架集成了检索、推理和验证机制来模拟法庭的决策过程。
AI.result: 广泛的实验结果和专家评估表明，NyayaMind相比现有的CJPE方法，显著提高了解释质量和证据对齐，为可信的AI辅助法律决策支持系统提供了有前景的一步。
AI.conclusion: NyayaMind是一个开源框架，能够实现透明、可扩展的法律推理，专门为印度司法系统设计。该框架通过集成检索、推理和验证机制，模拟法庭的结构化决策过程，在解释质量和证据对齐方面表现优异，是迈向可信AI辅助法律决策支持系统的重要进展。

title: Dynamic Class-Aware Active Learning for Unbiased Satellite Image Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation of satellite imagery plays a vital role in land cover mapping and environmental monitoring. However, annotating large-scale, high-resolution satellite datasets is costly and time consuming, especially when covering vast geographic regions. Instead of randomly labeling data or exhaustively annotating entire datasets, Active Learning (AL) offers an efficient alternative by intelligently selecting the most informative samples for annotation with the help of Human-in-the-loop (HITL), thereby reducing labeling costs while maintaining high model performance. AL is particularly beneficial for large-scale or resource-constrained satellite applications, as it enables high segmentation accuracy with significantly fewer labeled samples. Despite these advantages, standard AL strategies typically rely on global uncertainty or diversity measures and lack the adaptability to target underperforming or rare classes as training progresses, leading to bias in the system. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel adaptive acquisition function, Dynamic Class-Aware Uncertainty based Active learning (DCAU-AL) that prioritizes sample selection based on real-time class-wise performance gaps, thereby overcoming class-imbalance issue. The proposed DCAU-AL mechanism continuously tracks the performance of the segmentation per class and dynamically adjusts the sampling weights to focus on poorly performing or underrepresented classes throughout the active learning process. Extensive experiments on the OpenEarth land cover dataset show that DCAU-AL significantly outperforms existing AL methods, especially under severe class imbalance, delivering superior per-class IoU and improved annotation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出DCAU-AL方法，通过动态跟踪每类分割性能并调整采样权重，解决卫星图像语义分割中主动学习的类别不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 卫星图像语义分割标注成本高昂，主动学习可减少标注需求但现有方法缺乏对类别不平衡的适应性，导致系统偏差。
AI.method: 提出动态类别感知不确定性主动学习(DCAU-AL)，实时跟踪每类分割性能，根据性能差距动态调整采样权重，优先选择表现差或代表性不足的类别样本。
AI.result: 在OpenEarth土地覆盖数据集上，DCAU-AL显著优于现有主动学习方法，尤其在严重类别不平衡情况下，获得更好的每类IoU和标注效率。
AI.conclusion: DCAU-AL通过动态类别感知采样有效解决主动学习中的类别不平衡问题，为大规模卫星图像分割提供高效标注解决方案。

title: Hierarchical Alignment: Enforcing Hierarchical Instruction-Following in LLMs through Logical Consistency
summary: Large language models increasingly operate under multiple instructions from heterogeneous sources with different authority levels, including system policies, user requests, tool outputs, and retrieved context. While prior work on instruction hierarchy highlights the importance of respecting instruction priorities, it mainly focuses on adversarial attacks and overlooks the benign but common instruction conflicts that arise in real-world applications. In such settings, models must not only avoid security violations but also preserve task utility and behavioral consistency when instructions partially or implicitly conflict. We propose Neuro-Symbolic Hierarchical Alignment (NSHA) for hierarchical instruction-following by explicitly modeling and enforcing instruction priorities. At inference time, we introduce solver-guided reasoning that formulates instruction resolution as a constraint satisfaction problem, enabling the model to derive a maximally consistent set of applicable instructions under hierarchical constraints. At training time, NSHA distills solver-based decisions into model parameters using automatically constructed supervision. We evaluate our approach on rule following, task execution, tool use, and safety, covering both single-turn and multi-turn interactions, and show that NSHA significantly improves performance under such conflicts while maintaining competitive utility in reference settings.

AI.tldr: NSHA提出神经符号层次对齐方法，通过显式建模指令优先级来解决真实应用中常见的良性指令冲突，在推理时使用求解器引导推理将指令解析建模为约束满足问题，训练时通过自动构建的监督将求解器决策蒸馏到模型参数中。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在异构来源的多重指令下运行，包括系统策略、用户请求、工具输出和检索上下文。现有工作主要关注对抗攻击，忽视了真实应用中常见的良性指令冲突。模型不仅需要避免安全违规，还需要在指令部分或隐式冲突时保持任务效用和行为一致性。
AI.method: 提出神经符号层次对齐（NSHA）方法：1）推理时采用求解器引导推理，将指令解析建模为约束满足问题，在层次约束下推导最大一致的可应用指令集；2）训练时使用自动构建的监督将求解器决策蒸馏到模型参数中。
AI.result: 在规则遵循、任务执行、工具使用和安全等多个领域评估NSHA，涵盖单轮和多轮交互。结果显示NSHA在指令冲突情况下显著提升性能，同时在参考设置中保持竞争力的效用。
AI.conclusion: NSHA通过显式建模和执行指令优先级，有效解决了真实应用中常见的指令冲突问题，在保持安全性的同时提升了任务效用和行为一致性，为层次化指令跟随提供了系统化解决方案。

title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Pre-training on Ascend NPUs
summary: Large foundation models have become central to modern machine learning, with performance scaling predictably with model size and data. However, training and deploying such models incur substantial computational and memory costs, motivating the development of low-precision training techniques. Recent work has demonstrated that 4-bit floating-point (FP4) formats--such as MXFP4 and NVFP4--can be successfully applied to linear GEMM operations in large language models (LLMs), achieving up to 4x improvements in compute throughput and memory efficiency compared to higher-precision baselines. In this work, we investigate the recently proposed HiFloat4 FP4 format for Huawei Ascend NPUs and systematically compare it with MXFP4 in large-scale training settings. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPU clusters, with linear and expert GEMM operations performed entirely in FP4 precision. We evaluate both dense architectures (e.g., Pangu and LLaMA-style models) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, where both standard linear layers and expert-specific GEMMs operate in FP4. Furthermore, we explore stabilization techniques tailored to FP4 training that significantly reduce numerical degradation, maintaining relative error within 1% of full-precision baselines while preserving the efficiency benefits of 4-bit computation. Our results provide a comprehensive empirical study of FP4 training on NPUs and highlight the practical trade-offs between FP4 formats in large-scale dense and MoE models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了华为昇腾NPU上的HiFloat4 FP4格式与MXFP4格式在大规模训练中的表现，包括稠密模型和MoE模型，并提出了针对FP4训练的稳定化技术，在保持4位计算效率的同时将相对误差控制在1%以内。
AI.motivation: 大型基础模型的计算和内存成本高昂，促使开发低精度训练技术。虽然已有研究证明4位浮点格式（如MXFP4和NVFP4）能在线性GEMM操作中实现4倍计算吞吐和内存效率提升，但针对华为昇腾NPU的HiFloat4 FP4格式在大规模训练中的表现尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在昇腾NPU集群上进行实验，完全使用FP4精度执行线性和专家GEMM操作。评估稠密架构（如Pangu和LLaMA风格模型）和混合专家（MoE）模型，其中标准线性层和专家特定GEMM均在FP4下运行。探索针对FP4训练的稳定化技术以减少数值退化。
AI.result: 稳定化技术显著减少了数值退化，将相对误差维持在完整精度基线的1%以内，同时保持了4位计算的效率优势。研究提供了FP4在NPU上训练的全面实证研究，并突出了大规模稠密和MoE模型中FP4格式的实际权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统比较了HiFloat4 FP4与MXFP4在昇腾NPU上的表现，证明了FP4格式在大规模训练中的可行性，通过稳定化技术实现了效率与精度的良好平衡，为低精度训练在NPU平台上的应用提供了实践指导。

title: Post-Hoc Guidance for Consistency Models by Joint Flow Distribution Learning
summary: Classifier-free Guidance (CFG) lets practitioners trade-off fidelity against diversity in Diffusion Models (DMs). The practicality of CFG is however hindered by DMs sampling cost. On the other hand, Consistency Models (CMs) generate images in one or a few steps, but existing guidance methods require knowledge distillation from a separate DM teacher, limiting CFG to Consistency Distillation (CD) methods. We propose Joint Flow Distribution Learning (JFDL), a lightweight alignment method enabling guidance in a pre-trained CM. With a pre-trained CM as an ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver, we verify with normality tests that the variance-exploding noise implied by the velocity fields from unconditional and conditional distributions is Gaussian. In practice, JFDL equips CMs with the familiar adjustable guidance knob, yielding guided images with similar characteristics to CFG. Applied to an original Consistency Trained (CT) CM that could only do conditional sampling, JFDL unlocks guided generation and reduces FID on both CIFAR-10 and ImageNet 64x64 datasets. This is the first time that CMs are able to receive effective guidance post-hoc without a DM teacher, thus, bridging a key gap in current methods for CMs.

AI.tldr: JFDL是一种轻量级对齐方法，使预训练的一致性模型能够实现事后引导生成，无需扩散模型教师，填补了当前一致性模型方法的空白。
AI.motivation: 无分类器引导(CFG)在扩散模型中实现了保真度与多样性的权衡，但采样成本高；一致性模型(CMs)采样速度快，但现有引导方法需要从扩散模型教师进行知识蒸馏，限制了CFG在一致性蒸馏方法中的应用。
AI.method: 提出联合流分布学习(JFDL)，这是一种轻量级对齐方法，利用预训练的一致性模型作为常微分方程求解器，通过正态性检验验证无条件分布和条件分布的速度场隐含的方差爆炸噪声是高斯分布，从而在预训练的一致性模型中实现引导。
AI.result: JFDL为一致性模型提供了可调节的引导旋钮，生成具有CFG类似特性的引导图像；应用于原始的一致性训练模型后，解锁了引导生成功能，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet 64x64数据集上降低了FID分数。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次实现一致性模型无需扩散模型教师即可获得有效事后引导的方法，填补了当前一致性模型方法的关键空白。

title: Prototype-Regularized Federated Learning for Cross-Domain Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
summary: Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) aims to extract all sentiment triplets of aspect terms, opinion terms, and sentiment polarities from a sentence. Existing methods are typically trained on individual datasets in isolation, failing to jointly capture the common feature representations shared across domains. Moreover, data privacy constraints prevent centralized data aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose Prototype-based Cross-Domain Span Prototype extraction (PCD-SpanProto), a prototype-regularized federated learning framework to enable distributed clients to exchange class-level prototypes instead of full model parameters. Specifically, we design a weighted performance-aware aggregation strategy and a contrastive regularization module to improve the global prototype under domain heterogeneity and the promotion between intra-class compactness and inter-class separability across clients. Extensive experiments on four ASTE datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines and reduces communication costs, validating the effectiveness of prototype-based cross-domain knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出PCD-SpanProto框架，通过原型正则化的联邦学习实现跨领域情感三元组提取，用类级原型交换替代完整模型参数传输，降低通信成本并提升跨领域知识迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有ASTE方法通常在孤立数据集上训练，无法捕捉跨领域共享特征表示，且数据隐私限制阻碍集中式数据聚合，需要解决跨领域知识迁移和隐私保护的双重挑战。
AI.method: 提出原型正则化联邦学习框架PCD-SpanProto，设计加权性能感知聚合策略和对比正则化模块，通过交换类级原型而非完整模型参数，在领域异构性下改进全局原型并促进类内紧凑性和类间分离性。
AI.result: 在四个ASTE数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于基线方法，同时显著降低了通信成本，验证了基于原型的跨领域知识迁移的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PCD-SpanProto通过原型正则化联邦学习成功解决了ASTE任务中的跨领域知识迁移和隐私保护问题，为分布式场景下的情感分析提供了有效解决方案。

title: Hierarchical Kernel Transformer: Multi-Scale Attention with an Information-Theoretic Approximation Analysis
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables submitted to Neurocomputing
summary: The Hierarchical Kernel Transformer (HKT) is a multi-scale attention mechanism that processes sequences at L resolution levels via trainable causal downsampling, combining level-specific score matrices through learned convex weights. The total computational cost is bounded by 4/3 times that of standard attention, reaching 1.3125x for L = 3. Four theoretical results are established. (i) The hierarchical score matrix defines a positive semidefinite kernel under a sufficient condition on the symmetrised bilinear form (Proposition 3.1). (ii) The asymmetric score matrix decomposes uniquely into a symmetric part controlling reciprocal attention and an antisymmetric part controlling directional attention; HKT provides L independent such pairs across scales, one per resolution level (Propositions 3.5-3.6). (iii) The approximation error decomposes into three interpretable components with an explicit non-Gaussian correction and a geometric decay bound in L (Theorem 4.3, Proposition 4.4). (iv) HKT strictly subsumes single-head standard attention and causal convolution (Proposition 3.4). Experiments over 3 random seeds show consistent gains over retrained standard attention baselines: +4.77pp on synthetic ListOps (55.10+-0.29% vs 50.33+-0.12%, T = 512), +1.44pp on sequential CIFAR-10 (35.45+-0.09% vs 34.01+-0.19%, T = 1,024), and +7.47pp on IMDB character-level sentiment (70.19+-0.57% vs 62.72+-0.40%, T = 1,024), all at 1.31x overhead.

AI.tldr: HKT是一种多尺度注意力机制，通过可训练的因果下采样在L个分辨率级别处理序列，使用学习到的凸权重组合级别特定得分矩阵，计算成本仅为标准注意力的4/3倍。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制在长序列处理上计算成本高，缺乏多尺度表示能力。HKT旨在通过分层结构在保持计算效率的同时捕获不同时间尺度的依赖关系。
AI.method: HKT使用可训练的因果下采样在L个分辨率级别处理序列，每个级别生成独立的得分矩阵，通过学习到的凸权重组合这些矩阵。该方法包含对称部分控制互惠注意力和反对称部分控制方向性注意力。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了四个结果：分层得分矩阵的正半定核性质、得分矩阵的对称-反对称分解、近似误差的三个可解释分量分解、以及HKT严格包含标准注意力和因果卷积。实验显示在三个数据集上均优于标准注意力基线：ListOps (+4.77pp)、sequential CIFAR-10 (+1.44pp)、IMDB (+7.47pp)，计算开销仅为1.31倍。
AI.conclusion: HKT提供了一种计算高效的多尺度注意力机制，在理论上有严格保证，实验上优于标准注意力，计算开销可控，适用于长序列处理任务。

title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos
summary: Small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos remains a significant challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), despite its practical value for object search and assistive applications. Although existing benchmarks have advanced video spatial intelligence, embodied reasoning, and diagnostic perception, no existing benchmark directly evaluates whether a model can localize a target object in video and express its position with sufficient precision for downstream use. In this work, we introduce PinpointQA, the first dataset and benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos. Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, PinpointQA comprises 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs organized into four progressively challenging tasks: Target Presence Verification (TPV), Nearest Reference Identification (NRI), Fine-Grained Spatial Description (FSD), and Structured Spatial Prediction (SSP). The dataset is built from intermediate spatial representations, with QA pairs generated automatically and further refined through quality control. Experiments on representative MLLMs reveal a consistent capability gap along the progressive chain, with SSP remaining particularly difficult. Supervised fine-tuning on PinpointQA yields substantial gains, especially on the harder tasks, demonstrating that PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training dataset. The dataset and project page are available at https://rainchowz.github.io/PinpointQA.

AI.tldr: PinpointQA是首个针对室内视频中小物体空间理解的数据集和基准测试，包含四个渐进式挑战任务，用于评估MLLMs在视频中定位目标物体并精确描述其位置的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试在视频空间智能、具身推理和诊断感知方面有所进展，但缺乏直接评估模型能否在视频中定位目标物体并以足够精度表达其位置以供下游使用的基准。室内视频中的小物体中心空间理解具有实际应用价值（如物体搜索和辅助应用），但目前仍是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: 基于ScanNet++和ScanNet200构建了包含1,024个场景和10,094个QA对的数据集。采用中间空间表示自动生成QA对，并通过质量控制进一步优化。设计了四个渐进式挑战任务：目标存在验证(TPV)、最近参考识别(NRI)、细粒度空间描述(FSD)和结构化空间预测(SSP)。
AI.result: 在代表性MLLMs上的实验显示，随着任务难度递增，模型能力存在一致性的差距，其中SSP任务尤其困难。在PinpointQA上进行监督微调带来了显著提升，特别是在较难任务上，表明该数据集既可作为诊断基准，也可作为有效的训练数据集。
AI.conclusion: PinpointQA填补了室内视频小物体空间理解评估的空白，为MLLMs提供了系统性的诊断工具和训练资源，有助于推动该领域的研究进展。

title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks by leveraging long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but often suffer from overthinking, leading to excessive reasoning steps and high inference latency. Existing CoT compression methods struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency, and lack fine-grained, step-level adaptation to redundancy and reasoning bias. Therefore, we propose State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance (STACK), a framework that performs step-wise CoT compression by explicitly modeling stage-specific redundancy sources and integrating with a retrieval-augmented guidance. STACK constructs online long-short contrastive samples and dynamically switches between knowledge-guided compression for uncertain or biased reasoning state and self-prompted compression for overly long but confident state, complemented by an answer-convergence-based early stopping mechanism to suppress redundant verification. We further propose a reward-difference-driven training strategy by combining Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), enabling models to learn state-conditioned compression strategies. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that STACK achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency balance, reducing average response length by 59.9% while improving accuracy by 4.8 points over existing methods.

AI.tldr: STACK框架通过状态感知推理压缩与知识引导，实现细粒度步骤级CoT压缩，平衡推理准确性与效率
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在复杂任务中依赖长链式思维，但存在过度思考问题，导致推理步骤过多、推理延迟高。现有CoT压缩方法难以平衡准确性与效率，缺乏对冗余和推理偏差的细粒度步骤级适应。
AI.method: 提出STACK框架：1) 显式建模阶段特定冗余源，结合检索增强引导；2) 构建在线长短对比样本，动态切换知识引导压缩（针对不确定或有偏推理状态）与自提示压缩（针对过长但自信状态）；3) 基于答案收敛的早停机制抑制冗余验证；4) 结合PPO和DPO的奖励差异驱动训练策略，学习状态条件压缩策略。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准测试中，STACK实现了优越的准确率-效率平衡：相比现有方法，平均响应长度减少59.9%，准确率提升4.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: STACK通过状态感知推理压缩与知识引导，有效解决了长CoT推理中的过度思考问题，在保持准确性的同时显著提升推理效率，为大型推理模型的优化提供了新思路。

title: Discrete Meanflow Training Curriculum
summary: Flow-based image generative models exhibit stable training and produce high quality samples when using multi-step sampling procedures. One-step generative models can produce high quality image samples but can be difficult to optimize as they often exhibit unstable training dynamics. Meanflow models exhibit excellent few-step sampling performance and tantalizing one-step sampling performance. Notably, MeanFlow models that achieve this have required extremely large training budgets. We significantly decrease the amount of computation and data budget it takes to train Meanflow models by noting and exploiting a particular discretization of the Meanflow objective that yields a consistency property which we formulate into a ``Discrete Meanflow'' (DMF) Training Curriculum. Initialized with a pretrained Flow Model, DMF curriculum reaches one-step FID 3.36 on CIFAR-10 in only 2000 epochs. We anticipate that faster training curriculums of Meanflow models, specifically those fine-tuned from existing Flow Models, drives efficient training methods of future one-step examples.

AI.tldr: 提出Discrete Meanflow (DMF)训练课程，显著降低MeanFlow模型的训练计算和数据需求，实现高效的一步生成
AI.motivation: 基于流的图像生成模型在多步采样中表现稳定且质量高，但一步生成模型训练困难且不稳定。MeanFlow模型在少步采样中表现优秀，但现有方法需要极大的训练预算
AI.method: 利用MeanFlow目标函数的特定离散化，提出具有一致性性质的Discrete Meanflow (DMF)训练课程。从预训练的Flow模型初始化，采用DMF课程进行训练
AI.result: DMF课程仅需2000个epoch就在CIFAR-10上达到一步FID 3.36，显著降低了训练计算和数据需求
AI.conclusion: DMF训练课程为MeanFlow模型提供了高效的训练方法，特别是从现有Flow模型微调，将推动未来一步生成模型的高效训练方法发展

title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
summary: With the advancement of interactive video generation, diffusion models have increasingly demonstrated their potential as world models. However, existing approaches still struggle to simultaneously achieve memory-enabled long-term temporal consistency and high-resolution real-time generation, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. To address this, we present Matrix-Game 3.0, a memory-augmented interactive world model designed for 720p real-time longform video generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 2.0, we introduce systematic improvements across data, model, and inference. First, we develop an upgraded industrial-scale infinite data engine that integrates Unreal Engine-based synthetic data, large-scale automated collection from AAA games, and real-world video augmentation to produce high-quality Video-Pose-Action-Prompt quadruplet data at scale. Second, we propose a training framework for long-horizon consistency: by modeling prediction residuals and re-injecting imperfect generated frames during training, the base model learns self-correction; meanwhile, camera-aware memory retrieval and injection enable the base model to achieve long horizon spatiotemporal consistency. Third, we design a multi-segment autoregressive distillation strategy based on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), combined with model quantization and VAE decoder pruning, to achieve efficient real-time inference. Experimental results show that Matrix-Game 3.0 achieves up to 40 FPS real-time generation at 720p resolution with a 5B model, while maintaining stable memory consistency over minute-long sequences. Scaling up to a 2x14B model further improves generation quality, dynamics, and generalization. Our approach provides a practical pathway toward industrial-scale deployable world models.

AI.tldr: Matrix-Game 3.0是一个内存增强的交互式世界模型，用于720p实时长视频生成，通过数据、模型和推理的系统改进，实现了40 FPS的实时生成和分钟级序列的稳定内存一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在交互式视频生成中难以同时实现内存支持的长时时间一致性和高分辨率实时生成，限制了在实际场景中的应用。需要解决长时一致性与实时性能的平衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 升级工业级无限数据引擎，整合虚幻引擎合成数据、AAA游戏大规模自动采集和真实视频增强；2) 长时一致性训练框架：建模预测残差、训练中重新注入不完美生成帧实现自校正，相机感知内存检索和注入；3) 基于DMD的多段自回归蒸馏策略，结合模型量化和VAE解码器剪枝实现高效实时推理。
AI.result: 5B模型在720p分辨率下实现高达40 FPS的实时生成，保持分钟级序列的稳定内存一致性。扩展到2x14B模型进一步提升了生成质量、动态性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Matrix-Game 3.0为工业级可部署的世界模型提供了实用路径，成功解决了长时时间一致性与高分辨率实时生成的平衡问题。

title: Spectral Geometry of LoRA Adapters Encodes Training Objective and Predicts Harmful Compliance
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, pre-registered experiment, data at https://github.com/roip/task-geometry-experiment-results
summary: We study whether low-rank spectral summaries of LoRA weight deltas can identify which fine-tuning objective was applied to a language model, and whether that geometric signal predicts downstream behavioral harm. In a pre-registered experiment on \texttt{Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct}, we manufacture 38 LoRA adapters across four categories: healthy SFT baselines, DPO on inverted harmlessness preferences, DPO on inverted helpfulness preferences, and activation-steering-derived adapters, and extract per-layer spectral features (norms, stable rank, singular-value entropy, effective rank, and singular-vector cosine alignment to a healthy centroid). Within a single training method (DPO), a logistic regression classifier achieves AUC~1.00 on binary drift detection, all six pairwise objective comparisons, and near-perfect ordinal severity ranking ($ρ\geq 0.956$). Principal component analysis on flattened weight deltas reveals that training objective is PC1 (AUC~1.00 for objective separation), orthogonal to training duration on PC2. Query-projection weights detect that drift occurred; value-projection weights identify which objective. Cross-method generalization fails completely: a DPO-trained classifier assigns every steering adapter a lower drift score than every DPO adapter (AUC~0.00). In a behavioral evaluation phase, DPO-inverted-harmlessness adapters show elevated harmful compliance on HEx-PHI prompts (mean ASR 0.266 vs.\ healthy 0.112, $Δ= +0.154$), with near-perfect dose--response ($ρ= 0.986$). The geometry-to-behavior rank correlation is $ρ= 0.72$ across 24 non-steered adapters. These results establish that within a controlled manufacturing regime, LoRA weight-space geometry carries objective identity, intensity ordering, and a coarse link to harmful compliance, and that cross-method monitoring requires per-method calibration.

AI.tldr: LoRA权重增量的低秩谱特征能够识别微调目标类型，几何信号可预测下游有害行为，但跨方法泛化失败
AI.motivation: 研究LoRA权重增量的几何特征是否能识别微调目标类型，以及这些几何信号是否能预测下游行为危害
AI.method: 在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct上制造38个LoRA适配器，分为四类：健康SFT基线、反向无害偏好DPO、反向有帮助偏好DPO、激活引导衍生适配器。提取每层谱特征（范数、稳定秩、奇异值熵、有效秩、奇异向量与健康质心的余弦对齐）。使用逻辑回归分类器和主成分分析进行检测
AI.result: 在单一训练方法（DPO）内，逻辑回归分类器在二元漂移检测、六对目标比较和严重性排序上达到AUC~1.00。主成分分析显示训练目标是PC1（AUC~1.00），与训练时长正交。查询投影权重检测漂移发生，值投影权重识别具体目标。跨方法泛化完全失败。行为评估显示反向无害偏好DPO适配器在有害提示上表现出更高的有害依从性（平均ASR 0.266 vs. 健康0.112），几何到行为的秩相关系数为ρ=0.72
AI.conclusion: 在受控制造机制下，LoRA权重空间几何携带目标身份、强度排序和与有害依从性的粗略联系，跨方法监控需要针对每种方法进行校准

title: Facet-Level Tracing of Evidence Uncertainty and Hallucination in RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved evidence, yet hallucinated answers remain common even when relevant documents are available. Existing evaluations focus on answer-level or passage-level accuracy, offering limited insight into how evidence is used during generation. In this work, we introduce a facet-level diagnostics framework for QA that decomposes each input question into atomic reasoning facets. For each facet, we assess evidence sufficiency and grounding using a structured Facet x Chunk matrix that combines retrieval relevance with natural language inference-based faithfulness scores. To diagnose evidence usage, we analyze three controlled inference modes: Strict RAG, which enforces exclusive reliance on retrieved evidence; Soft RAG, which allows integration of retrieved evidence and parametric knowledge; and LLM-only generation without retrieval. Comparing these modes enables thorough analysis of retrieval-generation misalignment, defined as cases where relevant evidence is retrieved but not correctly integrated during generation. Across medical QA and HotpotQA, we evaluate three open-source and closed-source LLMs (GPT, Gemini, and LLaMA), providing interpretable diagnostics that reveal recurring facet-level failure modes, including evidence absence, evidence misalignment, and prior-driven overrides. Our results demonstrate that hallucinations in RAG systems are driven less by retrieval accuracy and more by how retrieved evidence is integrated during generation, with facet-level analysis exposing systematic evidence override and misalignment patterns that remain hidden under answer-level evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向QA的细粒度诊断框架，通过将问题分解为原子推理面，评估证据充分性和忠实度，分析三种推理模式，揭示RAG系统中幻觉主要源于证据集成而非检索准确性。
AI.motivation: 尽管检索增强生成(RAG)旨在通过基于检索证据来减少幻觉，但即使相关文档可用，幻觉答案仍然常见。现有评估主要关注答案级或段落级准确性，对证据在生成过程中如何使用的洞察有限。
AI.method: 引入面向QA的细粒度诊断框架：1)将每个输入问题分解为原子推理面；2)使用结构化"面×块"矩阵评估每个面的证据充分性和忠实度；3)分析三种受控推理模式：严格RAG、软RAG和纯LLM生成；4)通过比较这些模式诊断检索-生成错配。
AI.result: 在医学QA和HotpotQA上评估了GPT、Gemini和LLaMA等开源和闭源LLM。结果显示：RAG系统中的幻觉主要源于证据集成方式而非检索准确性；细粒度分析揭示了系统性的证据覆盖和错配模式，这些在答案级评估中被隐藏。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的细粒度诊断框架提供了可解释的诊断，揭示了RAG系统中反复出现的失败模式，包括证据缺失、证据错配和先验驱动覆盖。研究强调了需要改进证据集成机制，而不仅仅是提高检索准确性。

title: Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control for Safeguarding Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted in CVPR 2026. Project page: https://peterljq.github.io/project/daco
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been shown to be vulnerable to malicious queries that can elicit unsafe responses. Recent work uses prompt engineering, response classification, or finetuning to improve MLLM safety. Nevertheless, such approaches are often ineffective against evolving malicious patterns, may require rerunning the query, or demand heavy computational resources. Steering the activations of a frozen model at inference time has recently emerged as a flexible and effective solution. However, existing steering methods for MLLMs typically handle only a narrow set of safety-related concepts or struggle to adjust specific concepts without affecting others. To address these challenges, we introduce Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control (DACO), a framework that utilizes a curated concept dictionary and a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to provide granular control over MLLM activations. First, we curate a dictionary of 15,000 multimodal concepts by retrieving over 400,000 caption-image stimuli and summarizing their activations into concept directions. We name the dataset DACO-400K. Second, we show that the curated dictionary can be used to intervene activations via sparse coding. Third, we propose a new steering approach that uses our dictionary to initialize the training of an SAE and automatically annotate the semantics of the SAE atoms for safeguarding MLLMs. Experiments on multiple MLLMs (e.g., QwenVL, LLaVA, InternVL) across safety benchmarks (e.g., MM-SafetyBench, JailBreakV) show that DACO significantly improves MLLM safety while maintaining general-purpose capabilities.

AI.tldr: DACO框架通过概念词典和稀疏自编码器实现对多模态大语言模型激活的细粒度控制，显著提升模型安全性同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM安全防护方法存在局限性：提示工程、响应分类或微调方法对不断演变的恶意模式效果有限，可能需要重新运行查询或消耗大量计算资源。现有的激活导向方法通常只能处理有限的安全相关概念，或难以在不影响其他概念的情况下调整特定概念。
AI.method: 提出Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control (DACO)框架：1) 通过检索40万+图文刺激并总结其激活，构建包含1.5万个多模态概念的概念词典(DACO-400K数据集)；2) 使用稀疏编码通过词典干预激活；3) 提出新的导向方法，使用词典初始化稀疏自编码器(SAE)训练，并自动标注SAE原子的语义用于保护MLLM。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM（QwenVL、LLaVA、InternVL）和安全基准测试（MM-SafetyBench、JailBreakV）上的实验表明，DACO显著提高了MLLM的安全性，同时保持了通用能力。
AI.conclusion: DACO框架通过概念词典和稀疏自编码器提供了一种灵活有效的MLLM安全防护方法，能够细粒度控制模型激活，在提升安全性的同时保持模型性能。

title: Robust by Design: A Continuous Monitoring and Data Integration Framework for Medical AI
comment: Accepted at IEEE ISBI 2026. Chandra Mohan and Hien Van Nguyen jointly supervised this work
summary: Adaptive medical AI models often face performance drops in dynamic clinical environments due to data drift. We propose an autonomous continuous monitoring and data integration framework that maintains robust performance over time. Focusing on glomerular pathology image classification (proliferative vs. non-proliferative lupus nephritis), our three-stage method uses multi-metric feature analysis and Monte Carlo dropout-based uncertainty gating to decide when to retrain on new data. Only images statistically similar to the training distribution (via Euclidean, cosine, Mahalanobis metrics) and with low predictive entropy are integrated. The model is then incrementally retrained with these images under strict performance safeguards (no metric degradation >5%). In experiments with a ResNet18 ensemble on a multi-center dataset, the framework prevents performance degradation: new images were added without significant change in AUC (~0.92) or accuracy (~89%). This approach addresses data shift and avoids catastrophic forgetting, enabling sustained learning in medical imaging AI.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应医疗AI框架，通过多指标特征分析和不确定性门控实现持续监控与数据集成，防止数据漂移导致的性能下降，在肾小球病理图像分类中保持稳定性能。
AI.motivation: 自适应医疗AI模型在动态临床环境中常因数据漂移导致性能下降，需要一种能够持续监控并集成新数据的方法来维持模型鲁棒性。
AI.method: 三阶段方法：1) 多指标特征分析（欧氏距离、余弦相似度、马氏距离）筛选统计相似于训练分布的新图像；2) Monte Carlo dropout不确定性门控，仅集成预测熵低的图像；3) 增量式再训练，设置严格性能保护（指标下降不超过5%）。使用ResNet18集成模型在多中心数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 框架有效防止性能退化：集成新图像后AUC保持约0.92，准确率约89%，无显著变化。成功应对数据偏移并避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 该自主持续监控与数据集成框架能够维持医疗影像AI的稳健性能，实现持续学习，为动态临床环境中的自适应AI系统提供可行解决方案。

title: Do LLMs Follow Their Own Rules? A Reflexive Audit of Self-Stated Safety Policies
summary: LLMs internalize safety policies through RLHF, yet these policies are never formally specified and remain difficult to inspect. Existing benchmarks evaluate models against external standards but do not measure whether models understand and enforce their own stated boundaries. We introduce the Symbolic-Neural Consistency Audit (SNCA), a framework that (1) extracts a model's self-stated safety rules via structured prompts, (2) formalizes them as typed predicates (Absolute, Conditional, Adaptive), and (3) measures behavioral compliance via deterministic comparison against harm benchmarks.
