Evaluating four frontier models across 45 harm categories and 47,496 observations reveals systematic gaps between stated policy and observed behavior: models claiming absolute refusal frequently comply with harmful prompts, reasoning models achieve the highest self-consistency but fail to articulate policies for 29% of categories, and cross-model agreement on rule types is remarkably low (11%). These results demonstrate that the gap between what LLMs say and what they do is measurable and architecture-dependent, motivating reflexive consistency audits as a complement to behavioral benchmarks.

AI.tldr: SNCA框架通过提取LLM自我声明的安全规则、形式化规则类型、测量行为合规性，揭示模型声明政策与实际行为之间的系统性差距
AI.motivation: LLM通过RLHF内化了安全政策，但这些政策从未被正式规定且难以检查。现有基准仅评估模型是否符合外部标准，无法测量模型是否理解并执行其自身声明的边界
AI.method: 引入符号-神经一致性审计(SNCA)框架：1)通过结构化提示提取模型自我声明的安全规则；2)将其形式化为类型化谓词(绝对、条件、自适应)；3)通过与危害基准的确定性比较测量行为合规性
AI.result: 评估4个前沿模型在45个危害类别和47,496个观察中显示：声称绝对拒绝的模型经常遵守有害提示；推理模型具有最高自洽性但无法为29%类别阐明政策；跨模型规则类型一致性极低(11%)
AI.conclusion: LLM所言与所为之间的差距是可测量的且与架构相关，这促使将自反一致性审计作为行为基准的补充

title: BlendFusion -- Scalable Synthetic Data Generation for Diffusion Model Training
summary: With the rapid adoption of diffusion models, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising approach for addressing the growing demand for large-scale image datasets. However, images generated purely by diffusion models often exhibit visual inconsistencies, and training models on such data can create an autophagous feedback loop that leads to model collapse, commonly referred to as Model Autophagy Disorder (MAD). To address these challenges, we propose BlendFusion, a scalable framework for synthetic data generation from 3D scenes using path tracing. Our pipeline incorporates an object-centric camera placement strategy, robust filtering mechanisms, and automatic captioning to produce high-quality image-caption pairs. Using this pipeline, we curate FineBLEND, an image-caption dataset constructed from a diverse set of 3D scenes. We empirically analyze the quality of FineBLEND and compare it to several widely used image-caption datasets. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our object-centric camera placement strategy relative to object-agnostic sampling approaches. Our open-source framework is designed for high configurability, enabling the community to create their own datasets from 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: BlendFusion是一个从3D场景生成高质量合成图像-文本对的可扩展框架，旨在解决扩散模型生成数据存在的视觉不一致性和模型自噬问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成的合成图像存在视觉不一致问题，且基于此类数据训练模型会导致模型自噬障碍（MAD），形成自噬反馈循环。需要更高质量的合成数据生成方法。
AI.method: 提出BlendFusion框架，使用路径追踪从3D场景生成合成数据。采用物体中心相机放置策略、鲁棒过滤机制和自动标注技术，生成高质量图像-文本对。构建了FineBLEND数据集。
AI.result: 创建了FineBLEND数据集，实证分析显示其质量优于多个广泛使用的图像-文本数据集。物体中心相机放置策略相比物体无关采样方法效果更佳。框架开源且高度可配置。
AI.conclusion: BlendFusion为从3D场景生成高质量合成数据提供了有效解决方案，解决了扩散模型生成数据的局限性，有助于缓解模型自噬障碍问题。

title: ScheMatiQ: From Research Question to Structured Data through Interactive Schema Discovery
summary: Many disciplines pose natural-language research questions over large document collections whose answers typically require structured evidence, traditionally obtained by manually designing an annotation schema and exhaustively labeling the corpus, a slow and error-prone process. We introduce ScheMatiQ, which leverages calls to a backbone LLM to take a question and a corpus to produce a schema and a grounded database, with a web interface that lets steer and revise the extraction. In collaboration with domain experts, we show that ScheMatiQ yields outputs that support real-world analysis in law and computational biology. We release ScheMatiQ as open source with a public web interface, and invite experts across disciplines to use it with their own data. All resources, including the website, source code, and demonstration video, are available at: www.ScheMatiQ-ai.com

AI.tldr: ScheMatiQ：利用大语言模型从文档集合中自动生成结构化证据提取模式，支持专家交互式修正
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要手动设计标注模式并穷尽标注语料库，这一过程缓慢且容易出错。需要一种自动化方法来从大规模文档集合中提取结构化证据以回答自然语言研究问题。
AI.method: ScheMatiQ利用骨干大语言模型，根据问题和语料库自动生成提取模式和基础数据库，并提供Web界面让专家能够引导和修正提取过程。
AI.result: 通过与领域专家合作，在法学和计算生物学领域验证了ScheMatiQ能够产生支持实际分析的结果。系统已开源并提供公共Web界面。
AI.conclusion: ScheMatiQ提供了一种自动化、交互式的方法来从大规模文档集合中提取结构化证据，解决了传统手动方法的局限性，并已在实际领域应用中验证了其有效性。

title: How does Chain of Thought decompose complex tasks?
summary: Many language tasks can be modeled as classification problems where a large language model (LLM) is given a prompt and selects one among many possible answers. We show that the classification error in such problems scales as a power law in the number of classes. This has a dramatic consequence: the prediction error can be reduced substantially by splitting the overall task into a sequence of smaller classification problems, each with the same number of classes ("degree"). This tree-structured decomposition models chain-of-thought (CoT). It has been observed that CoT-based predictors perform better when they "think'", i.e., when they develop a deeper tree, thus decomposing the problem into a larger number of steps. We identify a critical threshold for the degree, below which thinking is detrimental, and above which there exists an optimal depth that minimizes the error. It is impossible to surpass this minimal error by increasing the depth of thinking.

AI.tldr: 论文发现分类误差随类别数呈幂律增长，提出通过将任务分解为多步小分类问题（树状分解）可显著降低误差，类似于思维链方法，并确定了思维深度的临界阈值和最优深度。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型在分类任务中的误差特性，探索如何通过结构化分解来降低预测误差，特别是解释思维链方法为何能提高性能。
AI.method: 将分类任务建模为树状分解结构，每个节点进行相同类别数的分类（称为"度"），分析误差随类别数的幂律关系，推导出思维深度的临界阈值和最优深度。
AI.result: 发现分类误差随类别数呈幂律增长，通过树状分解可显著降低误差；确定了度的临界阈值，低于该阈值时增加思维深度有害，高于阈值时存在最小化误差的最优深度。
AI.conclusion: 思维链方法的有效性源于将复杂分类任务分解为多步小分类问题，存在度的临界阈值和最优思维深度，超过最优深度无法进一步降低误差。

title: CAD 100K: A Comprehensive Multi-Task Dataset for Car Related Visual Anomaly Detection
summary:
Multi-task visual anomaly detection is critical for car-related manufacturing quality assessment. However, existing methods remain task-specific, hindered by the absence of a unified benchmark for multi-task evaluation. To fill in this gap, We present the CAD Dataset, a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark designed for car-related multi-task visual anomaly detection. The dataset contains over 100
  images crossing 7 vehicle domains and 3 tasks, providing models a comprehensive view for car-related anomaly detection. It is the first car-related anomaly dataset specialized for multi-task learning(MTL), while combining synthesis data augmentation for few-shot anomaly images. We implement a multi-task baseline and conduct extensive empirical studies. Results show MTL promotes task interaction and knowledge transfer, while also exposing challenging conflicts between tasks. The CAD dataset serves as a standardized platform to drive future advances in car-related multi-task visual anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 提出CAD数据集，首个面向汽车相关多任务视觉异常检测的大规模基准，包含7个车辆领域和3个任务，促进多任务学习研究
AI.motivation: 汽车制造质量评估需要多任务视觉异常检测，但现有方法局限于特定任务，缺乏统一的多任务评估基准
AI.method: 构建CAD数据集：包含100+图像，跨越7个车辆领域和3个任务，结合合成数据增强处理少样本异常图像，实现多任务基线模型
AI.result: 多任务学习促进任务交互和知识迁移，但也暴露任务间的冲突挑战；CAD数据集为标准化平台推动该领域发展
AI.conclusion: CAD数据集填补了汽车相关多任务视觉异常检测的基准空白，为未来研究提供标准化评估平台，促进多任务学习发展

title: EthicMind: A Risk-Aware Framework for Ethical-Emotional Alignment in Multi-Turn Dialogue
comment: 18 pages, Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Intelligent dialogue systems are increasingly deployed in emotionally and ethically sensitive settings, where failures in either emotional attunement or ethical judgment can cause significant harm. Existing dialogue models typically address empathy and ethical safety in isolation, and often fail to adapt their behavior as ethical risk and user emotion evolve across multi-turn interactions. We formulate ethical-emotional alignment in dialogue as an explicit turn-level decision problem, and propose \textsc{EthicMind}, a risk-aware framework that implements this formulation in multi-turn dialogue at inference time. At each turn, \textsc{EthicMind} jointly analyzes ethical risk signals and user emotion, plans a high-level response strategy, and generates context-sensitive replies that balance ethical guidance with emotional engagement, without requiring additional model training. To evaluate alignment behavior under ethically complex interactions, we introduce a risk-stratified, multi-turn evaluation protocol with a context-aware user simulation procedure. Experimental results show that \textsc{EthicMind} achieves more consistent ethical guidance and emotional engagement than competitive baselines, particularly in high-risk and morally ambiguous scenarios.

AI.tldr: EthicMind是一个风险感知的多轮对话框架，通过联合分析伦理风险信号和用户情感，在推理时实现伦理-情感对齐，无需额外训练即可生成平衡伦理指导和情感参与的回答。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统通常在情感共情和伦理安全方面孤立处理，且难以在多轮交互中随着伦理风险和用户情感变化而调整行为。在情感和伦理敏感场景中，任一方面的失败都可能导致严重伤害。
AI.method: 将伦理-情感对齐形式化为明确的轮次级决策问题，提出EthicMind框架：在每一轮中联合分析伦理风险信号和用户情感，规划高层响应策略，生成上下文敏感的回答，平衡伦理指导和情感参与，无需额外模型训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EthicMind相比竞争基线实现了更一致的伦理指导和情感参与，特别是在高风险和道德模糊场景中表现更优。通过引入风险分层、多轮评估协议和上下文感知的用户模拟程序进行评估。
AI.conclusion: EthicMind框架成功解决了多轮对话中伦理-情感对齐的挑战，能够在推理时动态调整响应策略，在敏感场景中提供更安全、更共情的对话体验。

title: A Mathematical Framework for Temporal Modeling and Counterfactual Policy Simulation of Student Dropout
comment: Approx. 20 pages, 9 figures. Code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/rafa-rodriguess/TCM-Student-Dropout This work introduces a temporal survival framework with counterfactual policy simulation
summary: This study proposes a temporal modeling framework with a counterfactual policy-simulation layer for student dropout in higher education, using LMS engagement data and administrative withdrawal records. Dropout is operationalized as a time-to-event outcome at the enrollment level; weekly risk is modeled in discrete time via penalized, class-balanced logistic regression over person--period rows. Under a late-event temporal holdout, the model attains row-level AUCs of 0.8350 (train) and 0.8405 (test), with aggregate calibration acceptable but sparsely supported in the highest-risk bins. Ablation analyses indicate performance is sensitive to feature set composition, underscoring the role of temporal engagement signals. A scenario-indexed policy layer produces survival contrasts $ΔS(T)$ under an explicit trigger/schedule contract: positive contrasts are confined to the shock branch ($T_{\rm policy}=18$: 0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819), while the mechanism-aware branch is negative ($ΔS_{\rm mech}(18)=-0.0078$, $ΔS_{\rm mech}(38)=-0.0134$). A subgroup analysis by gender quantifies scenario-induced survival gaps via bootstrap; contrasts are directionally stable but small. Results are not causally identified; they demonstrate the framework's capacity for internal structural scenario comparison under observational data constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一个结合反事实政策模拟层的时间建模框架，用于高等教育学生辍学预测，使用LMS参与数据和行政退学记录，在时间保持验证下获得0.84 AUC，并通过政策模拟分析干预效果。
AI.motivation: 高等教育学生辍学是一个重要问题，需要基于学习管理系统(LMS)参与数据的时间建模方法来预测辍学风险，并评估潜在干预政策的反事实效果，为教育决策提供支持。
AI.method: 将辍学建模为时间到事件结果，使用离散时间惩罚逻辑回归在人员-周期行上建模每周风险，采用类别平衡处理数据不平衡，并构建包含反事实政策模拟层的框架，通过触发/调度合约生成生存对比ΔS(T)。
AI.result: 模型在时间保持验证下获得0.8350（训练）和0.8405（测试）的AUC，校准可接受但高风险区间支持稀疏；政策模拟显示冲击分支产生正生存对比（T=18时0.0102-0.0819），而机制感知分支为负（ΔS_mech(18)=-0.0078）；性别亚组分析显示方向稳定但效应小。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在观察数据约束下展示了内部结构场景比较的能力，结果虽无因果识别，但为教育政策模拟提供了实用工具，强调了时间参与信号的重要性，并揭示了不同干预策略的异质性效果。

title: Leave My Images Alone: Preventing Multi-Modal Large Language Models from Analyzing Images via Visual Prompt Injection
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for analyzing Internet-scale image data, offering significant benefits but also raising critical safety and societal concerns. In particular, open-weight MLLMs may be misused to extract sensitive information from personal images at scale, such as identities, locations, or other private details. In this work, we propose ImageProtector, a user-side method that proactively protects images before sharing by embedding a carefully crafted, nearly imperceptible perturbation that acts as a visual prompt injection attack on MLLMs. As a result, when an adversary analyzes a protected image with an MLLM, the MLLM is consistently induced to generate a refusal response such as "I'm sorry, I can't help with that request." We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of ImageProtector across six MLLMs and four datasets. Additionally, we evaluate three potential countermeasures, Gaussian noise, DiffPure, and adversarial training, and show that while they partially mitigate the impact of ImageProtector, they simultaneously degrade model accuracy and/or efficiency. Our study focuses on the practically important setting of open-weight MLLMs and large-scale automated image analysis, and highlights both the promise and the limitations of perturbation-based privacy protection.

AI.tldr: ImageProtector：一种用户端图像保护方法，通过嵌入几乎不可见的扰动，使多模态大语言模型在处理受保护图像时生成拒绝响应，从而防止敏感信息被大规模提取。
AI.motivation: 开放权重的多模态大语言模型可能被滥用于从个人图像中大规模提取敏感信息（如身份、位置等隐私细节），需要开发有效的隐私保护方法。
AI.method: 提出ImageProtector方法，在用户分享图像前嵌入精心设计的、几乎不可见的扰动，这种扰动作为视觉提示注入攻击，诱导MLLM在处理受保护图像时生成拒绝响应。
AI.result: 在6个MLLM和4个数据集上验证了ImageProtector的有效性。评估了三种潜在对抗措施（高斯噪声、DiffPure、对抗训练），发现它们虽然能部分缓解ImageProtector的影响，但会同时降低模型准确性和/或效率。
AI.conclusion: ImageProtector为开放权重MLLM和大规模自动化图像分析场景提供了有效的隐私保护方案，同时揭示了基于扰动的隐私保护方法的潜力与局限性。

title: Task-Aware LLM Routing with Multi-Level Task-Profile-Guided Data Synthesis for Cold-Start Scenarios
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial variability in performance and computational cost across tasks and queries, motivating routing systems that select models to meet user-specific cost-performance trade-offs. However, existing routers generalize poorly in cold-start scenarios where in-domain training data is unavailable. We address this limitation with a multi-level task-profile-guided data synthesis framework that constructs a hierarchical task taxonomy and produces diverse question-answer pairs to approximate the test-time query distribution. Building on this, we introduce TRouter, a task-type-aware router approach that models query-conditioned cost and performance via latent task-type variables, with prior regularization derived from the synthesized task taxonomy. This design enhances TRouter's routing utility under both cold-start and in-domain settings. Across multiple benchmarks, we show that our synthesis framework alleviates cold-start issues and that TRouter delivers effective LLM routing.

AI.tldr: 提出TRouter框架，通过多级任务轮廓引导的数据合成解决冷启动场景下的LLM路由问题，利用分层任务分类和查询条件化成本-性能建模实现有效路由
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在不同任务和查询上的性能与计算成本存在显著差异，需要路由系统来满足用户特定的成本-性能权衡。现有路由方法在缺乏领域内训练数据的冷启动场景中泛化能力较差，需要解决这一限制。
AI.method: 提出多级任务轮廓引导的数据合成框架，构建分层任务分类并生成多样化问答对来近似测试时查询分布。在此基础上引入TRouter，通过潜在任务类型变量建模查询条件化的成本和性能，利用合成任务分类提供的先验正则化，增强冷启动和领域内设置下的路由效用。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，合成框架有效缓解了冷启动问题，TRouter实现了有效的LLM路由，在冷启动和领域内设置下均表现出色。
AI.conclusion: TRouter框架通过任务轮廓引导的数据合成和任务类型感知的路由设计，解决了LLM路由中的冷启动泛化问题，为不同成本-性能权衡需求提供了有效的模型选择方案。

title: Revisiting the Capacity Gap in Chain-of-Thought Distillation from a Practical Perspective
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation transfers reasoning behaviors from a strong teacher to a smaller student, but prior work reports a capacity gap: distillation may fail when the teacher-student capability mismatch is large. We revisit the capacity gap from a practical perspective by re-examining commonly used experimental settings. Notably, we find that CoT distillation often degrades performance compared to the student's pre-distillation baseline, an issue obscured when only post-distillation comparisons are reported. We therefore propose a more realistic evaluation protocol and find that the impact of capacity gap effects does not consistently dominate across tasks and settings, especially when candidate teachers differ substantially in performance. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting teacher-student pairs in CoT distillation.

AI.tldr: 重新审视CoT蒸馏中的能力差距问题，发现现有评估方法可能掩盖了蒸馏后性能下降的问题，提出更现实的评估协议
AI.motivation: 先前工作报告CoT蒸馏存在能力差距问题，当师生能力不匹配较大时蒸馏可能失败。作者从实践角度重新审视这一问题，发现现有评估方法可能掩盖了蒸馏后性能下降的问题
AI.method: 重新检验常用的实验设置，发现CoT蒸馏经常导致性能下降（相比学生蒸馏前基线），提出更现实的评估协议来评估能力差距的影响
AI.result: 能力差距的影响在不同任务和设置中并不总是占主导地位，特别是当候选教师性能差异显著时。结果提供了CoT蒸馏中选择师生配对的实际指导
AI.conclusion: CoT蒸馏中的能力差距问题需要更现实的评估方法，师生配对选择应考虑具体任务和教师性能差异，而非简单假设能力差距总是主导因素

title: Automated Instruction Revision (AIR): A Structured Comparison of Task Adaptation Strategies for LLM
summary: This paper studies Automated Instruction Revision (AIR), a rule-induction-based method for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks using limited task-specific examples. We position AIR within the broader landscape of adaptation strategies, including prompt optimization, retrieval-based methods, and fine-tuning. We then compare these approaches across a diverse benchmark suite designed to stress different task requirements, such as knowledge injection, structured extraction, label remapping, and logical reasoning. The paper argues that adaptation performance is strongly task-dependent: no single method dominates across all settings. Across five benchmarks, AIR was strongest or near-best on label-remapping classification, while KNN retrieval performed best on closed-book QA, and fine-tuning dominated structured extraction and event-order reasoning. AIR is most promising when task behavior can be captured by compact, interpretable instruction rules, while retrieval and fine-tuning remain stronger in tasks dominated by source-specific knowledge or dataset-specific annotation regularities.

AI.tldr: AIR是一种基于规则归纳的自动指令修订方法，用于使用有限任务示例来适应LLM到下游任务。研究发现不同适应方法在不同任务类型上表现各异，没有单一方法在所有任务上占优。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索如何有效地将大型语言模型适应到下游任务，特别是在只有有限任务特定示例的情况下。作者希望比较不同的适应策略（包括提示优化、检索方法、微调等），并理解它们在各种任务需求下的相对优势。
AI.method: 提出了自动指令修订（AIR）方法，这是一种基于规则归纳的方法，通过从有限的任务特定示例中学习来适应LLM。研究将AIR与其他适应策略进行比较，包括提示优化、基于检索的方法（如KNN检索）和微调。使用了一个多样化的基准套件来评估这些方法，该套件设计用于测试不同的任务需求：知识注入、结构化提取、标签重映射和逻辑推理。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试中，AIR在标签重映射分类任务上表现最强或接近最佳；KNN检索在闭卷问答任务上表现最佳；微调在结构化提取和事件顺序推理任务上占主导地位。研究结果表明适应性能强烈依赖于任务类型，没有单一方法在所有设置中都占优。
AI.conclusion: 当任务行为可以通过紧凑、可解释的指令规则捕捉时，AIR最有前景；而在由特定源知识或数据集特定注释规律主导的任务中，检索和微调仍然更强。适应方法的选择应根据具体任务需求来决定，因为不同方法在不同任务类型上各有优势。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Transformers: Conformal Prediction for Language Models
summary: Transformers have had a profound impact on the field of artificial intelligence, especially on large language models and their variants. However, as was the case with neural networks, their black-box nature limits trust and deployment in high-stakes settings. For models to be genuinely useful and trustworthy in critical applications, they must provide more than just predictions: they must supply users with a clear understanding of the reasoning that underpins their decisions. This article presents an uncertainty quantification framework for transformer-based language models. This framework, called CONFIDE (CONformal prediction for FIne-tuned DEep language models), applies conformal prediction to the internal embeddings of encoder-only architectures, like BERT and RoBERTa, while enabling hyperparameter tuning. CONFIDE uses either [CLS] token embeddings or flattened hidden states to construct class-conditional nonconformity scores, enabling statistically valid prediction sets with instance-level explanations. Empirically, CONFIDE improves test accuracy by up to 4.09% on BERT-tiny and achieves greater correct efficiency (i.e., the expected size of the prediction set conditioned on it containing the true label) compared to prior methods, including NM2 and VanillaNN. We show that early and intermediate transformer layers often yield better-calibrated and more semantically meaningful representations for conformal prediction. In resource-constrained models and high-stakes tasks with ambiguous labels, CONFIDE offers robustness and interpretability where softmax-based uncertainty fails. We position CONFIDE as a framework for practical diagnostic and efficiency/robustness improvement over prior conformal baselines.

AI.tldr: CONFIDE框架为基于Transformer的语言模型提供不确定性量化，通过整合保形预测与模型内部嵌入，生成统计有效的预测集和实例级解释。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型的黑盒特性限制了其在高风险场景中的可信度和部署。为了在关键应用中实现真正的实用性和可信度，模型不仅需要提供预测，还需要提供支撑决策的清晰推理过程。
AI.method: CONFIDE框架将保形预测应用于编码器架构（如BERT、RoBERTa）的内部嵌入，使用[CLS]标记嵌入或展平的隐藏状态构建类条件非一致性分数，支持超参数调优。
AI.result: 在BERT-tiny上测试准确率提升高达4.09%，相比NM2和VanillaNN等方法获得更高的正确效率。早期和中间Transformer层通常产生更好校准且更具语义意义的表示。
AI.conclusion: CONFIDE为资源受限模型和高风险模糊标签任务提供了鲁棒性和可解释性，在软基不确定性失效的场景下，作为实用的诊断和效率/鲁棒性改进框架优于先前的保形基线。

title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Multi-Exposure Image Fusion in Dynamic Scenes (Track 2)
summary: This paper presents NTIRE 2026, the 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) challenge on multi-exposure image fusion in dynamic scenes. We introduce a benchmark that targets a practical yet difficult HDR imaging setting, where exposure bracketing must be fused under scene motion, illumination variation, and handheld camera jitter. The challenge data contains 100 training sequences with 7 exposure levels and 100 test sequences with 5 exposure levels, reflecting real-world scenarios that frequently cause misalignment and ghosting artefacts. We evaluate submissions with a leaderboard score derived from PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while also considering perceptual quality, efficiency, and reproducibility during the final review. This track attracted 114 participating teams and received 987 submissions. The winning methods significantly improved the ability to remove artifacts from multi-exposure fusion and recover fine details. The dataset and the code of each team can be found at the repository: https://github.com/qulishen/RAIM-HDR.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛聚焦动态场景下的多曝光图像融合，针对实际HDR成像中场景运动、光照变化和手持抖动导致的错位和重影问题，通过大规模竞赛推动算法改进。
AI.motivation: 解决实际HDR成像中的关键挑战：在动态场景（包含场景运动、光照变化和手持相机抖动）下进行多曝光融合时产生的错位和重影伪影问题。
AI.method: 组织第三届RAIM挑战赛，提供包含100个训练序列（7曝光级别）和100个测试序列（5曝光级别）的基准数据集，采用PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS综合评分，并考虑感知质量、效率和可复现性。
AI.result: 吸引了114个团队参与，收到987份提交，获胜方法显著提升了去除多曝光融合伪影和恢复精细细节的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛成功推动了动态场景下多曝光图像融合技术的发展，提供了公开数据集和代码库以促进该领域的研究和应用。

title: UIPress: Bringing Optical Token Compression to UI-to-Code Generation
summary: UI-to-Code generation requires vision-language models (VLMs) to produce thousands of tokens of structured HTML/CSS from a single screenshot, making visual token efficiency critical. Existing compression methods either select tokens at inference time using task-agnostic heuristics, or zero out low-attention features without actually shortening the sequence -- neither truly reduces prefill latency or adapts to the non-uniform information density of UI screenshots. Meanwhile, optical (encoder-side learned) compression has shown strong results for document OCR, yet no prior work has adapted this paradigm to UI-to-Code generation. We propose UIPress, a lightweight learned compression module inserted between the frozen ViT encoder and the LLM decoder of Qwen3-VL-8B. UIPress combines depthwise-separable convolutions, element-guided spatial reweighting, and Transformer refinement to compress ${\sim}$6{,}700 visual tokens to a fixed budget of 256. Together with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on the decoder to bridge the representation gap, the entire system adds only ${\sim}$21.7M trainable parameters (0.26\% of the 8B base model). Under a fair comparison on the same base model against four baselines on Design2Code, UIPress at 256 tokens achieves a CLIP score of 0.8127, outperforming the uncompressed baseline by +7.5\% and the strongest inference-time method by +4.6\%, while delivering 9.1$\times$ time-to-first-token speedup. To the best of our knowledge, UIPress is the first encoder-side learned compression method for the UI-to-Code task.

AI.tldr: UIPress：首个针对UI转代码任务的编码器端学习压缩方法，将约6700个视觉token压缩至固定256个，在保持性能的同时实现9.1倍的首token生成加速
AI.motivation: UI转代码生成需要视觉语言模型从单张截图生成数千个结构化HTML/CSS token，视觉token效率至关重要。现有压缩方法要么使用任务无关启发式方法在推理时选择token，要么在不实际缩短序列的情况下将低注意力特征置零，都无法真正减少预填充延迟或适应UI截图的非均匀信息密度。同时，光学（编码器端学习）压缩在文档OCR中显示出强大效果，但尚无工作将此范式应用于UI转代码生成。
AI.method: 提出UIPress，一个轻量级学习压缩模块，插入冻结的ViT编码器和Qwen3-VL-8B的LLM解码器之间。结合深度可分离卷积、元素引导的空间重加权和Transformer精炼，将约6700个视觉token压缩至固定256个预算。配合解码器的低秩适应（LoRA）来弥合表示差距，整个系统仅增加约2170万个可训练参数（占8B基础模型的0.26%）。
AI.result: 在Design2Code上与四个基线进行公平比较，UIPress在256个token时达到CLIP分数0.8127，比未压缩基线提升+7.5%，比最强推理时方法提升+4.6%，同时实现9.1倍的首token生成加速。
AI.conclusion: UIPress是首个针对UI转代码任务的编码器端学习压缩方法，通过高效的视觉token压缩在保持性能的同时显著加速推理，为视觉语言模型在UI转代码应用中的实际部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: A Closer Look at the Application of Causal Inference in Graph Representation Learning
summary: Modeling causal relationships in graph representation learning remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often draw on theories and methods from causal inference to identify causal subgraphs or mitigate confounders. However, due to the inherent complexity of graph-structured data, these approaches frequently aggregate diverse graph elements into single causal variables, an operation that risks violating the core assumptions of causal inference. In this work, we prove that such aggregation compromises causal validity. Building on this conclusion, we propose a theoretical model grounded in the smallest indivisible units of graph data to ensure that the causal validity is guaranteed. With this model, we further analyze the costs of achieving precise causal modeling in graph representation learning and identify the conditions under which the problem can be simplified. To empirically support our theory, we construct a controllable synthetic dataset that reflects realworld causal structures and conduct extensive experiments for validation. Finally, we develop a causal modeling enhancement module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing graph learning pipelines, and we demonstrate its effectiveness through comprehensive comparative experiments.

AI.tldr: 论文证明图表示学习中聚合图元素为单一因果变量会损害因果有效性，提出基于最小不可分单元的理论模型，开发了可集成到现有图学习流程的因果建模增强模块。
AI.motivation: 现有图表示学习方法常将多样化的图元素聚合为单一因果变量，这种操作可能违反因果推断的核心假设，损害因果建模的有效性。需要建立确保因果有效性的理论基础。
AI.method: 1) 证明聚合操作会损害因果有效性；2) 基于图数据最小不可分单元建立理论模型；3) 分析精确因果建模的成本和简化条件；4) 构建反映真实世界因果结构的可控合成数据集；5) 开发可集成到现有图学习流程的因果建模增强模块。
AI.result: 理论证明聚合会损害因果有效性，建立了基于最小不可分单元的因果有效模型。通过可控合成数据集验证了理论，开发的增强模块在综合比较实验中表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 图表示学习中的因果建模需要避免将多样图元素聚合为单一变量，基于最小不可分单元的理论模型能确保因果有效性。提出的增强模块可提升现有方法的因果建模能力，为图因果推断提供了理论基础和实践工具。

title: SiMing-Bench: Evaluating Procedural Correctness from Continuous Interactions in Clinical Skill Videos
summary: Current video benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) focus on event recognition, temporal ordering, and long-context recall, but overlook a harder capability required for expert procedural judgment: tracking how ongoing interactions update the procedural state and thereby determine the correctness of later actions. We introduce SiMing-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating this capability from full-length clinical skill videos. It targets rubric-grounded process-level judgment of whether interaction-driven state updates preserve procedural correctness across an entire workflow. SiMing-Bench is instantiated with SiMing-Score, a physician-annotated dataset of real clinical skill examination videos spanning cardiopulmonary resuscitation, automated external defibrillator operation, and bag-mask ventilation, each paired with a standardized step-wise rubric and dual-expert labels. Across diverse open- and closed-source MLLMs, we observe consistently weak agreement with physician judgments. Moreover, weak performance on rubric-defined intermediate steps persists even when overall procedure-level correlation appears acceptable, suggesting that coarse global assessment substantially overestimates current models' procedural judgment ability. Additional analyses with binary step judgment and step-aligned clips indicate that the bottleneck is not merely fine-grained scoring or temporal localization, but modeling how continuous interactions update procedural state over time.

AI.tldr: SiMing-Bench是首个用于评估多模态大语言模型在临床技能视频中进行基于评分标准的流程级判断能力的基准，重点关注交互驱动的状态更新如何影响整个工作流程的程序正确性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频基准主要关注事件识别、时序排序和长上下文回忆，但忽视了专家程序判断所需的关键能力：跟踪持续交互如何更新程序状态并决定后续动作的正确性。特别是在临床技能评估中，需要基于标准化评分标准进行流程级判断。
AI.method: 研究者开发了SiMing-Bench基准，包含SiMing-Score数据集：由医生标注的真实临床技能考试视频，涵盖心肺复苏、自动体外除颤器操作和球囊面罩通气。每个视频配有标准化分步评分标准和双专家标注。通过评估多种开源和闭源MLLMs，分析其在流程级判断、中间步骤评估、二元步骤判断和步骤对齐片段等方面的表现。
AI.result: 所有测试的MLLMs与医生判断的一致性都很弱。即使在整体流程级相关性看似可接受的情况下，模型在评分标准定义的中间步骤上表现仍然不佳，表明粗粒度全局评估严重高估了当前模型的程序判断能力。进一步分析表明瓶颈不在于细粒度评分或时间定位，而在于建模连续交互如何随时间更新程序状态。
AI.conclusion: SiMing-Bench揭示了当前MLLMs在程序判断能力上的重要局限性，特别是在跟踪交互驱动的状态更新方面。该基准为评估和改进模型在复杂程序性任务中的理解能力提供了重要工具，强调了需要开发能够建模持续状态变化的模型架构。

title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于数据集级、以对象为中心的监督方案，用于在3D高斯泼溅中学习对象表示，通过场景无关的对象码本提供跨视图和跨场景的一致身份锚定表示
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法利用视觉基础模型的2D掩码监督辐射场，但这些监督信号本质上不是以对象为中心的，需要额外的掩码预处理/后处理或专门的训练设计来解决跨视图的掩码身份冲突，且学习到的3D场景身份是场景依赖的，限制了跨场景的泛化能力
AI.method: 基于预训练的基于槽注意力的全局对象中心学习模块，学习场景无关的对象码本，提供跨视图和跨场景的一致、身份锚定表示。通过将码本与模块的无监督对象掩码耦合，可以直接监督3D高斯的身份特征，无需额外的掩码预处理/后处理或显式的多视图对齐
AI.result: 学习到的场景无关码本支持对象监督和识别，无需逐场景微调或重新训练。该方法将无监督对象中心学习引入3D高斯泼溅，产生更结构化的表示，并在机器人交互、场景理解和跨场景泛化等下游任务中表现出更好的泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种数据集级、以对象为中心的监督方案，通过场景无关的对象码本解决了现有方法在跨视图身份一致性和跨场景泛化方面的限制，为3D场景理解提供了更结构化和可泛化的对象表示

title: From Reasoning to Agentic: Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse, outcome-level rewards -- yet determining which actions within a long trajectory caused the outcome remains difficult. This credit assignment (CA) problem manifests in two regimes: reasoning RL, where credit must be distributed across tokens and steps within a single chain-of-thought generation (500--30K+ tokens); and agentic RL, where multi-turn environment interaction introduces stochastic transitions, partial observability, and horizons of 100+ turns (100K--1M tokens), making episode-level credit increasingly uninformative.
  We survey 47 CA methods (41 core, 6 adjacent enablers) published between 2024 and early 2026, organizing them in a two-dimensional taxonomy by assignment granularity (token, segment, step, turn, multi-agent) and methodology (Monte Carlo, temporal difference, model-based, game-theoretic, information-theoretic). Beyond the survey itself, we contribute three reusable resources: (1) a structured, machine-readable paper inventory with taxonomy labels, baseline families, and evidence levels; (2) a reporting checklist for future CA papers, validated against the reviewed literature to identify systematic methodological gaps; and (3) a benchmark protocol specification with task families, metadata requirements, and controlled bifurcation tasks, accompanied by a method selection decision tree.
  Our synthesis suggests that the shift from reasoning to agentic RL complicates and reshapes the credit assignment landscape: reasoning CA is maturing around process reward models and critic-free group comparison, while agentic CA is driving genuinely new approaches -- hindsight counterfactual analysis, privileged asymmetric critics, and turn-level MDP reformulations -- that have no direct precedent in reasoning RL.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统综述了2024-2026年间47种大语言模型强化学习中的信用分配方法，提出了二维分类法，并提供了结构化资源库、报告清单和基准协议。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型强化学习日益依赖稀疏的结果级奖励，但在长轨迹中确定哪些动作导致了结果仍然困难。信用分配问题在推理RL（500-30K+令牌）和智能体RL（100K-1M令牌）两个领域表现不同，需要系统梳理现有方法。
AI.method: 对47种信用分配方法（41种核心方法，6种相邻赋能方法）进行系统综述，建立二维分类法：按分配粒度（令牌、片段、步骤、回合、多智能体）和方法论（蒙特卡洛、时序差分、基于模型、博弈论、信息论）。提供结构化资源库、报告清单和基准协议。
AI.result: 研究发现从推理RL到智能体RL的转变重塑了信用分配格局：推理CA围绕过程奖励模型和无批评者群体比较趋于成熟，而智能体CA推动了全新方法（事后反事实分析、特权不对称批评者、回合级MDP重构），这些在推理RL中没有直接先例。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为LLM强化学习中的信用分配问题提供了系统框架和实用工具，揭示了推理与智能体RL在信用分配方法上的本质差异，为未来研究提供了方法论指导和基准标准。

title: Using Synthetic Data for Machine Learning-based Childhood Vaccination Prediction in Narok, Kenya
summary: Background: Limited data utilization in low-resource settings poses a barrier to the vaccine delivery ecosystem, undermining efforts to achieve equitable immunization coverage. In nomadic populations, individuals face an increased risk of missing crucial vaccination doses as children. One such population is the Maasai in Narok County, Kenya, where the absence of high-volume, quality data hampers accurate coverage estimates, impedes efficient resource allocation, and weakens the ability to deliver timely interventions. Additionally, data privacy concerns are heightened in groups with limited sensitive data. Objectives: First, we aim to identify children at risk of missing key vaccines across a large population to provide timely, evidence-based interventions that support increased vaccination coverage. Second, we aim to better protect the privacy of sensitive health data in a vulnerable population. Methods: We digitized 8 years of child vaccination records from the MOH 510 registry (n=6,913) and applied machine learning models (Logistic Regression and XGBoost) to identify children at risk. Additionally, we utilize a novel approach to tabular diffusion-based synthetic data generation (TabSyn) to protect patient privacy within the models. Results: Our findings show that classification techniques can reliably and successfully predict children at risk of missing a vaccine, with recall, precision, and F1-scores exceeding 90% for some vaccines modeled. Additionally, training these models with synthetic data rather than real data, thus preserving the privacy of individuals within the original dataset, does not lead to a loss in predictive performance. Conclusion: These results support the use of synthetic data implementation in health informatics strategies for clinics with limited digital infrastructure, enabling privacy-preserving, scalable forecasting for childhood immunization coverage.

AI.tldr: 机器学习模型可预测儿童漏种疫苗风险，合成数据保护隐私且不降低预测性能
AI.motivation: 解决低资源环境下数据利用不足问题，特别是游牧民族（如肯尼亚马赛人）儿童疫苗接种覆盖率难以准确评估、资源分配效率低、隐私保护需求迫切等挑战
AI.method: 数字化8年儿童疫苗接种记录（n=6,913），应用逻辑回归和XGBoost机器学习模型识别漏种风险儿童，采用表格扩散合成数据生成（TabSyn）技术保护患者隐私
AI.result: 分类技术能可靠预测儿童漏种疫苗风险（部分疫苗模型的召回率、精确率和F1分数超过90%），使用合成数据训练模型不会降低预测性能，同时保护原始数据隐私
AI.conclusion: 支持在数字基础设施有限的诊所中实施合成数据策略，实现隐私保护、可扩展的儿童免疫覆盖率预测，促进健康信息学发展

title: Across the Levels of Analysis: Explaining Predictive Processing in Humans Requires More Than Machine-Estimated Probabilities
comment: 9 pages, Behavioral & Brain Sciences Commentary on Futrell & Mahowald (forthcoming)
summary: Under the lens of Marr's levels of analysis, we critique and extend two claims about language models (LMs) and language processing: first, that predicting upcoming linguistic information based on context is central to language processing, and second, that many advances in psycholinguistics would be impossible without large language models (LLMs). We further outline future directions that combine the strengths of LLMs with psycholinguistic models.

AI.tldr: 本文在Marr分析框架下批判性审视了关于语言模型与语言处理的两个核心主张，并提出了结合LLMs与心理语言学模型优势的未来研究方向
AI.motivation: 本文旨在批判性地评估当前关于语言模型与语言处理关系的两个主流观点：1）基于上下文预测即将到来的语言信息是语言处理的核心；2）没有大语言模型，许多心理语言学的进展将不可能实现。作者希望通过Marr的分析层次框架对这些主张进行系统性审视
AI.method: 采用Marr的分析层次框架（计算层、算法层、实现层）作为理论工具，对语言模型与语言处理的关系进行系统性分析。该方法提供了多层次的分析视角，能够区分不同抽象层次上的问题
AI.result: 通过Marr框架的分析，作者对两个核心主张进行了批判性审视和扩展，指出了这些主张在不同分析层次上的局限性和适用性。同时提出了结合LLMs与心理语言学模型优势的未来研究方向
AI.conclusion: 本文强调了在Marr分析框架下审视语言模型与语言处理关系的重要性，认为需要更细致地区分不同分析层次上的问题。未来的研究应该结合大语言模型的计算能力与心理语言学模型的认知约束，以推动语言处理理论的进一步发展

title: Bridging SFT and RL: Dynamic Policy Optimization for Robust Reasoning
summary: Post-training paradigms for Large Language Models (LLMs), primarily Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), face a fundamental dilemma: SFT provides stability (low variance) but suffers from high fitting bias, while RL enables exploration (low bias) but grapples with high gradient variance. Existing unified optimization strategies often employ naive loss weighting, overlooking the statistical conflict between these distinct gradient signals. In this paper, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of this bias-variance trade-off and propose \textbf{DYPO} (Dynamic Policy Optimization), a unified framework designed to structurally mitigate this conflict. DYPO integrates three core components: (1) a \textit{Group Alignment Loss (GAL)} that leverages intrinsic group dynamics to significantly reduce RL gradient variance; (2) a \textit{Multi-Teacher Distillation} mechanism that corrects SFT fitting bias via diverse reasoning paths; and (3) a \textit{Dynamic Exploitation-Exploration Gating} mechanism that adaptively arbitrates between stable SFT and exploratory RL based on reward feedback. Theoretical analysis confirms that DYPO linearly reduces fitting bias and minimizes overall variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DYPO significantly outperforms traditional sequential pipelines, achieving an average improvement of 4.8\% on complex reasoning benchmarks and 13.3\% on out-of-distribution tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tocci-Zhu/DYPO.

AI.tldr: DYPO是一个统一的大语言模型后训练框架，通过动态策略优化解决SFT和RL之间的偏差-方差权衡问题，显著提升复杂推理和分布外任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型后训练范式（SFT和RL）存在根本性困境：SFT稳定性高但拟合偏差大，RL探索性强但梯度方差高。现有统一优化策略往往采用简单的损失加权，忽视了这两种不同梯度信号之间的统计冲突。
AI.method: 提出DYPO（动态策略优化）框架，包含三个核心组件：1）组对齐损失（GAL），利用内在群体动态显著降低RL梯度方差；2）多教师蒸馏机制，通过多样化推理路径纠正SFT拟合偏差；3）动态利用-探索门控机制，基于奖励反馈自适应仲裁稳定SFT和探索性RL。
AI.result: 理论分析证实DYPO线性减少拟合偏差并最小化总体方差。实验表明DYPO显著优于传统顺序流水线，在复杂推理基准上平均提升4.8%，在分布外任务上提升13.3%。
AI.conclusion: DYPO通过结构性地缓解SFT和RL之间的统计冲突，为LLM后训练提供了一个有效的统一优化框架，在偏差-方差权衡方面取得了理论保证和实践验证的改进。

title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy requires frame-level recognition of visually similar suturing gestures with variable duration and substantial class imbalance. The SIA-RAPN benchmark defines this problem on 50 clinical videos acquired with the da Vinci Xi system and annotated with 12 frame-level labels. The benchmark compares four temporal models built on I3D features: MS-TCN++, AsFormer, TUT, and DiffAct. Evaluation uses balanced accuracy, edit score, segmental F1 at overlap thresholds of 10, 25, and 50, frame-wise accuracy, and frame-wise mean average precision. In addition to the primary evaluation across five released split configurations on SIA-RAPN, the benchmark reports cross-domain results on a separate single-port RAPN dataset. Across the strongest reported values over those five runs on the primary dataset, DiffAct achieves the highest F1, frame-wise accuracy, edit score, and frame mAP, while MS-TCN++ attains the highest balanced accuracy.

AI.tldr: SIA-RAPN基准测试评估了四种时序模型在机器人辅助肾部分切除术中精细动作分割的性能，DiffAct在多个指标上表现最佳
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助肾部分切除术中肾实质缝合阶段的精细动作分割面临视觉相似手势、可变持续时间和类别不平衡的挑战，需要建立标准化基准来评估时序模型性能
AI.method: 创建SIA-RAPN基准数据集（50个临床视频，12个帧级标签），基于I3D特征比较MS-TCN++、AsFormer、TUT和DiffAct四种时序模型，使用多种评估指标并在五个分割配置和跨域数据集上测试
AI.result: DiffAct在F1分数、帧级准确率、编辑分数和帧级mAP上表现最佳，MS-TCN++在平衡准确率上最高，所有模型在跨域测试中性能下降
AI.conclusion: SIA-RAPN基准为机器人辅助手术中的精细动作分割提供了标准化评估框架，DiffAct在大多数指标上表现最优，但跨域泛化仍是挑战

title: Delve into the Applicability of Advanced Optimizers for Multi-Task Learning
summary: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is a foundational machine learning problem that has seen extensive development over the past decade. Recently, various optimization-based MTL approaches have been proposed to learn multiple tasks simultaneously by altering the optimization trajectory. Although these methods strive to de-conflict and re-balance tasks, we empirically identify that their effectiveness is often undermined by an overlooked factor when employing advanced optimizers: the instant-derived gradients play only a marginal role in the actual parameter updates. This discrepancy prevents MTL frameworks from fully releasing its power on learning dynamics. Furthermore, we observe that Muon-a recently emerged advanced optimizer-inherently functions as a multi-task learner, which underscores the critical importance of the gradients used for its orthogonalization. To address these issues, we propose APT (Applicability of advanced oPTimizers), a framework featuring a simple adaptive momentum mechanism designed to balance the strengths between advanced optimizers and MTL. Additionally, we introduce a light direction preservation method to facilitate Muon's orthogonalization. Extensive experiments across four mainstream MTL datasets demonstrate that APT consistently augments existing MTL approaches, yielding substantial performance improvements.

AI.tldr: APT框架通过自适应动量机制和轻量方向保持方法，解决先进优化器在多任务学习中梯度利用率不足的问题，显著提升现有MTL方法性能
AI.motivation: 现有基于优化的多任务学习方法虽然致力于任务解冲突和再平衡，但在使用先进优化器时存在一个被忽视的问题：即时梯度在实际参数更新中作用有限，导致MTL框架无法充分发挥学习动态的潜力。同时发现Muon等先进优化器本身具有多任务学习能力，其正交化所用梯度的质量至关重要。
AI.method: 提出APT框架：1）采用简单的自适应动量机制，平衡先进优化器与MTL的优势；2）引入轻量方向保持方法，促进Muon的正交化过程。
AI.result: 在四个主流MTL数据集上的广泛实验表明，APT能够持续增强现有MTL方法，带来显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: APT框架有效解决了先进优化器在多任务学习中的梯度利用问题，通过自适应动量机制和方向保持方法，显著提升了MTL方法的性能，为优化器与MTL的协同提供了新思路。

title: Tora3: Trajectory-Guided Audio-Video Generation with Physical Coherence
summary: Audio-video (AV) generation has recently made strong progress in perceptual quality and multimodal coherence, yet generating content with plausible motion-sound relations remains challenging. Existing methods often produce object motions that are visually unstable and sounds that are only loosely aligned with salient motion or contact events, largely because they lack an explicit motion-aware structure shared by video and audio generation. We present Tora3, a trajectory-guided AV generation framework that improves physical coherence by using object trajectories as a shared kinematic prior. Rather than treating trajectories as a video-only control signal, Tora3 uses them to jointly guide visual motion and acoustic events. Specifically, we design a trajectory-aligned motion representation for video, a kinematic-audio alignment module driven by trajectory-derived second-order kinematic states, and a hybrid flow matching scheme that preserves trajectory fidelity in trajectory-conditioned regions while maintaining local coherence elsewhere. We further curate PAV, a large-scale AV dataset emphasizing motion-relevant patterns with automatically extracted motion annotations. Extensive experiments show that Tora3 improves motion realism, motion-sound synchronization, and overall AV generation quality over strong open-source baselines.

AI.tldr: Tora3是一个轨迹引导的音频-视频生成框架，通过使用物体轨迹作为共享的运动学先验来改善物理一致性，解决了现有方法在运动-声音关系方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前音频-视频生成方法在感知质量和多模态一致性方面虽有进展，但在生成具有合理运动-声音关系的内容方面仍面临挑战。现有方法常产生视觉不稳定的物体运动，且声音仅与显著运动或接触事件松散对齐，主要原因是缺乏视频和音频生成共享的显式运动感知结构。
AI.method: 提出Tora3框架，使用物体轨迹作为共享运动学先验。具体包括：1) 轨迹对齐的运动表示用于视频；2) 由轨迹导出的二阶运动学状态驱动的运动学-音频对齐模块；3) 混合流匹配方案，在轨迹条件区域保持轨迹保真度，在其他区域保持局部一致性。此外还构建了PAV数据集，强调运动相关模式并包含自动提取的运动标注。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Tora3在运动真实性、运动-声音同步性和整体AV生成质量方面优于强大的开源基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Tora3通过使用物体轨迹作为共享运动学先验，显著改善了音频-视频生成的物理一致性和运动-声音对齐，为多模态生成提供了更合理的运动感知结构。

title: Predictive Entropy Links Calibration and Paraphrase Sensitivity in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical Vision Language Models VLMs suffer from two failure modes that threaten safe deployment mis calibrated confidence and sensitivity to question rephrasing. We show they share a common cause, proximity to the decision boundary, by benchmarking five uncertainty quantification methods on MedGemma 4BIT across in distribution MIMIC CXR and outof distribution PadChest chest X ray datasets, with cross architecture validation on LLaVA RAD7B. For well calibrated single model methods, predictive entropy from one forward pass predicts which samples will flip under rephrasing AUROC 0.711 on MedGemma, 0.878 on LLaVARAD p 10 4, enabling a single entropy threshold to flag both unreliable and rephrase sensitive predictions. A five member LoRA ensemble fails under the MIMIC PadChest shift 42.9 ECE, 34.1 accuracy, though LLaVA RAD s ensemble does not collapse 69.1. MC Dropout achieves the best calibration ECE 4.3 and selective prediction coverage 21.5 at 5 risk, yet total entropy from a single forward pass outperforms the ensemble for both error detection AUROC 0.743 vs 0.657 and paraphrase screening. Simple methods win.

AI.tldr: 研究发现医学视觉语言模型存在两个关键问题：置信度校准不佳和对问题重述敏感。通过评估五种不确定性量化方法，发现预测熵能有效识别不可靠预测，而简单方法优于复杂集成方法。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型在安全部署中存在两个关键问题：1) 置信度校准不佳，可能导致错误信任；2) 对问题重述敏感，同一问题的不同表述可能得到不同答案。这些问题威胁模型在临床环境中的安全应用。
AI.method: 研究在MedGemma 4BIT和LLaVA-RAD(7B)两个模型上评估了五种不确定性量化方法：1) 单次前向传播的预测熵；2) 五成员LoRA集成；3) MC Dropout；4) 其他两种方法。使用MIMIC-CXR（分布内）和PadChest（分布外）胸部X光数据集进行测试，通过AUROC、ECE（预期校准误差）和选择性预测覆盖率等指标评估性能。
AI.result: 1) 预测熵能有效预测哪些样本会在问题重述时改变答案（MedGemma AUROC 0.711，LLaVA-RAD AUROC 0.878）；2) LoRA集成在分布偏移下性能崩溃（ECE 42.9，准确率34.1%）；3) MC Dropout获得最佳校准（ECE 4.3）和选择性预测覆盖率（风险5%时覆盖率21.5%）；4) 单次前向传播的总熵在错误检测（AUROC 0.743 vs 0.657）和重述筛查方面优于集成方法。
AI.conclusion: 医学视觉语言模型的两个主要问题（校准不佳和重述敏感）有共同原因——接近决策边界。简单的单模型方法（如预测熵）在识别不可靠预测方面优于复杂集成方法，为临床部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Learning Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved notable progress in end-to-end autonomous driving by integrating perception, reasoning, and control within a unified multimodal framework. However, they often lack explicit modeling of temporal dynamics and global world consistency, which limits their foresight and safety. In contrast, world models can simulate plausible future scenes but generally struggle to reason about or evaluate the imagined future they generate. In this work, we present VLA-World, a simple yet effective VLA world model that unifies predictive imagination with reflective reasoning to improve driving foresight. VLA-World first uses an action-derived feasible trajectory to guide the generation of the next-frame image, capturing rich spatial and temporal cues that describe how the surrounding environment evolves. The model then reasons over this self-generated future imagined frame to refine the predicted trajectory, achieving higher performance and better interpretability. To support this pipeline, we curate nuScenes-GR-20K, a generative reasoning dataset derived from nuScenes, and employ a three-stage training strategy that includes pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VLA-World consistently surpasses state-of-the-art VLA and world-model baselines on both planning and future-generation benchmarks. Project page: https://vlaworld.github.io

AI.tldr: VLA-World是一个将预测想象与反思推理结合的视觉-语言-动作世界模型，通过自生成未来帧来改进自动驾驶的预见性和安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏对时间动态和全局世界一致性的显式建模，限制了其预见性和安全性；而世界模型虽然能模拟未来场景，但难以对生成的想象未来进行推理或评估。
AI.method: 提出VLA-World模型：1) 使用动作导出的可行轨迹指导生成下一帧图像，捕捉环境演化的时空线索；2) 对自生成的未来想象帧进行推理，精炼预测轨迹。构建nuScenes-GR-20K数据集，采用预训练、监督微调和强化学习的三阶段训练策略。
AI.result: VLA-World在规划和未来生成基准测试中持续超越最先进的VLA和世界模型基线，表现出更高的性能和更好的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: VLA-World通过统一预测想象与反思推理，有效提升了自动驾驶的预见能力，为端到端自动驾驶系统提供了更安全、更可靠的解决方案。

title: BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation
summary: Accurate evaluation is central to the large language model (LLM) ecosystem, guiding model selection and downstream adoption across diverse use cases. In practice, however, evaluating generative outputs typically relies on rigid lexical methods to extract and assess answers, which can conflate a model's true problem-solving ability with its compliance with predefined formatting guidelines. While recent LLM-as-a-Judge approaches mitigate this issue by assessing semantic correctness rather than strict structural conformity, they also introduce substantial computational overhead, making evaluation costly. In this work, we first systematically investigate the limitations of lexical evaluation through a large-scale empirical study spanning 36 models and 15 downstream tasks, demonstrating that such methods correlate poorly with human judgments. To address this limitation, we introduce BERT-as-a-Judge, an encoder-driven approach for assessing answer correctness in reference-based generative settings, robust to variations in output phrasing, and requiring only lightweight training on synthetically annotated question-candidate-reference triplets. We show that it consistently outperforms the lexical baseline while matching the performance of much larger LLM judges, providing a compelling tradeoff between the two and enabling reliable, scalable evaluation. Finally, through extensive experimentation, we provide detailed insights into BERT-as-a-Judge's performance to offer practical guidance for practitioners, and release all project artifacts to foster downstream adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出BERT-as-a-Judge方法，使用轻量级编码器评估生成式模型的答案正确性，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算成本，解决了传统词汇匹配评估方法的相关性差和LLM评估计算开销大的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型评估存在两个主要问题：1) 传统的词汇匹配评估方法将模型真实问题解决能力与预定义格式合规性混为一谈，与人类判断相关性差；2) 新兴的LLM-as-a-Judge方法虽然评估语义正确性，但计算开销巨大，成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出BERT-as-a-Judge方法：1) 通过大规模实证研究（36个模型，15个下游任务）系统分析词汇评估的局限性；2) 开发基于编码器的评估方法，对输出措辞变化具有鲁棒性；3) 仅需在合成标注的问题-候选-参考三元组上进行轻量级训练。
AI.result: BERT-as-a-Judge在性能上持续优于词汇基线，同时匹配更大规模LLM评估器的性能，提供了两者之间的理想权衡。该方法实现了可靠、可扩展的评估，计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: BERT-as-a-Judge为生成式模型评估提供了高效、准确的解决方案，通过详细实验分析为实践者提供实用指导，并开源所有项目资源以促进下游应用。

title: You Can't Fight in Here! This is BBS!
comment: Accepted at Behavioral and Brain Sciences as a response to the commentaries to the accepted target article "How Linguistics Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Language Models", whose preprint appears here: arXiv:2501.17047
summary: Norm, the formal theoretical linguist, and Claudette, the computational language scientist, have a lovely time discussing whether modern language models can inform important questions in the language sciences. Just as they are about to part ways until they meet again, 25 of their closest friends show up -- from linguistics, neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology, philosophy, and computer science. We use this discussion to highlight what we see as some common underlying issues: the String Statistics Strawman (the mistaken idea that LMs can't be linguistically competent or interesting because they, like their Markov model predecessors, are statistical models that learn from strings) and the As Good As it Gets Assumption (the idea that LM research as it stands in 2026 is the limit of what it can tell us about linguistics). We clarify the role of LM-based work for scientific insights into human language and advocate for a more expansive research program for the language sciences in the AI age, one that takes on the commentators' concerns in order to produce a better and more robust science of both human language and of LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Norm和Claudette的对话讨论，探讨了现代语言模型能否为语言科学提供重要见解，并指出了该领域存在的两个常见误解：字符串统计稻草人谬误和"已经够好"假设。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在澄清语言模型研究在人类语言科学中的作用，回应学术界对语言模型能力的常见误解，并倡导在AI时代建立更广泛的语言科学研究计划。
AI.method: 采用对话讨论的形式，汇集了来自语言学、神经科学、认知科学、心理学、哲学和计算机科学等25位学者的观点，通过多学科视角分析语言模型研究的现状和问题。
AI.result: 识别了两个关键问题：1) 字符串统计稻草人谬误——错误地认为语言模型只是统计字符串的模型，缺乏语言能力；2) "已经够好"假设——认为2026年的语言模型研究已经达到了极限。文章澄清了语言模型研究的科学价值。
AI.conclusion: 需要建立一个更广泛的语言科学研究计划，既要考虑评论者的关切，又要利用语言模型为人类语言科学提供更深入的理解，同时推动语言模型本身的发展，实现更稳健的语言科学和语言模型研究。

title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 8th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in robotics is often limited by the cost and risk of data collection, motivating experience transfer from a source task to a target task. Offline-to-online RL leverages prior data but typically assumes a given fixed dataset and does not address how to generate reliable data for transfer. We propose \textit{World Model-based Experience Transfer} (WOMBET), a framework that jointly generates and utilizes prior data. WOMBET learns a world model in the source task and generates offline data via uncertainty-penalized planning, followed by filtering trajectories with high return and low epistemic uncertainty. It then performs online fine-tuning in the target task using adaptive sampling between offline and online data, enabling a stable transition from prior-driven initialization to task-specific adaptation. We show that the uncertainty-penalized objective provides a lower bound on the true return and derive a finite-sample error decomposition capturing distribution mismatch and approximation error. Empirically, WOMBET improves sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines on continuous control benchmarks, demonstrating the benefit of jointly optimizing data generation and transfer.

AI.tldr: WOMBET提出了一种基于世界模型的体验迁移框架，通过不确定性惩罚规划生成可靠的离线数据，并在目标任务中自适应采样进行在线微调，显著提升了样本效率和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人强化学习中数据收集的成本和风险限制了其应用，现有的离线到在线RL方法通常假设已有固定数据集，但未解决如何生成可靠的迁移数据这一关键问题。
AI.method: WOMBET框架包含两个核心阶段：1) 在源任务中学习世界模型，通过不确定性惩罚规划生成离线数据，筛选高回报低认知不确定性的轨迹；2) 在目标任务中进行在线微调，采用离线与在线数据间的自适应采样策略，实现从先验驱动初始化到任务特定适应的稳定过渡。
AI.result: 理论分析表明不确定性惩罚目标提供了真实回报的下界，并推导了捕获分布不匹配和近似误差的有限样本误差分解。在连续控制基准测试中，WOMBET相比强基线显著提升了样本效率和最终性能。
AI.conclusion: WOMBET通过联合优化数据生成和迁移过程，证明了同时考虑数据生成和利用的重要性，为解决机器人强化学习中的数据效率问题提供了有效框架。

title: Many Ways to Be Fake: Benchmarking Fake News Detection Under Strategy-Driven AI Generation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the large-scale generation of highly fluent and deceptive news-like content. While prior work has often treated fake news detection as a binary classification problem, modern fake news increasingly arises through human-AI collaboration, where strategic inaccuracies are embedded within otherwise accurate and credible narratives. These mixed-truth cases represent a realistic and consequential threat, yet they remain underrepresented in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce MANYFAKE, a synthetic benchmark containing 6,798 fake news articles generated through multiple strategy-driven prompting pipelines that capture many ways fake news can be constructed and refined. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of state-of-the-art fake news detectors. Our results show that even advanced reasoning-enabled models approach saturation on fully fabricated stories, but remain brittle when falsehoods are subtle, optimized, and interwoven with accurate information.

AI.tldr: MANYFAKE是一个包含6,798篇合成假新闻文章的基准数据集，通过多种策略驱动的提示管道生成，用于评估假新闻检测器在混合真伪内容上的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前假新闻检测通常被视为二元分类问题，但现代假新闻越来越多地通过人机协作产生，将战略性不准确信息嵌入到原本准确可信的叙述中。这些混合真伪案例代表了现实且严重的威胁，但在现有基准中代表性不足。
AI.method: 引入MANYFAKE合成基准，包含6,798篇假新闻文章，通过多种策略驱动的提示管道生成，捕捉假新闻构建和优化的多种方式。使用该基准评估一系列最先进的假新闻检测器。
AI.result: 即使先进的推理模型在完全虚构的故事上接近饱和性能，但在虚假信息微妙、优化且与准确信息交织的情况下仍然脆弱。混合真伪内容对现有检测器构成显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发更强大的假新闻检测方法，能够处理混合真伪内容，其中虚假信息被战略性地嵌入到可信叙述中。MANYFAKE基准为这一研究方向提供了重要资源。

title: Efficient Hierarchical Implicit Flow Q-learning for Offline Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) is a practical reinforcement learning paradigm that aims to learn goal-conditioned policies from reward-free offline data. Despite recent advances in hierarchical architectures such as HIQL, long-horizon control in offline GCRL remains challenging due to the limited expressiveness of Gaussian policies and the inability of high-level policies to generate effective subgoals. To address these limitations, we propose the goal-conditioned mean flow policy, which introduces an average velocity field into hierarchical policy modeling for offline GCRL. Specifically, the mean flow policy captures complex target distributions for both high-level and low-level policies through a learned average velocity field, enabling efficient action generation via one-step sampling. Furthermore, considering the insufficiency of goal representation, we introduce a LeJEPA loss that repels goal representation embeddings during training, thereby encouraging more discriminative representations and improving generalization. Experimental results show that our method achieves strong performance across both state-based and pixel-based tasks in the OGBench benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于离线目标条件强化学习的平均流策略，通过引入平均速度场来改进分层策略建模，解决了高斯策略表达能力有限和高层策略生成有效子目标能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习中，高斯策略的表达能力有限，高层策略难以生成有效的子目标，导致长时程控制任务表现不佳。现有方法如HIQL等分层架构仍面临这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出目标条件平均流策略，在分层策略建模中引入平均速度场，通过一步采样高效生成动作。同时引入LeJEPA损失函数，在训练中排斥目标表示嵌入，鼓励更具区分性的表示以提高泛化能力。
AI.result: 在OGBench基准测试中，该方法在基于状态和基于像素的任务上都取得了强劲的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 平均流策略通过改进分层策略建模和目标表示学习，有效解决了离线目标条件强化学习中的长时程控制挑战，为实际应用提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation from Spatial Transcriptomics to Histology
comment: Accepted to the CVMI Workshop at CVPR 2026. Project page: https://cross-modal-distillation.github.io/
summary: Spatial transcriptomics provides a molecularly rich description of tissue organization, enabling unsupervised discovery of tissue niches -- spatially coherent regions of distinct cell-type composition and function that are relevant to both biological research and clinical interpretation. However, spatial transcriptomics remains costly and scarce, while H&E histology is abundant but carries a less granular signal. We propose to leverage paired spatial transcriptomics and H&E data to transfer transcriptomics-derived niche structure to a histology-only model via cross-modal distillation. Across multiple tissue types and disease contexts, the distilled model achieves substantially higher agreement with transcriptomics-derived niche structure than unsupervised morphology-based baselines trained on identical image features, and recovers biologically meaningful neighborhood composition as confirmed by cell-type analysis. The resulting framework leverages paired spatial transcriptomic and H&E data during training, and can then be applied to held-out tissue regions using histology alone, without any transcriptomic input at inference time.

AI.tldr: 通过跨模态蒸馏将空间转录组学发现的组织生态位结构迁移到仅需H&E组织学的模型，实现仅用组织学图像即可推断转录组学定义的生态位
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学成本高且稀缺，而H&E组织学丰富但信号粒度较粗，需要利用配对数据将转录组学发现的生态位结构迁移到仅需组织学的模型
AI.method: 提出跨模态蒸馏框架，利用配对的空间转录组学和H&E数据训练模型，将转录组学定义的生态位结构知识迁移到仅基于组织学图像的模型
AI.result: 蒸馏模型在多种组织类型和疾病背景下，与转录组学定义的生态位结构一致性显著高于基于相同图像特征的无监督形态学基线，并通过细胞类型分析验证了生物学意义的邻域组成恢复
AI.conclusion: 该框架在训练时利用配对数据，推理时仅需H&E组织学即可应用，无需转录组学输入，为大规模组织学数据分析提供了转录组学级别的生态位发现能力

title: Large Language Models Generate Harmful Content Using a Distinct, Unified Mechanism
summary: Large language models (LLMs) undergo alignment training to avoid harmful behaviors, yet the resulting safeguards remain brittle: jailbreaks routinely bypass them, and fine-tuning on narrow domains can induce ``emergent misalignment'' that generalizes broadly. Whether this brittleness reflects a fundamental lack of coherent internal organization for harmfulness remains unclear. Here we use targeted weight pruning as a causal intervention to probe the internal organization of harmfulness in LLMs. We find that harmful content generation depends on a compact set of weights that are general across harm types and distinct from benign capabilities. Aligned models exhibit a greater compression of harm generation weights than unaligned counterparts, indicating that alignment reshapes harmful representations internally--despite the brittleness of safety guardrails at the surface level. This compression explains emergent misalignment: if weights of harmful capabilities are compressed, fine-tuning that engages these weights in one domain can trigger broad misalignment. Consistent with this, pruning harm generation weights in a narrow domain substantially reduces emergent misalignment. Notably, LLMs harmful generation capability is dissociated from how they recognize and explain such content. Together, these results reveal a coherent internal structure for harmfulness in LLMs that may serve as a foundation for more principled approaches to safety.

AI.tldr: 通过定向权重剪枝发现LLMs中的有害内容生成依赖于一组紧凑的权重，这些权重在不同有害类型间通用且与良性能力分离。对齐训练压缩了这些权重，解释了"涌现错位"现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs经过对齐训练以避免有害行为，但安全防护措施仍然脆弱：越狱攻击经常绕过它们，在狭窄领域微调可能导致"涌现错位"。这种脆弱性是否反映了有害性内部缺乏连贯的组织结构尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用定向权重剪枝作为因果干预手段，探测LLMs中有害性的内部组织。分析有害内容生成所依赖的权重集，比较对齐与未对齐模型中的权重压缩程度，并研究权重剪枝对涌现错位的影响。
AI.result: 1) 有害内容生成依赖于一组紧凑的权重，这些权重在不同有害类型间通用且与良性能力分离；2) 对齐模型比未对齐模型表现出更大的有害生成权重压缩；3) 这种压缩解释了涌现错位现象；4) 在狭窄领域剪枝有害生成权重显著减少涌现错位；5) LLMs的有害生成能力与其识别和解释此类内容的能力是分离的。
AI.conclusion: LLMs中存在有害性的连贯内部结构，这种结构可能为更原则性的安全方法奠定基础。对齐训练在内部重塑了有害表示，尽管表面上的安全防护措施仍然脆弱。

title: Neighbourhood Transformer: Switchable Attention for Monophily-Aware Graph Learning
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted in engineering applications such as social network analysis, chemical research and computer vision. However, their efficacy is severely compromised by the inherent homophily assumption, which fails to hold for heterophilic graphs where dissimilar nodes are frequently connected. To address this fundamental limitation in graph learning, we first draw inspiration from the recently discovered monophily property of real-world graphs, and propose Neighbourhood Transformers (NT), a novel paradigm that applies self-attention within every local neighbourhood instead of aggregating messages to the central node as in conventional message-passing GNNs. This design makes NT inherently monophily-aware and theoretically guarantees its expressiveness is no weaker than traditional message-passing frameworks. For practical engineering deployment, we further develop a neighbourhood partitioning strategy equipped with switchable attentions, which reduces the space consumption of NT by over 95% and time consumption by up to 92.67%, significantly expanding its applicability to larger graphs. Extensive experiments on 10 real-world datasets (5 heterophilic and 5 homophilic graphs) show that NT outperforms all current state-of-the-art methods on node classification tasks, demonstrating its superior performance and cross-domain adaptability. The full implementation code of this work is publicly available at https://github.com/cf020031308/MoNT to facilitate reproducibility and industrial adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出Neighbourhood Transformers（NT）解决GNN在异配图上的性能下降问题，通过局部邻域自注意力机制替代传统消息传递，实现单配性感知并保证表达能力不弱于传统框架，同时开发邻域分区策略大幅降低时空消耗。
AI.motivation: 传统GNN基于同配性假设，在异配图（相似节点不常相连）上性能严重下降。受现实图单配性特性启发，需要设计能够处理异配图的图学习方法。
AI.method: 提出Neighbourhood Transformers（NT）范式，在局部邻域内应用自注意力机制而非传统消息传递的聚合方式。开发邻域分区策略配合可切换注意力，大幅降低时空消耗（空间减少95%以上，时间减少最多92.67%）。
AI.result: 在10个真实数据集（5个异配图和5个同配图）上的节点分类任务中，NT超越了所有当前最先进方法，展示了优越性能和跨领域适应性。
AI.conclusion: NT通过局部邻域自注意力机制有效解决了GNN在异配图上的局限性，在保持理论表达能力的同时大幅降低计算成本，为图学习提供了新的有效范式。

title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch
summary: We propose a multimodal, physically grounded approach for metric-scale amodal object reconstruction and pose estimation under severe hand occlusion. Unlike prior occlusion-aware 3D generation methods that rely only on vision, we leverage physical interaction signals: proprioception provides the posed hand geometry, and multi-contact touch constrains where the object surface must lie, reducing ambiguity in occluded regions. We represent object structure as a pose-aware, camera-aligned signed distance field (SDF) and learn a compact latent space with a Structure-VAE. In this latent space, we train a conditional flow-matching diffusion model, pretraining on vision-only images and finetuning on occluded manipulation scenes while conditioning on visible RGB evidence, occluder/visibility masks, the hand latent representation, and tactile information. Crucially, we incorporate physics-based objectives and differentiable decoder-guidance during finetuning and inference to reduce hand--object interpenetration and to align the reconstructed surface with contact observations. Because our method produces a metric, physically consistent structure estimate, it integrates naturally into existing two-stage reconstruction pipelines, where a downstream module refines geometry and predicts appearance. Experiments in simulation show that adding proprioception and touch substantially improves completion under occlusion and yields physically plausible reconstructions at correct real-world scale compared to vision-only baselines; we further validate transfer by deploying the model on a real humanoid robot with an end-effector different from those used during training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多模态物理基础方法，用于在严重手部遮挡下进行度量尺度无模态物体重建和姿态估计，结合视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号
AI.motivation: 现有遮挡感知3D生成方法仅依赖视觉，在严重手部遮挡下存在模糊性。需要利用物理交互信号（本体感觉提供手部几何姿态，多接触触觉约束物体表面位置）来减少遮挡区域的模糊性
AI.method: 1) 使用姿态感知、相机对齐的有符号距离场(SDF)表示物体结构；2) 学习紧凑的潜在空间(Structure-VAE)；3) 在潜在空间中训练条件流匹配扩散模型，先在仅视觉图像上预训练，后在遮挡操作场景上微调；4) 条件输入包括可见RGB证据、遮挡/可见性掩码、手部潜在表示和触觉信息；5) 微调和推理时加入基于物理的目标和可微分解码器引导，减少手-物体穿透并使重建表面与接触观测对齐
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，添加本体感觉和触觉显著改善了遮挡下的补全效果，相比仅视觉基线产生了物理上合理、正确真实世界尺度的重建结果。模型成功部署到具有与训练不同末端执行器的真实人形机器人上，验证了迁移能力
AI.conclusion: 多模态物理基础方法通过结合视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，能够在严重手部遮挡下实现度量尺度、物理一致的无模态物体重建和姿态估计，自然集成到现有两阶段重建流程中

title: The nextAI Solution to the NeurIPS 2023 LLM Efficiency Challenge
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly impacted the field of natural language processing, but their growing complexity raises concerns about resource usage and transparency. Addressing these challenges, we participated in the NeurIPS LLM Efficiency Challenge, aiming to fine-tune a foundation model within stringent constraints. Our focus was the LLaMa2 70 billion model, optimized on a single A100 40GB GPU within a 24-hour limit. Our methodology hinged on a custom dataset, carefully assembled from diverse open-source resources and benchmark tests, aligned with the challenge's open-source ethos. Our approach leveraged Quantized-Low Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) Fine tuning, integrated with advanced attention mechanisms like Flash Attention 2. We experimented with various configurations of the LoRA technique, optimizing the balance between computational efficiency and model accuracy. Our fine-tuning strategy was underpinned by the creation and iterative testing of multiple dataset compositions, leading to the selection of a version that demonstrated robust performance across diverse tasks and benchmarks. The culmination of our efforts was an efficiently fine-tuned LLaMa2 70B model that operated within the constraints of a single GPU, showcasing not only a significant reduction in resource utilization but also high accuracy across a range of QA benchmarks. Our study serves as a testament to the feasibility of optimizing large-scale models in resource-constrained environments, emphasizing the potential of LLMs in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 在NeurIPS LLM效率挑战中，使用QLoRA微调技术，在单张A100 40GB GPU上24小时内成功优化LLaMa2 70B模型，显著降低资源消耗的同时保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展带来了资源使用和透明度方面的挑战。为了在资源受限环境中优化大规模模型，参与NeurIPS LLM效率挑战，旨在严格的约束条件下微调基础模型。
AI.method: 采用量化低秩适应（QLoRA）微调技术，结合Flash Attention 2等先进注意力机制。使用从多种开源资源和基准测试中精心组装的定制数据集，实验不同的LoRA配置以平衡计算效率和模型精度。通过迭代测试多个数据集组合，选择在多样化任务和基准测试中表现稳健的版本。
AI.result: 成功在单GPU约束下实现了高效的LLaMa2 70B模型微调，不仅显著降低了资源利用率，还在多个QA基准测试中展现出高精度。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了在资源受限环境中优化大规模模型的可行性，强调了LLMs在现实世界应用中的潜力，为高效微调大型语言模型提供了实用方法。

title: U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster
comment: Our code is available at: https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/u-cast
summary: AI-based weather forecasting now rivals traditional physics-based ensembles, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models rely on specialized architectures and massive computational budgets, creating a high barrier to entry. We demonstrate that such complexity is unnecessary for frontier performance. We introduce U-Cast, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity. As a result, our model matches or exceeds the probabilistic skill of GenCast and IFS ENS at 1.5$^\circ\$ resolution while reducing training compute by over 10$\times$ compared to leading CRPS-based models and inference latency by over 10$\times$ compared to diffusion-based models. U-Cast trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days and generates a 60-step ensemble forecast in 11 seconds. These results suggest that scalable, general-purpose architectures paired with efficient training curricula can match complex domain-specific designs at a fraction of the cost, opening the training of frontier probabilistic weather models to the broader community. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/u-cast.

AI.tldr: U-Cast：基于标准U-Net架构的简化概率天气预报模型，通过确定性预训练+概率微调的简单方法，在显著降低计算成本的同时达到或超越现有最先进模型的性能
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的AI天气预报模型依赖专门架构和巨大计算预算，形成了较高的进入门槛。研究旨在证明实现前沿性能并不需要这种复杂性，希望开发更易访问的解决方案
AI.method: 使用标准U-Net作为主干架构，采用简单的训练方案：先在平均绝对误差上进行确定性预训练，然后使用蒙特卡洛Dropout进行随机性，在连续排序概率得分上进行短时间的概率微调
AI.result: 在1.5°分辨率下，U-Cast匹配或超越了GenCast和IFS ENS的概率技能，同时相比领先的CRPS模型减少了10倍以上的训练计算量，相比基于扩散的模型减少了10倍以上的推理延迟。模型在12个H200 GPU天内完成训练，11秒内生成60步集合预报
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的通用架构与高效训练课程相结合，能够以极低成本匹配复杂的领域特定设计，这为更广泛的社区开放了前沿概率天气模型的训练机会

title: FIRE-CIR: Fine-grained Reasoning for Composed Fashion Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that depicts a reference image modified by a textual description. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) achieve promising CIR performance by embedding images and text into a shared space for retrieval, they often fail to reason about what to preserve and what to change. This limitation hinders interpretability and yields suboptimal results, particularly in fine-grained domains like fashion. In this paper, we introduce FIRE-CIR, a model that brings compositional reasoning and interpretability to fashion CIR. Instead of relying solely on embedding similarity, FIRE-CIR performs question-driven visual reasoning: it automatically generates attribute-focused visual questions derived from the modification text, and verifies the corresponding visual evidence in both reference and candidate images. To train such a reasoning system, we automatically construct a large-scale fashion-specific visual question answering dataset, containing questions requiring either single- or dual-image analysis. During retrieval, our model leverages this explicit reasoning to re-rank candidate results, filtering out images inconsistent with the intended modifications. Experimental results on the Fashion IQ benchmark show that FIRE-CIR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in retrieval accuracy. It also provides interpretable, attribute-level insights into retrieval decisions.

AI.tldr: FIRE-CIR：一种通过问题驱动的视觉推理实现可解释性时尚组合图像检索的新方法
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在组合图像检索中主要依赖嵌入相似度，缺乏对"保留什么、改变什么"的显式推理能力，导致可解释性差且在时尚等细粒度领域表现不佳。
AI.method: FIRE-CIR采用问题驱动的视觉推理：1) 从修改文本自动生成属性聚焦的视觉问题；2) 在参考图像和候选图像中验证相应的视觉证据；3) 利用大规模自动构建的时尚特定视觉问答数据集进行训练；4) 在检索时使用显式推理对候选结果进行重排序。
AI.result: 在Fashion IQ基准测试中，FIRE-CIR在检索准确率上超越了最先进的方法，同时提供了可解释的属性级检索决策洞察。
AI.conclusion: FIRE-CIR通过引入显式的组合推理机制，不仅提升了时尚组合图像检索的性能，还增强了模型的可解释性，为细粒度视觉推理任务提供了新思路。

title: PDE-regularized Dynamics-informed Diffusion with Uncertainty-aware Filtering for Long-Horizon Dynamics
summary: Long-horizon spatiotemporal prediction remains a challenging problem due to cumulative errors, noise amplification, and the lack of physical consistency in existing models. While diffusion models provide a probabilistic framework for modeling uncertainty, conventional approaches often rely on mean squared error objectives and fail to capture the underlying dynamics governed by physical laws. In this work, we propose PDYffusion, a dynamics-informed diffusion framework that integrates PDE-based regularization and uncertainty-aware forecasting for stable long-term prediction. The proposed method consists of two key components: a PDE-regularized interpolator and a UKF-based forecaster. The interpolator incorporates a differential operator to enforce physically consistent intermediate states, while the forecaster leverages the Unscented Kalman Filter to explicitly model uncertainty and mitigate error accumulation during iterative prediction. We provide theoretical analyses showing that the proposed interpolator satisfies PDE-constrained smoothness properties, and that the forecaster converges under the proposed loss formulation. Extensive experiments on multiple dynamical datasets demonstrate that PDYffusion achieves superior performance in terms of CRPS and MSE, while maintaining stable uncertainty behavior measured by SSR. We further analyze the inherent trade-off between prediction accuracy and uncertainty, showing that our method provides a balanced and robust solution for long-horizon forecasting.

AI.tldr: PDYffusion是一个基于物理约束的扩散框架，通过PDE正则化和UKF不确定性建模解决长时程时空预测中的误差累积和物理不一致问题
AI.motivation: 现有长时程时空预测模型存在误差累积、噪声放大和缺乏物理一致性的问题，传统扩散模型虽然能建模不确定性，但依赖均方误差目标且无法捕捉物理规律约束的底层动力学
AI.method: 提出PDYffusion框架，包含两个核心组件：1) PDE正则化插值器，通过微分算子强制物理一致的中间状态；2) UKF预测器，利用无迹卡尔曼滤波器显式建模不确定性并减轻迭代预测中的误差累积
AI.result: 在多个动力学数据集上的实验表明，PDYffusion在CRPS和MSE指标上表现优异，同时通过SSR测量保持稳定的不确定性行为，在预测精度和不确定性之间实现了平衡
AI.conclusion: PDYffusion通过整合PDE正则化和不确定性感知预测，为长时程预测提供了平衡且鲁棒的解决方案，理论分析证明了插值器满足PDE约束平滑性，预测器在提出的损失公式下收敛

title: Few-Shot Personalized Age Estimation
summary: Existing age estimation methods treat each face as an independent sample, learning a global mapping from appearance to age. This ignores a well-documented phenomenon: individuals age at different rates due to genetics, lifestyle, and health, making the mapping from face to age identity-dependent. When reference images of the same person with known ages are available, we can exploit this context to personalize the estimate. The only existing benchmark for this task (NIST FRVT) is closed-source and limited to a single reference image. In this work, we introduce OpenPAE, the first open benchmark for $N$-shot personalized age estimation with strict evaluation protocols. We establish a hierarchy of increasingly sophisticated baselines: from arithmetic offset, through closed-form Bayesian linear regression, to a conditional attentive neural process. Our experiments show that personalization consistently improves performance, that the gains are not merely domain adaptation, and that nonlinear methods significantly outperform simpler alternatives. We release all models, code, protocols, and evaluation splits.

AI.tldr: OpenPAE：首个用于N-shot个性化年龄估计的开放基准，通过利用同一人的参考图像来改进年龄估计，超越传统独立样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有年龄估计方法将每个面部视为独立样本，学习从外观到年龄的全局映射，忽略了由于遗传、生活方式和健康等因素导致的个体衰老速率差异。当同一人已知年龄的参考图像可用时，可以利用这种上下文信息来个性化估计。
AI.method: 引入OpenPAE基准，建立层次化基线方法：从算术偏移，到封闭形式的贝叶斯线性回归，再到条件注意力神经过程。使用严格的评估协议进行N-shot个性化年龄估计。
AI.result: 实验表明个性化一致提高性能，这些改进不仅仅是领域适应，非线性方法显著优于简单替代方案。
AI.conclusion: OpenPAE为个性化年龄估计提供了首个开放基准，证明利用同一人的参考图像可以显著改进年龄估计，并发布了所有模型、代码、协议和评估分割。

title: Feature-Label Modal Alignment for Robust Partial Multi-Label Learning
summary: In partial multi-label learning (PML), each instance is associated with a set of candidate labels containing both ground-truth and noisy labels. The presence of noisy labels disrupts the correspondence between features and labels, degrading classification performance. To address this challenge, we propose a novel PML method based on feature-label modal alignment (PML-MA), which treats features and labels as two complementary modalities and restores their consistency through systematic alignment. Specifically, PML-MA first employs low-rank orthogonal decomposition to generate pseudo-labels that approximate the true label distribution by filtering noisy labels. It then aligns features and pseudo-labels through both global projection into a common subspace and local preservation of neighborhood structures. Finally, a multi-peak class prototype learning mechanism leverages the multi-label nature where instances simultaneously belong to multiple categories, using pseudo-labels as soft membership weights to enhance discriminability. By integrating modal alignment with prototype-guided refinement, PML-MA ensures pseudo-labels better reflect the true distribution while maintaining robustness against label noise. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that PML-MA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior classification accuracy and noise robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出PML-MA方法，通过特征-标签模态对齐解决部分多标签学习中的噪声标签问题，结合低秩正交分解生成伪标签、全局-局部模态对齐和多峰值类原型学习，显著提升分类性能
AI.motivation: 部分多标签学习(PML)中，每个实例关联的候选标签集包含真实标签和噪声标签，噪声标签破坏了特征与标签之间的对应关系，导致分类性能下降。需要一种有效方法来恢复特征与标签之间的一致性，提高噪声鲁棒性。
AI.method:
1. 低秩正交分解：生成近似真实标签分布的伪标签，过滤噪声标签
2. 模态对齐：全局投影到共同子空间 + 局部保持邻域结构，对齐特征和伪标签
3. 多峰值类原型学习：利用多标签特性，使用伪标签作为软成员权重增强判别性
4. 模态对齐与原型引导精化的集成框架
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成数据集上的广泛实验表明，PML-MA显著优于现有最先进方法，实现了优越的分类准确性和噪声鲁棒性。伪标签能更好地反映真实分布，同时保持对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PML-MA通过特征-标签模态对齐有效解决了部分多标签学习中的噪声标签问题，结合伪标签生成、模态对齐和原型学习，显著提升了分类性能，为PML问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: FaceLiVTv2: An Improved Hybrid Architecture for Efficient Mobile Face Recognition
summary: Lightweight face recognition is increasingly important for deployment on edge and mobile devices, where strict constraints on latency, memory, and energy consumption must be met alongside reliable accuracy. Although recent hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures have advanced global context modeling, striking an effective balance between recognition performance and computational efficiency remains an open challenge. In this work, we present FaceLiVTv2, an improved version of our FaceLiVT hybrid architecture designed for efficient global--local feature interaction in mobile face recognition. At its core is Lite MHLA, a lightweight global token interaction module that replaces the original multi-layer attention design with multi-head linear token projections and affine rescale transformations, reducing redundancy while preserving representational diversity across heads. We further integrate Lite MHLA into a unified RepMix block that coordinates local and global feature interactions and adopts global depthwise convolution for adaptive spatial aggregation in the embedding stage. Under our experimental setup, results on LFW, CA-LFW, CP-LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, and IJB show that FaceLiVTv2 consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over existing lightweight methods. Notably, FaceLiVTv2 reduces mobile inference latency by 22% relative to FaceLiVTv1, achieves speedups of up to 30.8% over GhostFaceNets on mobile devices, and delivers 20-41% latency improvements over EdgeFace and KANFace across platforms while maintaining higher recognition accuracy. These results demonstrate that FaceLiVTv2 offers a practical and deployable solution for real-time face recognition. Code is available at https://github.com/novendrastywn/FaceLiVT.

AI.tldr: FaceLiVTv2是一种改进的轻量级人脸识别混合架构，通过Lite MHLA模块和RepMix块优化全局-局部特征交互，在移动设备上实现更优的精度-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 边缘和移动设备上的人脸识别需要满足严格的延迟、内存和能耗约束，同时保持可靠的准确性。尽管现有的混合CNN-Transformer架构在全局上下文建模方面有所进展，但在识别性能和计算效率之间取得有效平衡仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出FaceLiVTv2架构，核心是Lite MHLA模块：使用多头线性令牌投影和仿射重缩放变换替代原始的多层注意力设计，减少冗余同时保持头间的表示多样性。将Lite MHLA集成到统一的RepMix块中，协调局部和全局特征交互，并在嵌入阶段采用全局深度卷积进行自适应空间聚合。
