AI.result: 在LFW、CA-LFW、CP-LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30和IJB等基准测试中，FaceLiVTv2相比现有轻量级方法持续改善了精度-效率权衡。相比FaceLiVTv1减少22%移动推理延迟，相比GhostFaceNets在移动设备上提速30.8%，相比EdgeFace和KANFace在不同平台上实现20-41%延迟改进，同时保持更高的识别精度。
AI.conclusion: FaceLiVTv2为实时人脸识别提供了一个实用且可部署的解决方案，在移动设备上实现了更好的精度-效率平衡，代码已开源。

title: Strips as Tokens: Artist Mesh Generation with Native UV Segmentation
summary: Recent advancements in autoregressive transformers have demonstrated remarkable potential for generating artist-quality meshes. However, the token ordering strategies employed by existing methods typically fail to meet professional artist standards, where coordinate-based sorting yields inefficiently long sequences, and patch-based heuristics disrupt the continuous edge flow and structural regularity essential for high-quality modeling. To address these limitations, we propose Strips as Tokens (SATO), a novel framework with a token ordering strategy inspired by triangle strips. By constructing the sequence as a connected chain of faces that explicitly encodes UV boundaries, our method naturally preserves the organized edge flow and semantic layout characteristic of artist-created meshes. A key advantage of this formulation is its unified representation, enabling the same token sequence to be decoded into either a triangle or quadrilateral mesh. This flexibility facilitates joint training on both data types: large-scale triangle data provides fundamental structural priors, while high-quality quad data enhances the geometric regularity of the outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SATO consistently outperforms prior methods in terms of geometric quality, structural coherence, and UV segmentation.

AI.tldr: SATO提出了一种基于三角形条带（triangle strips）的token排序策略，用于生成艺术家级质量的网格，解决了现有方法中坐标排序导致序列过长、基于patch的启发式方法破坏边缘流和结构规律性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归transformer生成网格的方法中，token排序策略通常无法达到专业艺术家标准：基于坐标的排序会产生低效的长序列，而基于patch的启发式方法会破坏高质量建模所需的连续边缘流和结构规律性。
AI.method: 提出SATO框架，采用受三角形条带启发的token排序策略。通过将序列构建为明确编码UV边界的连接面链，该方法自然保留了艺术家创建网格的组织边缘流和语义布局。关键优势是统一表示，使同一token序列可解码为三角形或四边形网格。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SATO在几何质量、结构连贯性和UV分割方面持续优于先前方法。通过联合训练三角形和四边形数据，大规模三角形数据提供基础结构先验，高质量四边形数据增强输出的几何规律性。
AI.conclusion: SATO通过创新的三角形条带token排序策略，解决了现有网格生成方法在序列效率和结构保持方面的局限性，实现了更高质量的艺术家级网格生成，并提供了三角形和四边形网格的统一表示框架。

title: Beyond Isolated Clients: Integrating Graph-Based Embeddings into Event Sequence Models
comment: Short paper accepted at ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW '26)
summary: Large-scale digital platforms generate billions of timestamped user-item interactions (events) that are crucial for predicting user attributes in, e.g., fraud prevention and recommendations. While self-supervised learning (SSL) effectively models the temporal order of events, it typically overlooks the global structure of the user-item interaction graph. To bridge this gap, we propose three model-agnostic strategies for integrating this structural information into contrastive SSL: enriching event embeddings, aligning client representations with graph embeddings, and adding a structural pretext task. Experiments on four financial and e-commerce datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently improves the accuracy (up to a 2.3% AUC) and reveals that graph density is a key factor in selecting the optimal integration strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出三种模型无关策略，将用户-物品交互图的全局结构信息融入对比自监督学习，提升时序事件预测性能
AI.motivation: 大规模数字平台产生海量带时间戳的用户-物品交互事件，这些事件对用户属性预测（如欺诈预防和推荐）至关重要。传统自监督学习虽然能有效建模事件时序顺序，但通常忽略了用户-物品交互图的全局结构信息。
AI.method: 提出三种模型无关策略：1) 丰富事件嵌入，将图结构信息融入事件表示；2) 对齐客户端表示与图嵌入，使学习到的表示与图结构一致；3) 添加结构预训练任务，作为额外的自监督学习目标。
AI.result: 在四个金融和电商数据集上的实验表明，该方法能一致提升预测准确性（AUC最高提升2.3%），并揭示图密度是选择最优集成策略的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 通过将用户-物品交互图的全局结构信息融入对比自监督学习框架，可以显著提升时序事件预测性能，且图密度指导了最佳集成策略的选择。

title: Geometry Reinforced Efficient Attention Tuning Equipped with Normals for Robust Stereo Matching
summary: Despite remarkable advances in image-driven stereo matching over the past decade, Synthetic-to-Realistic Zero-Shot (Syn-to-Real) generalization remains an open challenge. This suboptimal generalization performance mainly stems from cross-domain shifts and ill-posed ambiguities inherent in image textures, particularly in occluded, textureless, repetitive, and non-Lambertian (specular/transparent) regions. To improve Syn-to-Real generalization, we propose GREATEN, a framework that incorporates surface normals as domain-invariant, object-intrinsic, and discriminative geometric cues to compensate for the limitations of image textures. The proposed framework consists of three key components. First, a Gated Contextual-Geometric Fusion (GCGF) module adaptively suppresses unreliable contextual cues in image features and fuses the filtered image features with normal-driven geometric features to construct domain-invariant and discriminative contextual-geometric representations. Second, a Specular-Transparent Augmentation (STA) strategy improves the robustness of GCGF against misleading visual cues in non-Lambertian regions. Third, sparse attention designs preserve the fine-grained global feature extraction capability of GREAT-Stereo for handling occlusion and texture-related ambiguities while substantially reducing computational overhead, including Sparse Spatial (SSA), Sparse Dual-Matching (SDMA), and Simple Volume (SVA) attentions. Trained exclusively on synthetic data such as SceneFlow, GREATEN-IGEV achieves outstanding Syn-to-Real performance. Specifically, it reduces errors by 30% on ETH3D, 8.5% on the non-Lambertian Booster, and 14.1% on KITTI-2015, compared to FoundationStereo, Monster-Stereo, and DEFOM-Stereo, respectively. In addition, GREATEN-IGEV runs 19.2% faster than GREAT-IGEV and supports high-resolution (3K) inference on Middlebury with disparity ranges up to 768.

AI.tldr: GREATEN框架通过引入表面法线作为域不变几何线索，结合门控上下文-几何融合、镜面-透明增强和稀疏注意力设计，显著提升了合成到真实场景的零样本立体匹配泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管图像驱动的立体匹配在过去十年取得了显著进展，但合成到真实场景的零样本泛化仍然是一个开放挑战。跨域偏移和图像纹理固有的不适定模糊性（特别是在遮挡、无纹理、重复和非朗伯表面区域）导致泛化性能不理想。
AI.method: 提出GREATEN框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 门控上下文-几何融合模块，自适应抑制图像特征中的不可靠上下文线索，并将过滤后的图像特征与法线驱动的几何特征融合；2) 镜面-透明增强策略，提高GCGF对非朗伯区域误导性视觉线索的鲁棒性；3) 稀疏注意力设计（稀疏空间注意力、稀疏双匹配注意力、简单体积注意力），在保持细粒度全局特征提取能力的同时大幅减少计算开销。
AI.result: 仅在合成数据（如SceneFlow）上训练，GREATEN-IGEV在合成到真实场景泛化中表现优异：在ETH3D上误差减少30%，在非朗伯Booster数据集上减少8.5%，在KITTI-2015上减少14.1%（相比FoundationStereo、Monster-Stereo和DEFOM-Stereo）。运行速度比GREAT-IGEV快19.2%，支持Middlebury的高分辨率（3K）推理，视差范围达768。
AI.conclusion: GREATEN通过引入表面法线作为域不变几何线索，有效解决了合成到真实场景立体匹配中的跨域泛化问题，在多个真实数据集上实现了显著的性能提升，同时保持了计算效率。

title: Deep Light Pollution Removal in Night Cityscape Photographs
summary: Nighttime photography is severely degraded by light pollution induced by pervasive artificial lighting in urban environments. After long-range scattering and spatial diffusion, unwanted artificial light overwhelms natural night luminance, generates skyglow that washes out the view of stars and celestial objects and produces halos and glow artifacts around light sources. Unlike nighttime dehazing, which aims to improve detail legibility through thick air, the objective of light pollution removal is to restore the pristine night appearance by neutralizing the radiative footprint of ground lighting. In this paper we introduce a physically-based degradation model that adds to the previous ones for nighttime dehazing two critical aspects; (i) anisotropic spread of directional light sources, and (ii) skyglow caused by invisible surface lights behind skylines. In addition, we construct a training strategy that leverages large generative model and synthetic-real coupling to compensate for the scarcity of paired real data and enhance generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed formulation and learning framework substantially reduce light pollution artifacts and better recover authentic night imagery than prior nighttime restoration methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于物理的退化模型和训练策略，用于去除夜间摄影中的光污染，恢复原始夜景外观。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中普遍的人工照明导致严重的光污染，包括天空辉光、光晕和辉光伪影，这些污染掩盖了自然夜景和天体观测。现有的夜间去雾方法主要关注细节可读性，而光污染去除的目标是恢复原始夜景外观，中和地面照明的辐射影响。
AI.method: 1. 提出了基于物理的退化模型，在先前夜间去雾模型基础上增加了两个关键方面：(i) 定向光源的各向异性扩散，(ii) 天际线后方不可见表面光源引起的天空辉光。2. 构建了训练策略，利用大型生成模型和合成-真实耦合来弥补配对真实数据的稀缺性并增强泛化能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的公式和学习框架显著减少了光污染伪影，比先前的夜间恢复方法更好地恢复了真实的夜间图像。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入更全面的物理退化模型和创新的训练策略，有效解决了夜间光污染去除问题，为恢复原始夜景外观提供了更优的解决方案。

title: GeoPAS: Geometric Probing for Algorithm Selection in Continuous Black-Box Optimisation
comment: Companion to a paper to appear at GECCO 2026
summary: Automated algorithm selection in continuous black-box optimisation typically relies on fixed landscape descriptors computed under a limited probing budget, yet such descriptors can degrade under problem-split or cross-benchmark evaluation. We propose GeoPAS, a geometric probing approach that represents a problem instance by multiple coarse two-dimensional slices sampled across locations, orientations, and logarithmic scales. A shared validity-aware convolutional encoder maps each slice to an embedding, conditions it on slice-scale and amplitude statistics, and aggregates the resulting features permutation-invariantly for risk-aware solver selection via log-scale performance prediction with an explicit penalty on tail failures. On COCO/BBOB with a 12-solver portfolio in dimensions 2--10, GeoPAS improves over the single best solver under leave-instance-out, grouped random, and leave-problem-out evaluation. These results suggest that multi-scale geometric slices provide a useful transferable static signal for algorithm selection, although a small number of heavy-tail regimes remain and continue to dominate the mean. Our code is available at $\href{https://github.com/BradWangW/GeoPAS}{GitHub}$.

AI.tldr: GeoPAS是一种基于几何探测的算法选择方法，通过多尺度二维切片表示问题实例，使用卷积编码器提取特征，进行风险感知的求解器选择。
AI.motivation: 传统连续黑盒优化中的自动算法选择通常依赖于有限的探测预算下计算的固定景观描述符，但这些描述符在问题分割或跨基准评估时性能会下降。
AI.method: 提出GeoPAS方法：1）通过在不同位置、方向和对数尺度上采样多个粗糙的二维切片来表示问题实例；2）使用共享的有效性感知卷积编码器将每个切片映射到嵌入；3）基于切片尺度和振幅统计条件化嵌入；4）通过置换不变方式聚合特征；5）使用对数尺度性能预测进行风险感知求解器选择，并对尾部失败施加显式惩罚。
AI.result: 在COCO/BBOB基准测试中，使用2-10维的12个求解器组合，GeoPAS在留实例出、分组随机和留问题出评估中均优于单一最佳求解器。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度几何切片为算法选择提供了有用的可转移静态信号，尽管少量重尾机制仍然存在并继续主导均值性能。

title: Benchmarking CNN- and Transformer-Based Models for Surgical Instrument Segmentation in Robotic-Assisted Surgery
summary:
Accurate segmentation of surgical instruments in robotic-assisted surgery is critical for enabling context-aware computer-assisted interventions, such as tool tracking, workflow analysis, and autonomous decision-making. In this study, we benchmark five deep learning architectures-UNet, UNet, DeepLabV3, Attention UNet, and SegFormer on the SAR-RARP50 dataset for multi-class semantic segmentation of surgical instruments in real-world radical prostatectomy videos. The models are trained with a compound loss function combining Cross Entropy and Dice loss to address class imbalance and capture fine object boundaries. Our experiments reveal that while convolutional models such as UNet and Attention UNet provide strong baseline performance, DeepLabV3 achieves results comparable to SegFormer, demonstrating the effectiveness of atrous convolution and multi-scale context aggregation in capturing complex surgical scenes. Transformer-based architectures like SegFormer further enhance global contextual understanding, leading to improved generalization across varying instrument appearances and surgical conditions.
  This work provides a comprehensive comparison and practical insights for selecting segmentation models in surgical AI applications, highlighting the trade-offs between convolutional and transformer-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究在SAR-RARP50数据集上对UNet、DeepLabV3、Attention UNet和SegFormer五种深度学习架构进行基准测试，用于机器人辅助手术中手术器械的多类别语义分割，比较了卷积和基于Transformer的方法在复杂手术场景中的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助手术中手术器械的精确分割对于实现上下文感知的计算机辅助干预至关重要，如工具跟踪、工作流程分析和自主决策。然而，现有研究缺乏对不同深度学习架构在真实手术视频中性能的系统比较。
AI.method: 在SAR-RARP50数据集上对五种深度学习架构（UNet、UNet变体、DeepLabV3、Attention UNet和SegFormer）进行基准测试，使用结合交叉熵和Dice损失的复合损失函数来处理类别不平衡并捕捉精细对象边界。
AI.result: 实验表明，卷积模型如UNet和Attention UNet提供强大的基线性能，DeepLabV3与SegFormer结果相当，展示了空洞卷积和多尺度上下文聚合在捕捉复杂手术场景中的有效性。基于Transformer的架构如SegFormer进一步增强了全局上下文理解，提高了对不同器械外观和手术条件的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为手术AI应用中选择分割模型提供了全面比较和实用见解，突出了卷积和基于Transformer方法之间的权衡，强调了多尺度上下文聚合和全局理解在复杂手术场景分割中的重要性。

title: Score-Driven Rating System for Sports
summary: This paper introduces a score-driven rating system, a generalization of the classical Elo rating system that employs the score, i.e. the gradient of the log-likelihood, as the updating mechanism for player and team ratings. The proposed framework extends beyond simple win/loss game outcomes and accommodates a wide range of game results, such as point differences, win/draw/loss outcomes, or complete rankings. Theoretical properties of the score are derived, showing that it has zero expected value, sums to zero across all players, and decreases with increasing value of a player's rating, thereby ensuring internal consistency and fairness. Furthermore, the score-driven rating system exhibits a reversion property, meaning that ratings tend to follow the underlying unobserved true skills over time. The proposed framework provides a theoretical rationale for existing dynamic models of sports performance and offers a systematic approach for constructing new ones.

AI.tldr: 提出基于分数的评分系统，作为经典Elo系统的推广，使用对数似然梯度作为更新机制，可处理多种比赛结果类型
AI.motivation: 传统Elo评分系统仅处理胜负结果，需要更通用的框架来处理点差、平局、完整排名等多种比赛结果类型，并为现有动态体育表现模型提供理论依据
AI.method: 提出基于分数的评分系统，使用对数似然函数的梯度作为评分更新机制，该框架扩展了Elo系统，可适应点差、胜/平/负、完整排名等多种结果类型
AI.result: 推导了分数的理论性质：期望值为零、所有玩家分数之和为零、随玩家评分增加而减小，确保内部一致性和公平性；系统具有回归特性，评分随时间趋向于潜在真实技能水平
AI.conclusion: 基于分数的评分系统为现有动态体育表现模型提供了理论依据，并为构建新模型提供了系统化方法，是经典Elo系统的有效推广

title: MAG-3D: Multi-Agent Grounded Reasoning for 3D Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet grounded reasoning in 3D scenes remains underexplored. Effective 3D reasoning hinges on accurate grounding: to answer open-ended queries, a model must first identify query-relevant objects and regions in a complex scene, and then reason about their spatial and geometric relationships. Recent approaches have demonstrated strong potential for grounded 3D reasoning. However, they often rely on in-domain tuning or hand-crafted reasoning pipelines, which limit their flexibility and zero-shot generalization to novel environments. In this work, we present MAG-3D, a training-free multi-agent framework for grounded 3D reasoning with off-the-shelf VLMs. Instead of relying on task-specific training or fixed reasoning procedures, MAG-3D dynamically coordinates expert agents to address the key challenges of 3D reasoning. Specifically, we propose a planning agent that decomposes the task and orchestrates the overall reasoning process, a grounding agent that performs free-form 3D grounding and relevant frame retrieval from extensive 3D scene observations, and a coding agent that conducts flexible geometric reasoning and explicit verification through executable programs. This multi-agent collaborative design enables flexible training-free 3D grounded reasoning across diverse scenes and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MAG-3D：一个无需训练的多智能体框架，用于3D场景的基于视觉语言模型的推理，通过规划、定位和编码智能体的协作实现零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在3D场景的推理能力不足，现有方法依赖领域内调优或手工设计的推理流程，限制了灵活性和零样本泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的MAG-3D多智能体框架：规划智能体分解任务并协调推理过程；定位智能体执行自由形式的3D定位和场景帧检索；编码智能体通过可执行程序进行几何推理和显式验证。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，能够灵活处理不同场景的3D推理任务。
AI.conclusion: MAG-3D通过多智能体协作设计，无需训练即可实现灵活的3D场景推理，为开放域3D理解提供了有效的解决方案。

title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation
summary: We introduce Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT), a highly parameter-efficient class of visual generative models based on a recurrent transformer architecture. While conventional generative models rely on deep stacks of unique transformer layers, our approach employs iterative, weight-shared transformer blocks to drastically reduce parameter counts while maintaining high synthesis quality. To effectively train these models for image and video generation, we propose the idea of Intra-Loop Self Distillation (ILSD), where student configurations (intermediate loops) are distilled from the teacher configuration (maximum training loops) to ensure consistency across the model's depth in a single training step. Our framework yields a family of elastic models from a single training run, enabling Any-Time inference capability with dynamic trade-offs between computational cost and generation quality, with the same parameter count. ELT significantly shifts the efficiency frontier for visual synthesis. With $4\times$ reduction in parameter count under iso-inference-compute settings, ELT achieves a competitive FID of $2.0$ on class-conditional ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and FVD of $72.8$ on class-conditional UCF-101.

AI.tldr: ELT是一种基于循环Transformer架构的高效视觉生成模型，通过权重共享的循环块大幅减少参数，同时保持高质量合成能力，支持任意时间推理。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型依赖深度堆叠的独特Transformer层，导致参数数量庞大。需要开发参数效率更高的视觉生成模型，在减少参数的同时保持合成质量。
AI.method: 提出弹性循环Transformer（ELT），采用权重共享的循环Transformer块减少参数。引入循环内自蒸馏（ILSD）训练方法，将学生配置（中间循环）从教师配置（最大训练循环）蒸馏，确保深度一致性。支持从单次训练中获得弹性模型家族。
AI.result: 在相同推理计算下，ELT将参数减少4倍，在ImageNet 256×256上获得2.0的FID，在UCF-101上获得72.8的FVD。实现了计算成本与生成质量之间的动态权衡。
AI.conclusion: ELT显著提升了视觉合成的效率边界，通过循环架构和ILSD训练实现了参数高效的高质量生成，支持任意时间推理能力。

title: Truncated Rectified Flow Policy for Reinforcement Learning with One-Step Sampling
summary: Maximum entropy reinforcement learning (MaxEnt RL) has become a standard framework for sequential decision making, yet its standard Gaussian policy parameterization is inherently unimodal, limiting its ability to model complex multimodal action distributions. This limitation has motivated increasing interest in generative policies based on diffusion and flow matching as more expressive alternatives. However, incorporating such policies into MaxEnt RL is challenging for two main reasons: the likelihood and entropy of continuous-time generative policies are generally intractable, and multi-step sampling introduces both long-horizon backpropagation instability and substantial inference latency. To address these challenges, we propose Truncated Rectified Flow Policy (TRFP), a framework built on a hybrid deterministic-stochastic architecture. This design makes entropy-regularized optimization tractable while supporting stable training and effective one-step sampling through gradient truncation and flow straightening. Empirical results on a toy multigoal environment and 10 MuJoCo benchmarks show that TRFP captures multimodal behavior effectively, outperforms strong baselines on most benchmarks under standard sampling, and remains highly competitive under one-step sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出TRFP框架解决MaxEnt RL中生成策略的似然和熵难计算、多步采样不稳定和延迟高的问题，通过混合确定性-随机架构实现可处理的熵正则化优化和高效一步采样。
AI.motivation: 标准MaxEnt RL的高斯策略参数化本质上是单峰的，无法建模复杂多峰动作分布。虽然扩散和流匹配生成策略更具表达力，但将其整合到MaxEnt RL面临两大挑战：连续时间生成策略的似然和熵通常难以计算，多步采样存在长时域反向传播不稳定性和显著推理延迟。
AI.method: 提出截断整流流策略（TRFP），基于混合确定性-随机架构设计。通过梯度截断和流拉直技术，使熵正则化优化变得可处理，同时支持稳定训练和有效的一步采样。
AI.result: 在玩具多目标环境和10个MuJoCo基准测试上的实验结果表明，TRFP能有效捕捉多峰行为，在标准采样下在大多数基准上优于强基线，在一部采样下仍保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TRFP框架成功解决了将生成策略整合到MaxEnt RL中的关键挑战，实现了可处理的优化、稳定训练和高效推理，为复杂多峰决策问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: UniSemAlign: Text-Prototype Alignment with a Foundation Encoder for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Workshop. 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation in computational pathology remains challenging due to scarce pixel-level annotations and unreliable pseudo-label supervision. We propose UniSemAlign, a dual-modal semantic alignment framework that enhances visual segmentation by injecting explicit class-level structure into pixel-wise learning. Built upon a pathology-pretrained Transformer encoder, UniSemAlign introduces complementary prototype-level and text-level alignment branches in a shared embedding space, providing structured guidance that reduces class ambiguity and stabilizes pseudo-label refinement. The aligned representations are fused with visual predictions to generate more reliable supervision for unlabeled histopathology images. The framework is trained end-to-end with supervised segmentation, cross-view consistency, and cross-modal alignment objectives. Extensive experiments on the GlaS and CRAG datasets demonstrate that UniSemAlign substantially outperforms recent semi-supervised baselines under limited supervision, achieving Dice improvements of up to 2.6% on GlaS and 8.6% on CRAG with only 10% labeled data, and strong improvements at 20% supervision. Code is available at: https://github.com/thailevann/UniSemAlign

AI.tldr: UniSemAlign：一种用于计算病理学的双模态语义对齐框架，通过将显式类别级结构注入像素级学习来增强视觉分割，显著提升半监督语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学中的半监督语义分割面临像素级标注稀缺和伪标签监督不可靠的挑战，需要更有效的监督信号来减少类别模糊性并稳定伪标签优化。
AI.method: 基于病理学预训练的Transformer编码器，引入互补的原型级和文本级对齐分支，在共享嵌入空间中进行双模态语义对齐，将对齐表示与视觉预测融合生成更可靠的监督信号，通过端到端训练结合监督分割、跨视图一致性和跨模态对齐目标。
AI.result: 在GlaS和CRAG数据集上的实验表明，UniSemAlign显著优于现有半监督基线方法，在仅10%标注数据下，GlaS数据集Dice系数提升2.6%，CRAG数据集提升8.6%，在20%监督下也表现出强劲改进。
AI.conclusion: UniSemAlign通过双模态语义对齐有效缓解了计算病理学中半监督分割的挑战，为像素级学习提供了结构化指导，减少了类别模糊性并稳定了伪标签优化，在有限监督下实现了显著性能提升。

title: Visually-Guided Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, the inherent text-dominated nature of VLMs often leads to insufficient visual faithfulness, characterized by sparse attention activation to visual tokens. More importantly, our empirical analysis reveals that temporal visual forgetting along reasoning steps exacerbates this deficiency. To bridge this gap, we propose Visually-Guided Policy Optimization (VGPO), a novel framework to reinforce visual focus during policy optimization. Specifically, VGPO initially introduces a Visual Attention Compensation mechanism that leverages visual similarity to localize and amplify visual cues, while progressively elevating visual expectations in later steps to counteract visual forgetting. Building on this mechanism, we implement a dual-grained advantage re-weighting strategy: the intra-trajectory level highlights tokens exhibiting relatively high visual activation, while the inter-trajectory level prioritizes trajectories demonstrating superior visual accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VGPO achieves better visual activation and superior performance in mathematical multimodal reasoning and visual-dependent tasks.

AI.tldr: VGPO通过视觉注意力补偿机制和双重粒度优势重加权策略，增强视觉语言模型在推理过程中的视觉忠实度，解决视觉遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习虽然提升了视觉语言模型的推理能力，但由于文本主导特性导致视觉忠实度不足，表现为视觉令牌激活稀疏，且存在沿推理步骤的时间性视觉遗忘问题。
AI.method: 提出视觉引导策略优化框架，包含视觉注意力补偿机制（利用视觉相似性定位和放大视觉线索，并在后续步骤逐步提升视觉期望以对抗视觉遗忘），以及双重粒度优势重加权策略（轨迹内级别突出视觉激活相对较高的令牌，轨迹间级别优先考虑视觉积累更优的轨迹）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明VGPO在数学多模态推理和视觉依赖任务中实现了更好的视觉激活和更优的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VGPO通过强化视觉焦点优化策略，有效解决了视觉语言模型中的视觉忠实度不足和视觉遗忘问题，在多模态推理任务中展现出显著优势。

title: Automated Batch Distillation Process Simulation for a Large Hybrid Dataset for Deep Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection (AD) in chemical processes based on deep learning offers significant opportunities but requires large, diverse, and well-annotated training datasets that are rarely available from industrial operations. In a recent work, we introduced a large, fully annotated experimental dataset for batch distillation under normal and anomalous operating conditions. In the present study, we augment this dataset with a corresponding simulation dataset, creating a novel hybrid dataset. The simulation data is generated in an automated workflow with a novel Python-based process simulator that employs a tailored index-reduction strategy for the underlying differential-algebraic equations. Leveraging the rich metadata and structured anomaly annotations of the experimental database, experimental records are automatically translated into simulation scenarios. After calibration to a single reference experiment, the dynamics of the other experiments are well predicted. This enabled the fully automated, consistent generation of time-series data for a large number of experimental runs, covering both normal operation and a wide range of actuator- and control-related anomalies. The resulting hybrid dataset is released openly. From a process simulation perspective, this work demonstrates the automated, consistent simulation of large-scale experimental campaigns, using batch distillation as an example. From a data-driven AD perspective, the hybrid dataset provides a unique basis for simulation-to-experiment style transfer, the generation of pseudo-experimental data, and future research on deep AD methods in chemical process monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建了一个用于化工过程异常检测的混合数据集，结合实验数据和自动化生成的模拟数据，以解决工业数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 化工过程异常检测需要大量、多样且标注良好的训练数据集，但工业操作中很少能获得这样的数据。虽然之前已有一个批蒸馏实验数据集，但需要更多数据来支持深度学习方法的开发。
AI.method: 1. 开发基于Python的过程模拟器，采用定制的索引缩减策略处理微分代数方程；2. 利用实验数据库的元数据和异常标注，自动将实验记录转换为模拟场景；3. 通过单一参考实验校准后，预测其他实验的动态特性；4. 自动化生成大量实验运行的时间序列数据，涵盖正常操作和各种执行器与控制相关异常。
AI.result: 1. 成功创建并公开发布了混合数据集；2. 模拟器经过校准后能准确预测其他实验的动态特性；3. 实现了大规模实验活动的自动化、一致性模拟；4. 为模拟到实验的风格迁移、伪实验数据生成以及深度异常检测方法研究提供了独特基础。
AI.conclusion: 从过程模拟角度看，本研究展示了大规模实验活动的自动化一致性模拟（以批蒸馏为例）。从数据驱动的异常检测角度看，混合数据集为模拟到实验的风格迁移、伪实验数据生成以及化工过程监测中深度异常检测方法的未来研究提供了独特基础。

title: MixFlow: Mixed Source Distributions Improve Rectified Flows
summary: Diffusion models and their variations, such as rectified flows, generate diverse and high-quality images, but they are still hindered by slow iterative sampling caused by the highly curved generative paths they learn. An important cause of high curvature, as shown by previous work, is independence between the source distribution (standard Gaussian) and the data distribution. In this work, we tackle this limitation by two complementary contributions. First, we attempt to break away from the standard Gaussian assumption by introducing $κ\texttt{-FC}$, a general formulation that conditions the source distribution on an arbitrary signal $κ$ that aligns it better with the data distribution. Then, we present MixFlow, a simple but effective training strategy that reduces the generative path curvatures and considerably improves sampling efficiency. MixFlow trains a flow model on linear mixtures of a fixed unconditional distribution and a $κ\texttt{-FC}$-based distribution. This simple mixture improves the alignment between the source and data, provides better generation quality with less required sampling steps, and accelerates the training convergence considerably. On average, our training procedure improves the generation quality by 12\% in FID compared to standard rectified flow and 7\% compared to previous baselines under a fixed sampling budget. Code available at: $\href{https://github.com/NazirNayal8/MixFlow}{https://github.com/NazirNayal8/MixFlow}$

AI.tldr: MixFlow：通过κ-FC条件化源分布和混合流训练策略，减少生成路径曲率，显著提升扩散模型采样效率
AI.motivation: 扩散模型及其变体（如整流流）存在采样速度慢的问题，主要原因是源分布（标准高斯）与数据分布之间的独立性导致生成路径曲率过高。现有方法受限于标准高斯假设，需要改进源分布与数据分布的对齐。
AI.method: 提出两个互补贡献：1) κ-FC：打破标准高斯假设，通过任意信号κ条件化源分布，使其更好地与数据分布对齐；2) MixFlow：在固定无条件分布和κ-FC条件分布的线性混合上训练流模型，减少生成路径曲率。
AI.result: 在固定采样预算下，MixFlow相比标准整流流提升12%的FID生成质量，相比先前基线提升7%。同时显著加速训练收敛，减少所需采样步数。
AI.conclusion: MixFlow通过改进源分布与数据分布的对齐，有效减少生成路径曲率，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升采样效率，为扩散模型的实际应用提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: Arbitration Failure, Not Perceptual Blindness: How Vision-Language Models Resolve Visual-Linguistic Conflicts
summary: When a Vision-Language Model (VLM) sees a blue banana and answers "yellow", is the problem of perception or arbitration? We explore the question in ten VLMs with various sizes and reveal an Encoding--Grounding Dissociation: models that fail to report what they see (and thus provide a wrong answer) still encode the visual evidence as strongly as models that provide the correct answer. Using Multimodal Arbitration Crossover (MAC) analysis with layer-by-layer Logit Lens probing, we track the competition between visual and prior signals across every layer of each model. We show that visual attributes can be linearly decodable from early layers (AUC > 0.86). The accuracy remains nearly identical for both successful and failed samples. However, the gap in the final-layer logit -- not the strength of encoding -- better predicts grounding outcomes with a correlation of . After having studied when VLMs base their answers on image clues rather than prior knowledge, we want to understand the causal relationships. We establish causality through full-sequence activation patching. The standard last-token interventions in LLM interpretability do not affect VLMs. In contrast, replacing the full token sequence at layers identified by MAC alters 60 to 84% of outputs. Partial-token decomposition shows that image tokens carry almost all of the causal impact, while text tokens have none. Scaling addresses the remaining architectural differences to achieve perfect retention. Moving from diagnosis to intervention, we show that training-free activation steering -- both linear and sparse autoencoder-guided -- in early layers can improve visual grounding by up to +3.8% with degrading performance in some setups. Overall, these findings lead to a clear conclusion: VLMs already see well, but the challenge is acting on what they see. Targeted interventions can help to bridge this gap.

AI.tldr: VLM视觉感知能力良好但决策机制存在问题，通过激活修补和层间分析发现视觉证据编码充分但最终决策偏向先验知识，早期层干预可改善视觉接地效果。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型(VLM)回答错误时是感知问题还是决策问题，分析模型何时基于图像线索而非先验知识做出回答，并建立因果关系理解。
AI.method: 使用多模态仲裁交叉分析(MAC)和逐层Logit Lens探测，跟踪视觉与先验信号竞争；通过全序列激活修补建立因果关系；采用线性解码和稀疏自编码器引导的无训练激活导向进行干预。
AI.result: 视觉属性在早期层即可线性解码(AUC>0.86)，成功与失败样本的编码强度几乎相同；全序列激活修补可改变60-84%的输出，图像token承载几乎所有因果影响；早期层激活导向可提升视觉接地效果达+3.8%。
AI.conclusion: VLM视觉感知能力良好，主要挑战在于基于所见内容进行决策；编码-接地分离现象表明问题在于仲裁机制而非感知能力；针对性干预可帮助弥合这一差距。

title: Vision Transformers for Preoperative CT-Based Prediction of Histopathologic Chemotherapy Response Score in High-Grade Serous Ovarian Carcinoma
summary: Purpose. High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC) is characterized by pronounced biological and spatial heterogeneity and is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) followed by delayed primary surgery is commonly employed in patients unsuitable for primary cytoreduction. The Chemotherapy Response Score (CRS) is a validated histopathological biomarker of response to NACT, but it is only available postoperatively. In this study, we investigate whether pre-treatment computed tomography (CT) imaging and clinical data can be used to predict CRS as an investigational decision-support adjunct to inform multidisciplinary team (MDT) discussions regarding expected treatment response. Methods. We proposed a 2.5D multimodal deep learning framework that processes lesion-dense omental slices using a pre-trained Vision Transformer encoder and integrates the resulting visual representations with clinical variables through an intermediate fusion module to predict CRS. Results. Our multimodal model, integrating imaging and clinical data, achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.95 alongside 95% accuracy and 80% precision on the internal test cohort (IEO, n=41 patients). On the external test set (OV04, n=70 patients), it achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.68, alongside 67% accuracy and 75% precision. Conclusion. These preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of transformer-based deep learning for preoperative prediction of CRS in HGSOC using routine clinical data and CT imaging. As an investigational, pre-treatment decision-support tool, this approach may assist MDT discussions by providing early, non-invasive estimates of treatment response.

AI.tldr: 开发基于多模态深度学习的术前预测模型，利用CT影像和临床数据预测高级别浆液性卵巢癌患者对新辅助化疗的组织病理学反应评分（CRS）
AI.motivation: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSOC）具有显著的生物学和空间异质性，常被诊断为晚期。新辅助化疗（NACT）后延迟初次手术常用于不适合初次细胞减灭术的患者。化疗反应评分（CRS）是验证的NACT反应组织病理学生物标志物，但仅在术后可用。本研究旨在探索是否可以利用治疗前CT影像和临床数据预测CRS，作为多学科团队讨论治疗预期反应的决策支持工具。
AI.method: 提出2.5D多模态深度学习框架，使用预训练的Vision Transformer编码器处理病灶密集的网膜切片，并通过中间融合模块将视觉表征与临床变量整合，以预测CRS。
AI.result: 多模态模型在内部测试队列（IEO，n=41）中达到ROC-AUC 0.95、准确率95%、精确率80%；在外部测试集（OV04，n=70）中达到ROC-AUC 0.68、准确率67%、精确率75%。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，基于Transformer的深度学习利用常规临床数据和CT影像术前预测HGSOC的CRS是可行的。作为研究性治疗前决策支持工具，该方法可通过提供早期、非侵入性的治疗反应估计来辅助多学科团队讨论。

title: Is More Data Worth the Cost? Dataset Scaling Laws in a Tiny Attention-Only Decoder
comment: Presented as a paper at 3rd DATA-FM workshop @ ICLR 2026, Brazil. Published at 13th IEEE Swiss Conference on Data Science and AI (SDS 2026)
summary: Training Transformer language models is expensive, as performance typically improves with increasing dataset size and computational budget. Although scaling laws describe this trend at large scale, their implications in controlled, smaller-scale settings remain less explored. In this work, we isolate dataset-size effects using a strongly reduced attention-only decoder architecture. By training on progressively larger power-of-two subsets, we observe smooth performance improvements accompanied by clear diminishing returns, consistent with scaling-law behavior. Using only about 30% of the training data is sufficient to reach approximately 90% of the full-data validation token-level accuracy. These results provide actionable insights into dataset scaling in a controlled, component-isolated setting and offer practical guidance for balancing dataset size and computational cost in compute- and data-restricted environments, such as small research labs and exploratory model development.

AI.tldr: 在小规模控制实验中，通过逐步增加数据集规模训练简化Transformer模型，发现性能随数据量增加而平滑提升但存在边际递减效应，仅需约30%数据即可达到全数据90%的验证准确率。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型训练成本高昂，性能通常随数据集规模和计算预算增加而提升。虽然缩放定律在大规模场景下描述了这一趋势，但在受控的小规模环境中其影响尚未充分探索。本研究旨在在计算和数据受限环境下（如小型研究实验室和探索性模型开发），提供数据集规模效应的可操作见解。
AI.method: 使用高度简化的仅注意力解码器架构，隔离数据集规模效应。通过训练逐步增大的2的幂次方数据子集，观察性能变化。在受控的组件隔离设置中分析数据集缩放行为。
AI.result: 观察到平滑的性能提升伴随明显的边际递减效应，与缩放定律行为一致。仅使用约30%的训练数据即可达到全数据验证token级准确率的约90%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为受控、组件隔离设置中的数据集缩放提供了可操作的见解，并为计算和数据受限环境（如小型研究实验室和探索性模型开发）中平衡数据集规模和计算成本提供了实用指导。

title: Globally Optimal Pose from Orthographic Silhouettes
summary:
We solve the problem of determining the pose of known shapes in $\mathbb{R}^3$ from their unoccluded silhouettes. The pose is determined up to global optimality using a simple yet under-explored property of the area-of-silhouette: its continuity w.r.t trajectories in the rotation space. The proposed method utilises pre-computed silhouette-signatures, modelled as a response surface of the area-of-silhouettes. Querying this silhouette-signature response surface for pose estimation leads to a strong branching of the rotation search space, making resolution-guided candidate search feasible. Additionally, we utilise the aspect ratio of 2D ellipses fitted to projected silhouettes as an auxiliary global shape signature to accelerate the pose search. This combined strategy forms the first method to efficiently estimate globally optimal pose from just the silhouettes, without being guided by correspondences, for any shape, irrespective of its convexity and genus. We validate our method on synthetic and real examples, demonstrating significantly improved accuracy against comparable approaches.
  Code, data, and supplementary in: https://agnivsen.github.io/pose-from-silhouette/

AI.tldr: 提出首个仅从轮廓高效估计全局最优姿态的方法，利用轮廓面积连续性特性，通过预计算轮廓签名响应曲面和椭圆纵横比辅助形状签名加速姿态搜索
AI.motivation: 解决从已知三维形状的无遮挡轮廓确定姿态的问题，传统方法通常依赖对应关系或受限于特定形状类型，需要一种能处理任意形状（无论凸性或亏格）的全局最优姿态估计方法
AI.method: 利用轮廓面积在旋转空间中的连续性特性，预计算轮廓签名作为轮廓面积的响应曲面；使用二维椭圆拟合轮廓的纵横比作为辅助全局形状签名；通过查询轮廓签名响应曲面进行姿态估计，实现旋转搜索空间的有效分支，使分辨率引导的候选搜索可行
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了方法，相比可比方法显著提高了精度；能够处理任意形状，不受凸性和亏格限制；首次实现仅从轮廓高效估计全局最优姿态
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于轮廓面积连续性的新方法，通过预计算轮廓签名响应曲面和辅助形状签名，实现了从轮廓高效估计全局最优姿态，为任意形状的姿态估计提供了有效解决方案

title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning
summary: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal reasoning but frequently exhibit hallucinations and incorrect responses with high certainty, which hinders their usage in high-stakes domains. Existing verbalized confidence calibration methods, largely developed for text-only LLMs, typically optimize a single holistic confidence score using binary answer-level correctness. This design is mismatched to LVLMs: an incorrect prediction may arise from perceptual failures or from reasoning errors given correct perception, and a single confidence conflates these sources while visual uncertainty is often dominated by language priors. To address these issues, we propose VL-Calibration, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly decouples confidence into visual and reasoning confidence. To supervise visual confidence without ground-truth perception labels, we introduce an intrinsic visual certainty estimation that combines (i) visual grounding measured by KL-divergence under image perturbations and (ii) internal certainty measured by token entropy. We further propose token-level advantage reweighting to focus optimization on tokens based on visual certainty, suppressing ungrounded hallucinations while preserving valid perception. Experiments on thirteen benchmarks show that VL-Calibration effectively improves calibration while boosting visual reasoning accuracy, and it generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks across model scales and architectures.

AI.tldr: VL-Calibration：一种用于大型视觉语言模型的强化学习框架，将置信度解耦为视觉置信度和推理置信度，通过视觉不确定性估计和token级优势重加权来减少幻觉并提高校准效果
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本LLM的置信度校准方法不适用于LVLM，因为错误预测可能源于感知失败或正确感知下的推理错误，单一置信度分数会混淆这些来源，且视觉不确定性常被语言先验主导
AI.method: 提出VL-Calibration强化学习框架：1) 将置信度解耦为视觉置信度和推理置信度；2) 引入内在视觉确定性估计，结合图像扰动下的KL散度视觉基础和token熵的内部确定性；3) 提出token级优势重加权，基于视觉确定性聚焦优化
AI.result: 在13个基准测试上，VL-Calibration有效改善了校准效果，同时提升了视觉推理准确性，并且能够泛化到分布外基准测试，适用于不同模型规模和架构
AI.conclusion: VL-Calibration通过解耦视觉和推理置信度、引入视觉不确定性估计和token级优化，有效解决了LVLM中的幻觉问题，提高了模型的可靠性和校准性能

title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation
summary: Camera-controllable video generation aims to synthesize videos with flexible and physically plausible camera movements. However, existing methods either provide imprecise camera control from text prompts or rely on labor-intensive manual camera trajectory parameters, limiting their use in automated scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a novel Vision-Language-Camera model, termed CT-1 (Camera Transformer 1), a specialized model designed to transfer spatial reasoning knowledge to video generation by accurately estimating camera trajectories. Built upon vision-language modules and a Diffusion Transformer model, CT-1 employs a Wavelet-based Regularization Loss in the frequency domain to effectively learn complex camera trajectory distributions. These trajectories are integrated into a video diffusion model to enable spatially aware camera control that aligns with user intentions. To facilitate the training of CT-1, we design a dedicated data curation pipeline and construct CT-200K, a large-scale dataset containing over 47M frames. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework successfully bridges the gap between spatial reasoning and video synthesis, yielding faithful and high-quality camera-controllable videos and improving camera control accuracy by 25.7% over prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-1模型，通过视觉-语言-相机架构将空间推理知识迁移到视频生成，实现精确的相机轨迹控制，相比现有方法提升25.7%的控制精度。
AI.motivation: 现有相机可控视频生成方法存在两个问题：1）基于文本提示的相机控制不精确；2）依赖人工手动设置相机轨迹参数，难以自动化应用。需要一种能够准确估计相机轨迹并实现精确控制的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出CT-1（Camera Transformer 1）模型，基于视觉-语言模块和Diffusion Transformer架构，采用小波域正则化损失学习复杂相机轨迹分布，并将轨迹集成到视频扩散模型中实现空间感知的相机控制。构建了包含4700万帧的大规模数据集CT-200K用于训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CT-1成功弥合了空间推理与视频合成之间的差距，能够生成忠实且高质量的相机可控视频，相机控制精度相比现有方法提升25.7%。
AI.conclusion: CT-1通过专门的视觉-语言-相机架构，实现了精确的相机轨迹估计和控制，为自动化相机可控视频生成提供了有效解决方案，显著提升了控制精度和生成质量。

title: VisionFoundry: Teaching VLMs Visual Perception with Synthetic Images
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with visual perception tasks such as spatial understanding and viewpoint recognition. One plausible contributing factor is that natural image datasets provide limited supervision for low-level visual skills. This motivates a practical question: can targeted synthetic supervision, generated from only a task keyword such as Depth Order, address these weaknesses? To investigate this question, we introduce VisionFoundry, a task-aware synthetic data generation pipeline that takes only the task name as input and uses large language models (LLMs) to generate questions, answers, and text-to-image (T2I) prompts, then synthesizes images with T2I models and verifies consistency with a proprietary VLM, requiring no reference images or human annotation. Using VisionFoundry, we construct VisionFoundry-10K, a synthetic visual question answering (VQA) dataset containing 10k image-question-answer triples spanning 10 tasks. Models trained on VisionFoundry-10K achieve substantial improvements on visual perception benchmarks: +7% on MMVP and +10% on CV-Bench-3D, while preserving broader capabilities and showing favorable scaling behavior as data size increases. Our results suggest that limited task-targeted supervision is an important contributor to this bottleneck and that synthetic supervision is a promising path toward more systematic training for VLMs.

AI.tldr: VisionFoundry：仅需任务关键词即可生成合成监督数据的自动化流程，显著提升视觉语言模型在空间理解和视角识别等感知任务上的性能
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在空间理解和视角识别等视觉感知任务上表现不佳，可能源于自然图像数据集对低层视觉技能提供的监督有限。研究旨在探索是否可以通过针对性的合成监督来弥补这一缺陷
AI.method: 提出VisionFoundry任务感知合成数据生成流程：仅输入任务名称，利用大语言模型生成问题、答案和文本到图像提示，通过T2I模型合成图像，并使用专有VLM验证一致性，无需参考图像或人工标注。构建了包含10个任务、10k图像-问题-答案三元组的VisionFoundry-10K数据集
AI.result: 在VisionFoundry-10K上训练的模型在视觉感知基准测试中取得显著提升：MMVP上+7%，CV-Bench-3D上+10%，同时保持更广泛的能力，并显示出随着数据规模增加而改善的有利扩展行为
AI.conclusion: 有限的针对任务的监督是视觉语言模型瓶颈的重要原因，合成监督是朝着更系统化训练视觉语言模型的有前景的路径

title: Long-SCOPE: Fully Sparse Long-Range Cooperative 3D Perception
summary: Cooperative 3D perception via Vehicle-to-Everything communication is a promising paradigm for enhancing autonomous driving, offering extended sensing horizons and occlusion resolution. However, the practical deployment of existing methods is hindered at long distances by two critical bottlenecks: the quadratic computational scaling of dense BEV representations and the fragility of feature association mechanisms under significant observation and alignment errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Long-SCOPE, a fully sparse framework designed for robust long-distance cooperative 3D perception. Our method features two novel components: a Geometry-guided Query Generation module to accurately detect small, distant objects, and a learnable Context-Aware Association module that robustly matches cooperative queries despite severe positional noise. Experiments on the V2X-Seq and Griffin datasets validate that Long-SCOPE achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly in challenging 100-150 m long-range settings, while maintaining highly competitive computation and communication costs.

AI.tldr: Long-SCOPE：用于长距离协同3D感知的全稀疏框架，解决密集BEV表示二次计算复杂度和特征关联机制脆弱性问题
AI.motivation: 现有基于车路协同的3D感知方法在实际部署中面临两个关键瓶颈：1）密集BEV表示的二次计算复杂度随距离增加而急剧增长；2）特征关联机制在显著观测和对齐误差下表现脆弱，限制了长距离感知能力
AI.method: 提出Long-SCOPE全稀疏框架，包含两个核心组件：1）几何引导查询生成模块，用于精确检测小而远的物体；2）可学习的上下文感知关联模块，在严重位置噪声下鲁棒地匹配协同查询
AI.result: 在V2X-Seq和Griffin数据集上的实验验证表明，Long-SCOPE在100-150米长距离场景中达到最先进性能，同时保持极具竞争力的计算和通信成本
AI.conclusion: Long-SCOPE通过全稀疏设计和鲁棒关联机制，有效解决了长距离协同3D感知的实际部署瓶颈，为车路协同感知系统提供了可扩展且鲁棒的解决方案

title: The causal relation between off-street parking and electric vehicle adoption in Scotland
summary: The transition to electric mobility hinges on maximising aggregate adoption while also facilitating equitable access. This study examines whether the 'charging divide' between households with and without off-street parking reflects a genuine infrastructure constraint or a by-product of socio-economic disparity. Moving beyond conventional predictive models, we apply a probabilistic causal framework to a nationally representative dataset of Scottish households, enabling estimation of policy interventions while explicitly neutralising the confounding effect of other causal factors. The results reveal a structural hierarchy in the EV adoption process. Private off-street parking functions as a conversion catalyst: enabling access to home-charging increases the probability of EV ownership from 3.3% to 5.6% (a 70% relative, 2.3 percentage point absolute increase). However, this effect primarily accelerates households already economically positioned to purchase an EV rather than recruiting new entrants. By contrast, household income operates as the fundamental affordability ceiling. A causal contrast between lower- and higher-income strata, shows a reduction in market non-participation by 23.1 percentage points, identifying financial capacity as the principal gatekeeper to entering the EV transition funnel. Crucially, the analysis demonstrates that standard observational models overstate the isolated effect of off-street parking infrastructure. The apparent effect emerges from selection bias: higher-income households are disproportionately likely to possess both private parking and the means to purchase EVs. These findings support a dual-track policy strategy: lowering the affordability ceiling for non-participants through financial instruments, while addressing EV home-charging access for the 'latent intent' cohort in high-density urban contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示电动汽车普及存在结构性障碍：家庭收入是根本的"可负担性天花板"，而私人停车位主要加速已具备经济能力家庭的购买决策，并非扩大市场参与的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在探究电动汽车普及中的"充电鸿沟"——拥有与没有街外停车位家庭之间的差异，究竟是真实的基础设施约束还是社会经济不平等的副产品。需要超越传统预测模型，识别影响电动汽车采纳的真正因果机制。
AI.method: 采用概率因果框架分析苏格兰全国家庭代表性数据集，通过明确中和其他因果因素的混杂效应，估计政策干预效果。与传统观测模型相比，该方法能更准确地分离不同因素的作用。
AI.result: 研究发现电动汽车采纳过程存在结构性层级：私人停车位作为转化催化剂，使电动汽车拥有概率从3.3%提升至5.6%（相对增加70%，绝对增加2.3个百分点），但主要加速已具备经济能力家庭的购买。家庭收入则是根本的可负担性天花板，低收入与高收入阶层对比显示市场非参与率减少23.1个百分点。传统观测模型高估了停车位基础设施的独立效应，其表观效应源于选择偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持双轨政策策略：通过金融工具降低非参与者的可负担性门槛，同时在城市高密度环境中解决"潜在意向"群体的家庭充电接入问题。政策应优先解决根本的经济障碍，而非过度关注停车位基础设施。

title: SHIFT: Steering Hidden Intermediates in Flow Transformers
summary: Diffusion models have become leading approaches for high-fidelity image generation. Recent DiT-based diffusion models, in particular, achieve strong prompt adherence while producing high-quality samples. We propose SHIFT, a simple but effective and lightweight framework for concept removal in DiT diffusion models via targeted manipulation of intermediate activations at inference time, inspired by activation steering in large language models. SHIFT learns steering vectors that are dynamically applied to selected layers and timesteps to suppress unwanted visual concepts while preserving the prompt's remaining content and overall image quality. Beyond suppression, the same mechanism can shift generations into a desired \emph{style domain} or bias samples toward adding or changing target objects. We demonstrate that SHIFT provides effective and flexible control over DiT generation across diverse prompts and targets without time-consuming retraining.

AI.tldr: SHIFT：一种针对DiT扩散模型的轻量级概念移除框架，通过推理时操纵中间激活来抑制不需要的视觉概念，同时保持图像质量和提示内容
AI.motivation: 扩散模型已成为高质量图像生成的主要方法，特别是基于DiT的扩散模型在提示遵循和样本质量方面表现优异。然而，现有方法缺乏在不进行耗时重新训练的情况下，对生成内容进行灵活控制的能力，特别是在抑制不需要的视觉概念方面。
AI.method: SHIFT框架受大型语言模型中激活引导的启发，通过目标性地操纵推理过程中的中间激活来实现概念移除。该方法学习引导向量，动态应用于选定的层和时间步，以抑制不需要的视觉概念，同时保持提示的其余内容和整体图像质量。该机制还可用于将生成结果转移到特定风格域，或偏向添加/更改目标对象。
AI.result: SHIFT在DiT生成中提供了有效且灵活的控制，能够处理多样化的提示和目标，无需耗时的重新训练。该方法展示了在保持图像质量和提示内容的同时，成功抑制不需要的视觉概念的能力。
AI.conclusion: SHIFT是一个简单但有效且轻量级的框架，通过推理时激活操纵为DiT扩散模型提供了灵活的概念控制能力，不仅支持概念移除，还能实现风格转移和目标对象修改，为扩散模型的可控生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Compressed Communication: Optimal Regret and Applications
summary: Distributed online convex optimization (D-OCO) is a powerful paradigm for modeling distributed scenarios with streaming data. However, the communication cost between local learners and the central server is substantial in large-scale applications. To alleviate this bottleneck, we initiate the study of D-OCO with compressed communication. Firstly, to quantify the compression impact, we establish the $Ω(δ^{-1/2}\sqrt{T})$ and $Ω(δ^{-1}\log{T})$ lower bounds for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, where $δ\in (0,1]$ is the compression ratio. Secondly, we propose an optimal algorithm, which enjoys regret bounds of $O(δ^{-1/2}\sqrt{T})$ and $O(δ^{-1} \log T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively. Our method incorporates the error feedback mechanism into the Follow-the-Regularized-Leader framework to address the coupling between the compression error and the projection error. Furthermore, we employ the online compression strategy to mitigate the accumulated error arising from the bidirectional compression. Our online method has great generality, and can be extended to the offline stochastic setting via online-to-batch conversion. We establish convergence rates of $O(δ^{-1/2}T^{-1/2})$ and $O(δ^{-1} T^{-1})$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, providing the first guarantees for distributed non-smooth optimization with compressed communication and domain constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了分布式在线凸优化中的压缩通信问题，建立了压缩比δ对性能影响的理论下界，并提出了匹配下界的最优算法。
AI.motivation: 分布式在线凸优化(D-OCO)在流数据场景中具有重要应用，但大规模应用中本地学习器与中央服务器之间的通信成本很高。为缓解这一瓶颈，需要研究压缩通信下的D-OCO问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种最优算法，将误差反馈机制整合到Follow-the-Regularized-Leader框架中，以处理压缩误差和投影误差的耦合问题。采用在线压缩策略减轻双向压缩带来的累积误差。该方法具有通用性，可通过在线到批处理的转换扩展到离线随机设置。
AI.result: 建立了凸损失函数Ω(δ^{-1/2}√T)和强凸损失函数Ω(δ^{-1}logT)的理论下界。提出的算法实现了O(δ^{-1/2}√T)和O(δ^{-1}logT)的遗憾界，分别匹配了凸和强凸情况的下界。在离线设置中，获得了O(δ^{-1/2}T^{-1/2})和O(δ^{-1}T^{-1})的收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为具有压缩通信和域约束的分布式非光滑优化提供了理论保证，提出的算法在压缩通信下达到了最优性能，有效缓解了分布式学习中的通信瓶颈问题。

title: TinyNeRV: Compact Neural Video Representations via Capacity Scaling, Distillation, and Low-Precision Inference
comment: Submitted to "Computers and Electrical Engineering", Elsevier
summary: Implicit neural video representations encode entire video sequences within the parameters of a neural network and enable constant time frame reconstruction. Recent work on Neural Representations for Videos (NeRV) has demonstrated competitive reconstruction performance while avoiding the sequential decoding process of conventional video codecs. However, most existing studies focus on moderate or high capacity models, leaving the behavior of extremely compact configurations required for constrained environments insufficiently explored. This paper presents a systematic study of tiny NeRV architectures designed for efficient deployment. Two lightweight configurations, NeRV-T and NeRV-T+, are introduced and evaluated across multiple video datasets in order to analyze how aggressive capacity reduction affects reconstruction quality, computational complexity, and decoding throughput. Beyond architectural scaling, the work investigates strategies for improving the performance of compact models without increasing inference cost. Knowledge distillation with frequency-aware focal supervision is explored to enhance reconstruction fidelity in low-capacity networks. In addition, the impact of lowprecision inference is examined through both post training quantization and quantization aware training to study the robustness of tiny models under reduced numerical precision. Experimental results demonstrate that carefully designed tiny NeRV variants can achieve favorable quality efficiency trade offs while substantially reducing parameter count, computational cost, and memory requirements. These findings provide insight into the practical limits of compact neural video representations and offer guidance for deploying NeRV style models in resource constrained and real-time environments. The official implementation is available at https: //github.com/HannanAkhtar/TinyNeRV-Implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了用于高效部署的微型NeRV架构，提出了NeRV-T和NeRV-T+两种轻量配置，探索了知识蒸馏和低精度推理策略，为资源受限环境中的神经视频表示部署提供了指导。
AI.motivation: 现有神经视频表示研究主要关注中等或高容量模型，对资源受限环境所需的极端紧凑配置行为研究不足。需要探索微型NeRV架构在重建质量、计算复杂度和解码吞吐量方面的表现。
AI.method: 提出两种轻量配置NeRV-T和NeRV-T+，在多视频数据集上进行评估。采用知识蒸馏与频率感知焦点监督提升紧凑模型性能，研究后训练量化和量化感知训练对低精度推理的影响。
AI.result: 精心设计的微型NeRV变体能在显著减少参数数量、计算成本和内存需求的同时，实现良好的质量效率权衡。实验结果为紧凑神经视频表示的实际极限提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在资源受限和实时环境中部署NeRV风格模型提供了指导，证明了微型神经视频表示在保持可接受重建质量的同时实现高效部署的可行性。

title: Are Independently Estimated View Uncertainties Comparable? Unified Routing for Trusted Multi-View Classification
summary: Trusted multi-view classification typically relies on a view-wise evidential fusion process: each view independently produces class evidence and uncertainty, and the final prediction is obtained by aggregating these independent opinions. While this design is modular and uncertainty-aware, it implicitly assumes that evidence from different views is numerically comparable. In practice, however, this assumption is fragile. Different views often differ in feature space, noise level, and semantic granularity, while independently trained branches are optimized only for prediction correctness, without any constraint enforcing cross-view consistency in evidence strength. As a result, the uncertainty used for fusion can be dominated by branch-specific scale bias rather than true sample-level reliability. To address this issue, we propose Trusted Multi-view learning with Unified Routing (TMUR), which decouples view-specific evidence extraction from fusion arbitration. TMUR uses view-private experts and one collaborative expert, and employs a unified router that observes the global multi-view context to generate sample-level expert weights. Soft load-balancing and diversity regularization further encourage balanced expert utilization and more discriminative expert specialization. We also provide theoretical analysis showing why independent evidential supervision does not identify a common cross-view evidence scale, and why unified global routing is preferable to branch-local arbitration when reliability is sample-dependent.

AI.tldr: TMUR提出可信多视图分类的统一路由方法，解决传统证据融合中视图间证据尺度不可比的问题
AI.motivation: 传统可信多视图分类假设不同视图的证据在数值上可比，但实际上不同视图在特征空间、噪声水平和语义粒度上存在差异，独立训练的分支仅优化预测正确性，缺乏跨视图证据强度一致性约束，导致融合时的不确定性可能被分支特定的尺度偏差而非真实样本可靠性所主导
AI.method: 提出可信多视图学习与统一路由(TMUR)，将视图特定证据提取与融合仲裁解耦。使用视图私有专家和协作专家，通过统一路由器观察全局多视图上下文生成样本级专家权重。采用软负载均衡和多样性正则化促进专家平衡利用和更区分性的专家专业化
AI.result: 论文提供了理论分析，说明为什么独立的证据监督无法识别跨视图的共同证据尺度，以及当可靠性依赖于样本时，为什么统一的全局路由优于分支本地仲裁
AI.conclusion: TMUR通过解耦证据提取与融合仲裁，采用统一路由机制，解决了多视图分类中证据尺度可比性问题，提高了可信多视图分类的可靠性和准确性

title: Hitem3D 2.0: Multi-View Guided Native 3D Texture Generation
summary: Although recent advances have improved the quality of 3D texture generation, existing methods still struggle with incomplete texture coverage, cross-view inconsistency, and misalignment between geometry and texture. To address these limitations, we propose Hitem3D 2.0, a multi-view guided native 3D texture generation framework that enhances texture quality through the integration of 2D multi-view generation priors and native 3D texture representations. Hitem3D 2.0 comprises two key components: a multi-view synthesis framework and a native 3D texture generation model. The multi-view generation is built upon a pre-trained image editing backbone and incorporates plug-and-play modules that explicitly promote geometric alignment, cross-view consistency, and illumination uniformity, thereby enabling the synthesis of high-fidelity multi-view images. Conditioned on the generated views and 3D geometry, the native 3D texture generation model projects multi-view textures onto 3D surfaces while plausibly completing textures in unseen regions. Through the integration of multi-view consistency constraints with native 3D texture modeling, Hitem3D 2.0 significantly improves texture completeness, cross-view coherence, and geometric alignment. Experimental results demonstrate that Hitem3D 2.0 outperforms existing methods in terms of texture detail, fidelity, consistency, coherence, and alignment.

AI.tldr: Hitem3D 2.0是一个多视角引导的原生3D纹理生成框架，通过整合2D多视角生成先验和原生3D纹理表示，解决了现有方法在纹理覆盖不完整、跨视角不一致以及几何与纹理不对齐方面的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D纹理生成方法存在三个主要问题：1）纹理覆盖不完整；2）跨视角不一致性；3）几何与纹理不对齐。这些限制影响了3D纹理的质量和实用性，需要新的方法来同时解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 框架包含两个关键组件：1）多视角合成框架：基于预训练图像编辑骨干，加入即插即用模块，显式促进几何对齐、跨视角一致性和光照均匀性；2）原生3D纹理生成模型：基于生成的多视角图像和3D几何，将多视角纹理投影到3D表面，并在不可见区域合理补全纹理。通过多视角一致性约束与原生3D纹理建模的整合来提升质量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Hitem3D 2.0在纹理细节、保真度、一致性、连贯性和对齐度方面优于现有方法，显著改善了纹理完整性、跨视角一致性和几何对齐。
AI.conclusion: Hitem3D 2.0通过整合多视角生成先验和原生3D纹理表示，有效解决了3D纹理生成中的关键挑战，为高质量3D纹理生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Stability Enhanced Gaussian Process Variational Autoencoders
summary: A novel stability-enhanced Gaussian process variational autoencoder (SEGP-VAE) is proposed for indirectly training a low-dimensional linear time invariant (LTI) system, using high-dimensional video data. The mean and covariance function of the novel SEGP prior are derived from the definition of an LTI system, enabling the SEGP to capture the indirectly observed latent process using a combined probabilistic and interpretable physical model. The search space of LTI parameters is restricted to the set of semi-contracting systems via a complete and unconstrained parametrisation. As a result, the SEGP-VAE can be trained using unconstrained optimisation algorithms. Furthermore, this parametrisation prevents numerical issues caused by the presence of a non-Hurwitz state matrix. A case study applies SEGP-VAE to a dataset containing videos of spiralling particles. This highlights the benefits of the approach and the application-specific design choices that enabled accurate latent state predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出SEGP-VAE方法，通过高维视频数据间接训练低维线性时不变系统，结合概率模型与物理模型，使用半收缩系统参数化确保稳定性
AI.motivation: 需要从高维视频数据中学习低维线性时不变系统的表示，但传统方法存在数值不稳定问题，且难以同时保持概率建模的灵活性和物理模型的可解释性
AI.method: 提出稳定性增强的高斯过程变分自编码器（SEGP-VAE），其先验的均值和协方差函数从LTI系统定义推导，使用半收缩系统的完全无约束参数化限制搜索空间，避免非Hurwitz状态矩阵导致的数值问题
AI.result: SEGP-VAE能够准确预测螺旋粒子视频数据集中的潜在状态，展示了方法的有效性，并通过应用特定设计选择实现了精确的潜在状态预测
AI.conclusion: SEGP-VAE成功结合了概率建模和可解释物理模型，通过稳定性增强的参数化方法解决了传统训练中的数值问题，为从高维观测数据学习低维动态系统提供了有效框架

title: Hierarchical Flow Decomposition for Turning Movement Prediction at Signalized Intersections
comment: Accepted to IEEE SoutheastCon 2026. 6 pages, 5 figures
summary: Accurate prediction of intersection turning movements is essential for adaptive signal control but remains difficult due to the high volatility of directional flows. This study proposes HFD-TM (Hierarchical Flow-Decomposition for Turning Movement Prediction), a hierarchical deep learning framework that predicts turning movements by first forecasting corridor through-movements and then expanding these predictions to individual turning streams. This design is motivated by empirical traffic structure, where corridor flows account for 65.1% of total volume, exhibit lower volatility than turning movements, and explain 35.5% of turning-movement variance. A physics-informed loss function enforces flow conservation to maintain structural consistency. Evaluated on six months of 15-minute interval LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) data from a six-intersection corridor in Nashville, Tennessee, HFD-TM achieves a mean absolute error of 2.49 vehicles per interval, reducing MAE by 5.7% compared to a Transformer and by 27.0% compared to a GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit). Ablation results show that hierarchical decomposition provides the largest performance gain, while training time is 12.8 times lower than DCRNN (Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network), demonstrating suitability for real-time traffic applications.

AI.tldr: HFD-TM是一个分层深度学习框架，通过先预测走廊直行流量再扩展到转向流量的方式，提高交叉口转向流量预测精度，适用于实时交通信号控制。
AI.motivation: 交叉口转向流量预测对自适应信号控制至关重要，但由于转向流量波动性高而难以准确预测。实证交通结构显示走廊直行流量占总流量的65.1%，波动性低于转向流量，并能解释35.5%的转向流量方差，这为分层预测提供了理论基础。
AI.method: 提出HFD-TM（分层流量分解转向预测）框架：1）先预测走廊直行流量；2）将直行流量预测扩展到各转向流量；3）使用物理信息损失函数强制流量守恒以保持结构一致性。基于田纳西州纳什维尔六交叉口走廊六个月的15分钟间隔LiDAR数据进行评估。
AI.result: HFD-TM实现每间隔2.49辆车的平均绝对误差，相比Transformer降低5.7%的MAE，相比GRU降低27.0%。消融实验显示分层分解带来最大性能提升，训练时间比DCRNN低12.8倍，适合实时交通应用。
AI.conclusion: HFD-TM通过利用交通流量的层次结构（走廊直行流量作为稳定基础），显著提高了转向流量预测精度，同时计算效率高，适合实时自适应信号控制系统。

title: Beyond Segmentation: Structurally Informed Facade Parsing from Imperfect Images
summary: Standard object detectors typically treat architectural elements independently, often resulting in facade parsings that lack the structural coherence required for downstream procedural reconstruction. We address this limitation by augmenting the YOLOv8 training objective with a custom lightweight alignment loss. This regularization encourages grid-consistent arrangements of bounding boxes during training, effectively injecting geometric priors without altering the standard inference pipeline. Experiments on the CMP dataset demonstrate that our method successfully improves structural regularity, correcting alignment errors caused by perspective and occlusion while maintaining a controllable trade-off with standard detection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种增强YOLOv8目标检测器的方法，通过添加自定义轻量级对齐损失来改善建筑立面解析的结构一致性，无需改变标准推理流程。
AI.motivation: 标准目标检测器通常独立处理建筑元素，导致立面解析缺乏结构一致性，难以满足下游程序化重建的需求。
AI.method: 在YOLOv8训练目标中增加自定义轻量级对齐损失，这种正则化方法鼓励边界框在训练过程中保持网格一致排列，注入几何先验知识。
AI.result: 在CMP数据集上的实验表明，该方法成功提高了结构规律性，纠正了由透视和遮挡引起的对齐错误，同时保持了与标准检测精度的可控权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过添加对齐损失正则化，可以在不改变标准推理流程的情况下改善建筑立面解析的结构一致性，为下游程序化重建提供更好的基础。

title: Bringing Clustering to MLL: Weakly-Supervised Clustering for Partial Multi-Label Learning
summary: Label noise in multi-label learning (MLL) poses significant challenges for model training, particularly in partial multi-label learning (PML) where candidate labels contain both relevant and irrelevant labels. While clustering offers a natural approach to exploit data structure for noise identification, traditional clustering methods cannot be directly applied to multi-label scenarios due to a fundamental incompatibility: clustering produces membership values that sum to one per instance, whereas multi-label assignments require binary values that can sum to any number. We propose a novel weakly-supervised clustering approach for PML (WSC-PML) that bridges clustering and multi-label learning through membership matrix decomposition. Our key innovation decomposes the clustering membership matrix $\mathbf{A}$ into two components: $\mathbf{A} = \mathbfΠ \odot \mathbf{F}$, where $\mathbfΠ$ maintains clustering constraints while $\mathbf{F}$ preserves multi-label characteristics. This decomposition enables seamless integration of unsupervised clustering with multi-label supervision for effective label noise handling. WSC-PML employs a three-stage process: initial prototype learning from noisy labels, adaptive confidence-based weak supervision construction, and joint optimization via iterative clustering refinement. Extensive experiments on 24 datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms six state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出WSC-PML方法，通过成员矩阵分解将聚类与多标签学习相结合，解决部分多标签学习中的标签噪声问题
AI.motivation: 多标签学习中的标签噪声问题严重，特别是在部分多标签学习中，候选标签同时包含相关和无关标签。传统聚类方法无法直接应用于多标签场景，因为聚类产生的成员值总和为1，而多标签分配需要二进制值且总和可为任意数。
AI.method: 提出弱监督聚类方法WSC-PML，通过成员矩阵分解A = Π ⊙ F，其中Π保持聚类约束，F保留多标签特性。采用三阶段流程：从噪声标签中学习初始原型、构建自适应置信度弱监督、通过迭代聚类细化进行联合优化。
AI.result: 在24个数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在全部评估指标上优于六种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过成员矩阵分解成功桥接了聚类与多标签学习，为部分多标签学习中的标签噪声处理提供了有效解决方案。

title: GeRM: A Generative Rendering Model From Physically Realistic to Photorealistic
summary: For decades, Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) is the fundation of synthesizing photorealisitic images, and therefore sometimes roughly referred as Photorealistic Rendering (PRR). While PBR is indeed a mathematical simulation of light transport that guarantees physical reality, photorealism has additional reliance on the realistic digital model of geometry and appearance of the real world, leaving a barely explored gap from PBR to PRR (P2P). Consequently, the path toward photorealism faces a critical dilemma: the explicit simulation of PRR encumbered by unreachable realistic digital models for real-world existence, while implicit generation models sacrifice controllability and geometric consistency. Based on this insight, this paper presents the problem, data, and approach of mitigating P2P gap, followed by the first multi-modal generative rendering model, dubbed GeRM, to unify PBR and PRR. GeRM integrates physical attributes like G-buffers with text prompts, and progressive incremental injection to generate controllable photorealistic images, allowing users to fluidly navigate the continuum between strict physical fidelity and perceptual photorealism. Technically, we model the transition between PBR and PRR images as a distribution transfer and aim to learn a distribution transfer vector field (DTV Field) to guide this process. To define the learning objective, we first leverage a multi-agent VLM framework to construct an expert-guided pairwise P2P transfer dataset, named P2P-50K, where each paired sample in the dataset corresponds to a transfer vector in the DTV Field. Subsequently, we propose a multi-condition ControlNet to learn the DTV Field, which synthesizes PBR images and progressively transitions them into PRR images, guided by G-buffers, text prompts, and cues for enhanced regions.

AI.tldr: 提出GeRM模型，通过分布转移向量场（DTV Field）统一物理渲染（PBR）与照片级真实感渲染（PRR），解决两者间的P2P差距问题
AI.motivation: 传统物理渲染（PBR）虽能保证物理真实性，但照片级真实感（PRR）还需依赖难以获得的真实世界几何与外观数字模型。现有方法面临两难：显式模拟需要不可达的真实数字模型，而隐式生成模型牺牲了可控性与几何一致性。
AI.method: 1) 将PBR到PRR的过渡建模为分布转移，学习分布转移向量场（DTV Field）；2) 利用多智能体VLM框架构建专家指导的P2P转移数据集P2P-50K；3) 提出多条件ControlNet学习DTV Field，通过渐进增量注入合成可控照片级真实感图像。
AI.result: 提出首个多模态生成渲染模型GeRM，能够整合G-buffer等物理属性与文本提示，实现从严格物理保真度到感知照片级真实感的连续导航。
AI.conclusion: GeRM通过统一PBR与PRR，解决了照片级真实感渲染中的关键困境，在保持物理可控性的同时实现了高质量的照片级真实感生成。

title: Structure-Aware Fine-Grained Gaussian Splatting for Expressive Avatar Reconstruction
comment: The code is on Github: https://github.com/Su245811YZ/SFGS
summary: Reconstructing photorealistic and topology-aware human avatars from monocular videos remains a significant challenge in the fields of computer vision and graphics. While existing 3D human avatar modeling approaches can effectively capture body motion, they often fail to accurately model fine details such as hand movements and facial expressions. To address this, we propose Structure-aware Fine-grained Gaussian Splatting (SFGS), a novel method for reconstructing expressive and coherent full-body 3D human avatars from a monocular video sequence. The SFGS use both spatial-only triplane and time-aware hexplane to capture dynamic features across consecutive frames. A structure-aware gaussian module is designed to capture pose-dependent details in a spatially coherent manner and improve pose and texture expression. To better model hand deformations, we also propose a residual refinement module based on fine-grained hand reconstruction. Our method requires only a single-stage training and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, generating high-fidelity avatars with natural motion and fine details. The code is on Github: https://github.com/Su245811YZ/SFGS

AI.tldr: SFGS是一种从单目视频重建具有拓扑感知的高保真全身3D人体化身的新方法，通过空间三平面和时间六平面捕捉动态特征，结合结构感知高斯模块和手部残差细化模块，实现自然运动和精细细节的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体化身建模方法虽然能有效捕捉身体运动，但难以准确建模手部动作和面部表情等精细细节。从单目视频重建具有拓扑感知的逼真人体化身仍是一个重要挑战。
AI.method: 提出结构感知细粒度高斯溅射（SFGS）方法：1）使用空间三平面和时间六平面捕捉连续帧间的动态特征；2）设计结构感知高斯模块以空间一致的方式捕捉姿态相关细节，改善姿态和纹理表达；3）提出基于细粒度手部重建的残差细化模块，更好地建模手部变形。该方法仅需单阶段训练。
AI.result: 在定量和定性评估中均优于现有最先进基线方法，能够生成具有自然运动和精细细节的高保真化身。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: SFGS方法有效解决了从单目视频重建表达性和连贯性全身3D人体化身的挑战，在捕捉精细细节（特别是手部动作）方面表现出色，为高质量人体化身建模提供了新解决方案。

title: Efficient Unlearning through Maximizing Relearning Convergence Delay
summary: Machine unlearning poses challenges in removing mislabeled, contaminated, or problematic data from a pretrained model. Current unlearning approaches and evaluation metrics are solely focused on model predictions, which limits insight into the model's true underlying data characteristics. To address this issue, we introduce a new metric called relearning convergence delay, which captures both changes in weight space and prediction space, providing a more comprehensive assessment of the model's understanding of the forgotten dataset. This metric can be used to assess the risk of forgotten data being recovered from the unlearned model. Based on this, we propose the Influence Eliminating Unlearning framework, which removes the influence of the forgetting set by degrading its performance and incorporates weight decay and injecting noise into the model's weights, while maintaining accuracy on the retaining set. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing metrics and our proposed relearning convergence delay metric, approaching ideal unlearning performance. We provide theoretical guarantees, including exponential convergence and upper bounds, as well as empirical evidence of strong retention and resistance to relearning in both classification and generative unlearning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出新的遗忘学习评估指标"再学习收敛延迟"，捕捉权重空间和预测空间变化，并基于此提出影响消除遗忘框架，在保持保留集性能的同时有效移除遗忘集影响。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习遗忘方法仅关注模型预测，无法深入了解模型对遗忘数据的真实理解特性，需要更全面的评估指标来评估遗忘数据从模型中恢复的风险。
AI.method: 提出再学习收敛延迟指标，同时捕捉权重空间和预测空间变化；基于此提出影响消除遗忘框架，通过权重衰减和权重注入噪声来消除遗忘集影响，同时保持保留集准确率。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法优于现有指标和提出的再学习收敛延迟指标，接近理想遗忘性能；提供理论保证（指数收敛和上界）和实证证据，在分类和生成遗忘任务中均表现出强保持性和抗再学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的再学习收敛延迟指标和影响消除遗忘框架为机器学习遗忘提供了更全面的评估和更有效的解决方案，能够更好地评估遗忘数据恢复风险并实现更彻底的遗忘。

title: From Frames to Events: Rethinking Evaluation in Human-Centric Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Pose-based Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) has gained significant attention for its privacy-preserving nature and robustness to environmental variations. However, traditional frame-level evaluations treat video as a collection of isolated frames, fundamentally misaligned with how anomalies manifest and are acted upon in the real world. In operational surveillance systems, what matters is not the flagging of individual frames, but the reliable detection, localization, and reporting of a coherent anomalous event, a contiguous temporal episode with an identifiable onset and duration. Frame-level metrics are blind to this distinction, and as a result, they systematically overestimate model performance for any deployment that requires actionable, event-level alerts. In this work, we propose a shift toward an event-centric perspective in VAD. We first audit widely used VAD benchmarks, including SHT[19], CHAD[6], NWPUC[4], and HuVAD[25], to characterize their event structure. We then introduce two strategies for temporal event localization: a score-refinement pipeline with hierarchical Gaussian smoothing and adaptive binarization, and an end-to-end Dual-Branch Model that directly generates event-level detections. Finally, we establish the first event-based evaluation standard for VAD by adapting Temporal Action Localization metrics, including tIoU-based event matching and multi-threshold F1 evaluation. Our results quantify a substantial performance gap: while all SoTA models achieve frame-level AUC-ROC exceeding 52% on the NWPUC[4], their event-level localization precision falls below 10% even at a minimal tIoU=0.2, with an average event-level F1 of only 0.11 across all thresholds. The code base for this work is available at https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/EventCentric-VAD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从帧级评估转向事件中心视角的视频异常检测方法，通过审计现有基准的事件结构、开发事件定位策略，并建立首个基于事件的评估标准，揭示了现有方法在事件级检测上的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 传统基于姿态的视频异常检测采用帧级评估，这与实际监控系统中需要检测连贯异常事件（具有可识别起始和持续时间）的需求不匹配。帧级指标会系统性高估模型性能，无法满足需要可操作事件级警报的实际部署需求。
AI.method: 1) 审计SHT、CHAD、NWPUC、HuVAD等广泛使用的VAD基准的事件结构；2) 提出两种时间事件定位策略：基于分层高斯平滑和自适应二值化的分数细化管道，以及直接生成事件级检测的端到端双分支模型；3) 通过调整时间动作定位指标（包括基于tIoU的事件匹配和多阈值F1评估），建立首个基于事件的VAD评估标准。
AI.result: 量化了显著的性能差距：所有最先进模型在NWPUC上的帧级AUC-ROC超过52%，但事件级定位精度即使在最小tIoU=0.2时也低于10%，所有阈值下的平均事件级F1仅为0.11。
AI.conclusion: 需要从帧级评估转向事件中心视角的视频异常检测，现有方法在事件级检测上表现严重不足，提出的事件级评估标准能更准确地反映模型在实际部署中的性能。

title: OASIS: Online Activation Subspace Learning for Memory-Efficient Training
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) is constrained by memory requirements, with activations accounting for a substantial fraction of the total footprint. Existing approaches reduce memory using low-rank weight parameterizations or low-rank gradient subspaces for optimizer states, while activation memory is addressed through architectural modifications or compression schemes based on periodically updated projections. We propose OASIS, an online activation subspace learning algorithm for memory-efficient training that tracks and continuously updates a low-dimensional activation subspace during training. Intermediate activations are projected onto this evolving subspace, reducing memory without modifying forward-pass computations. The evolving activation subspace induces low-rank gradient representations, enabling both gradients and optimizer states to be maintained directly in this subspace, while a projection-aware optimizer consistently transports optimizer states across subspace updates for stable training. Across various finetuning and pretraining tasks, OASIS achieves up to $2\times$ lower peak memory than full fine-tuning while matching its performance and outperforming prior low-rank methods.

AI.tldr: OASIS是一种在线激活子空间学习算法，通过在训练过程中持续更新低维激活子空间来减少内存占用，实现高效训练
AI.motivation: 训练大型语言模型受限于内存需求，其中激活值占用了大量内存。现有方法通过低秩权重参数化或低秩梯度子空间来减少内存，但激活内存通常需要架构修改或基于周期性更新投影的压缩方案
AI.method: 提出OASIS算法：1）在线跟踪并持续更新低维激活子空间；2）将中间激活投影到该演化子空间以减少内存；3）演化激活子空间诱导低秩梯度表示，使梯度和优化器状态可直接在该子空间中维护；4）使用投影感知优化器在子空间更新间一致传输优化器状态以确保训练稳定性
AI.result: 在各种微调和预训练任务中，OASIS实现了比完整微调低2倍的峰值内存，同时性能相当且优于先前的低秩方法
AI.conclusion: OASIS通过在线激活子空间学习有效减少训练内存，无需修改前向计算，在保持性能的同时显著降低内存需求

title: NOMAD: Generating Embeddings for Massive Distributed Graphs
summary:
Successful machine learning on graphs or networks requires embeddings that not only represent nodes and edges as low-dimensional vectors but also preserve the graph structure. Established methods for generating embeddings require flexible exploration of the entire graph through repeated use of random walks that capture graph structure with samples of nodes and edges. These methods create scalability challenges for massive graphs with millions-to-billions of edges because single-node solutions have inadequate memory and processing capabilities.
  We present NOMAD, a distributed-memory graph embedding framework using the Message Passing Interface (MPI) for distributed graphs. NOMAD implements proximity-based models proposed in the widely popular LINE (Large-scale Information Network Embedding) algorithm. We propose several practical trade-offs to improve the scalability and communication overheads confronted by irregular and distributed graph embedding methods, catering to massive-scale graphs arising in web and science domains. NOMAD demonstrates median speedups of 10/100x on CPU-based NERSC Perlmutter cluster relative to the popular reference implementations of multi-threaded LINE and node2vec, 35-76x over distributed PBG, and competitive embedding quality relative to LINE, node2vec, and GraphVite, while yielding 12-370x end-to-end speedups on real-world graphs.

AI.tldr: NOMAD是一个基于MPI的分布式内存图嵌入框架，针对大规模图（百万到十亿边）的嵌入计算，相比现有方法实现了10-370倍的加速，同时保持与LINE、node2vec等算法相当的嵌入质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图嵌入方法（如LINE、node2vec）在处理大规模图时面临可扩展性挑战，因为基于随机游走的单节点解决方案在内存和处理能力上不足，无法有效处理百万到十亿边级别的图。
AI.method: 提出NOMAD分布式内存图嵌入框架，使用MPI实现分布式图处理。基于LINE算法的邻近性模型，提出了多个实用权衡策略来改善不规则和分布式图嵌入方法的可扩展性和通信开销。
AI.result: 在NERSC Perlmutter CPU集群上，相比多线程LINE和node2vec实现了中位数10-100倍加速，相比分布式PBG实现35-76倍加速，相比GraphVite实现12-370倍端到端加速，同时保持与LINE、node2vec相当的嵌入质量。
AI.conclusion: NOMAD框架成功解决了大规模图嵌入的可扩展性问题，通过分布式内存架构和优化策略，在保持嵌入质量的同时显著提升了计算性能，适用于Web和科学领域的大规模图应用。

title: Offline Local Search for Online Stochastic Bandits
comment: Part of this work has been accepted at ACM SIGMETRICS 2026
summary: Combinatorial multi-armed bandits provide a fundamental online decision-making environment where a decision-maker interacts with an environment across $T$ time steps, each time selecting an action and learning the cost of that action. The goal is to minimize regret, defined as the loss compared to the optimal fixed action in hindsight under full-information. There has been substantial interest in leveraging what is known about offline algorithm design in this online setting. Offline greedy and linear optimization algorithms (both exact and approximate) have been shown to provide useful guarantees when deployed online. We investigate local search methods, a broad class of algorithms used widely in both theory and practice, which have thus far been under-explored in this context. We focus on problems where offline local search terminates in an approximately optimal solution and give a generic method for converting such an offline algorithm into an online stochastic combinatorial bandit algorithm with $O(\log^3 T)$ (approximate) regret. In contrast, existing offline-to-online frameworks yield regret (and approximate regret) which depend sub-linearly, but polynomially on $T$. We demonstrate the flexibility of our framework by applying it to three online stochastic combinatorial optimization problems: scheduling to minimize total completion time, finding a minimum cost base of a matroid and uncertain clustering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将离线局部搜索算法转换为在线随机组合多臂老虎机算法的通用框架，实现了O(log³ T)的近似遗憾，相比现有框架的亚线性多项式依赖有所改进。
AI.motivation: 组合多臂老虎机是重要的在线决策环境，现有研究主要关注如何利用离线算法设计知识来改进在线性能。虽然离线贪心和线性优化算法已被成功应用于在线设置，但局部搜索方法这一在理论和实践中广泛使用的算法类别尚未得到充分探索。论文旨在填补这一空白，研究如何将离线局部搜索算法转换为高效的在线算法。
AI.method: 提出一个通用框架，将离线局部搜索算法转换为在线随机组合老虎机算法。该框架适用于那些离线局部搜索能够终止于近似最优解的问题。核心思想是利用局部搜索的迭代改进特性，在在线环境中通过有限的探索来近似模拟离线搜索过程，同时控制探索成本。
AI.result: 实现了O(log³ T)的近似遗憾界，相比现有离线到在线转换框架的亚线性多项式依赖（如O(T^α)）有显著改进。将该框架应用于三个具体问题：最小化总完成时间的调度问题、拟阵最小成本基问题和不确定聚类问题，验证了框架的灵活性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 局部搜索算法可以有效地转换为在线随机组合老虎机算法，获得对数级别的近似遗憾。该框架为利用丰富的离线局部搜索算法解决在线组合优化问题提供了系统方法，扩展了离线到在线转换的理论工具集。

title: AdaCubic: An Adaptive Cubic Regularization Optimizer for Deep Learning
summary: A novel regularization technique, AdaCubic, is proposed that adapts the weight of the cubic term. The heart of AdaCubic is an auxiliary optimization problem with cubic constraints that dynamically adjusts the weight of the cubic term in Newton's cubic regularized method. We use Hutchinson's method to approximate the Hessian matrix, thereby reducing computational cost. We demonstrate that AdaCubic inherits the cubically regularized Newton method's local convergence guarantees. Our experiments in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, and Signal Processing tasks demonstrate that AdaCubic outperforms or competes with several widely used optimizers. Unlike other adaptive algorithms that require hyperparameter fine-tuning, AdaCubic is evaluated with a fixed set of hyperparameters, rendering it a highly attractive optimizer in settings where fine-tuning is infeasible. This makes AdaCubic an attractive option for researchers and practitioners alike. To our knowledge, AdaCubic is the first optimizer to leverage cubic regularization in scalable deep learning applications.

AI.tldr: AdaCubic是一种新颖的自适应三次正则化优化器，通过辅助优化问题动态调整三次项权重，使用Hutchinson方法近似Hessian矩阵降低计算成本，在多个深度学习任务中表现优异且无需超参数调优。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应优化算法通常需要大量超参数调优，而三次正则化牛顿方法虽然理论保证好但计算成本高，难以扩展到大规模深度学习应用。需要一种既能保持三次正则化优势又具备计算效率和易用性的优化器。
AI.method: 提出AdaCubic优化器，核心是包含三次约束的辅助优化问题，动态调整牛顿三次正则化方法中的三次项权重。采用Hutchinson方法近似Hessian矩阵以降低计算复杂度。该方法继承了三次正则化牛顿方法的局部收敛保证。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉、自然语言处理和信号处理任务上的实验表明，AdaCubic优于或与多种常用优化器竞争。重要的是，AdaCubic使用固定超参数集进行评估，无需调优，在无法进行超参数调优的场景中具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: AdaCubic是首个在可扩展深度学习应用中利用三次正则化的优化器，结合了理论保证、计算效率和易用性，为研究人员和从业者提供了有吸引力的优化选择。

title: Robust 4D Visual Geometry Transformer with Uncertainty-Aware Priors
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 4D scenes is an important yet challenging task. While 3D foundation models like VGGT excel in static settings, they often struggle with dynamic sequences where motion causes significant geometric ambiguity. To address this, we present a framework designed to disentangle dynamic and static components by modeling uncertainty across different stages of the reconstruction process.
